当前未选择模组。

你可以选择充斥光能模组、救赎花园模组、梦魇模组、突袭模组和战争思维电池模组在此插槽中使用。

flavorText.en: No time to rest. The hunt goes on.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无暇休息，狩猎继续。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

description.en: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
description.zh-CN: 手雷会在撞击时碎裂，留下一片减速目标的力场，未离开力场范围的敌人会被冻结。

description.en: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
description.zh-CN: 手雷可制造出冰影水晶所形成的墙壁以阻挡伤害和冻结目标；可以碎裂这些墙壁来制造伤害。

description.en: A grenade that sticks to combatants before exploding into razor-sharp [Stasis] Stasis shrapnel. The shrapnel ricochets off surfaces, dealing damage to all in its path. Hitting a frozen target shatters it instantly and deals bonus damage.
description.zh-CN: 一种会粘附在战斗人员身上，然后爆炸成锋利冰影弹片的手雷。弹片会在表面弹射，对路径上的一切造成伤害。命中被冻结的目标会立即将其击碎并造成额外伤害。

description.en: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
description.zh-CN: 手雷命中后会冻结敌人并释放另一颗跟踪雷来寻找并冻结目标。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: Forged in honor of Skorri, of lessons learned and lessons taught.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为向斯科里及其经验教训致敬而铸造。

description.zh-CN: 高射速的近战/远程长柄武器，带有正面护盾。造成远程伤害时产生护盾能量。

description.zh-CN: 造成持续伤害可割裂目标。

flavorText.zh-CN: 让愉悦在你的体内流转吧！

description.en:
Archie loves these dog-safe cookies, even though he can't really eat them! Deliver them to him in the Tower Annex.
 - Available only during the Dawning.
description.zh-CN:
阿奇很喜欢这些对狗无害的饼干，尽管他其实吃不了！把它们送到高塔附属建筑，交给他。
 - 仅在曙光节期间有效。

flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿坚定不移。

flavorText.zh-CN: Omolon塞努纳SI6可靠而稳定，随时准备就绪。

description.en: Deliver these delicious and nostalgic treats to Eris Morn on the Moon.
description.zh-CN: 给月球的埃里斯·摩恩送去这些美味而怀旧的小食。

flavorText.en: "When the lake used to freeze, people would dance on the ice wearing boots with tiny swords. And fall in love."
flavorText.zh-CN: “曾经湖泊结冰的时候，人们穿着带着冰刀的靴子在冰上舞蹈。然后坠入爱河。”

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

flavorText.en: "I'm tired, but I can't give in…"
flavorText.zh-CN: “我累了，但我不能屈服…”

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从此处到外环，插翅难飞。

description.en: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.
description.zh-CN: 使用混沌加速为你的虚空手雷充能时，可抵挡受到的伤害。充能完毕的虚空手雷在命中及施加削弱时会返还手雷能量。

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一副末世既临之容，一双厄土天赐之眼；观其形貌，便知逃无生天。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “或许我们能将它夺回来。你知道吗，或许农庄可以成为另一个圣城。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: Torches: recommended for adventurers and evil castles.
flavorText.zh-CN: 火炬：推荐冒险者和邪恶城堡使用。

description.en: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of reload speed.
description.zh-CN: 以牺牲填装速度为代价，大幅提升武器的稳定性。

description.en: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 使用手雷或此武器获得最后一击可提高此武器的伤害和操控性。

flavorText.en: "Without Light to sustain it, this body of mine cannot make the pilgrimage to the Shard. But you can." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有光能的支撑，我这副身躯无法前往碎片完成对它的朝圣。但你可以。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: "I've seen experiments like this before. My crew.... I don't want to talk about it." —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “我曾经见过这种实验。我的船员……我不想再提这个了。”——智能失效保险

flavorText.en: "You made the right choice. I think. Either way, I'm on your side." —Ghost
flavorText.zh-CN: “你做了对的选择，至少我这么认为。无论如何，我支持你。”——机灵

flavorText.en: "I'll tell my children I was there. Before the battle had a name. Before it became a symbol of victory for the Titan orders."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我会告诉我的孩子们，在那场战斗还没有名字之前，在它成为泰坦胜利的象征之前，我就在那里了。”

flavorText.en: "I know where I stand." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “我知道我的立场。”——第三百夫长泰坦，雅尔达姆-4

flavorText.en: "In war and peace, in fear and doubt… the Crucible still stands." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “战争与和平，恐惧与疑虑…熔炉竞技场始终屹立不倒。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的传承鼓舞着我们，这样我们才有力量把手伸向未来。没有哪个云端行者是在孤军奋战。”——云端行者，洛汗

flavorText.en: Burn the world. Burn it all.
flavorText.zh-CN: 焚烧这世界。烧毁这一切。

flavorText.en: "All that we've left in the athenaeum catalogs are suitable proxies for all the powers of this system. I've simply forgotten how to reach them. I'm not who I was. I need you." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们在宝藏世界目录中所留下的一切，都很适合成为这个星系中所有力量的代理人。我只是忘了怎么找到它们而已。我已经不是以前的我了。我需要你的帮助。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Complete the Royal Pools challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 完成皇家水池挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from Guardian Games.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从守护者游戏中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

name.zh-CN: 星芒冰影幼龙猎人披风

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "They who entered the Speaker's chambers as master and apprentice were bitter rivals when they left." —Brother Vance
flavorText.zh-CN: “那些以主仆的身份进入先知的房间的人，在离开时就变成了死对头。”——万斯修士

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "Cryptarchs made a crystal that starts fires? Get me one. I don't care how you do it. Go!" —Cayde-6
flavorText.zh-CN: “解密大师们制造了能点火的水晶？帮我搞一个，方法自己看着办。去吧！”——凯德6号

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: Forsaken, not stirred.
flavorText.zh-CN: 摇匀，但不要搅拌。

description.en:
Honk!

Press [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_vehicle_honk_button###] to honk your vehicle's equipped horn.
description.zh-CN:
滴滴！

按下[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_vehicle_honk_button###]以鸣响载具上装备的喇叭。

description.en: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
description.zh-CN: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

flavorText.en: A Black Armory experimental prototype.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件黑色军械库实验原型。

sourceString.en: Source: Crafted in a Black Armory forge.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在黑色军械库锻炉中制造。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: Mostly the hero—but with a healthy dash of the monster, too. That's what it means to be a Hunter.
flavorText.zh-CN: 基本算是英雄——但还带点儿怪物的气息。这就是猎人。

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Ikora Rey.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：艾可拉·蕾伊处获得升级包。

description.en: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
description.zh-CN: 在空中时进行第二次或第三次跳跃可保持在空中。

description.en: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
description.zh-CN: 在空中时再次跳跃可上升到更高的高度。

description.en: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
description.zh-CN: 在空中时凭借强劲的方向控制再次进行跳跃。

description.en: Equip this Weapon Ornament to change the appearance of Sturm.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变狂飙的外观。

flavorText.en: "A haze permeates the air here, occluding clear sight. Be very sure of your aim." —The Exo Stranger
flavorText.zh-CN: “雾霭在这里的空气中扩散，遮挡住清晰的视线。所以一定要瞄准再开枪。”——陌客

flavorText.en: To sharpen our senses when we return.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在归途中，锐化我们的感官。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Trachinus. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变龙䲢的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Solipsism. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变唯我主义的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 经济机灵模组

flavorText.en: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.
flavorText.zh-CN: 领主萨拉丁让战死的爱国同胞的回忆留存了下来。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
description.zh-CN: 在更短的一小段时间内瞄准此武器而不射击可提高射程和精准伤害，射击或退出瞄准后重置。

flavorText.en: Titans are both the shelter and the storm.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦既能遮风挡雨又是雷云风暴。

flavorText.en: Keep it moving. Swift of foot and long of stride.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要停步。快步行，大步走。

flavorText.en: "Six-arms attacked again today. Dayo and Lekan dead. Without Risen protection, we are all next." —Annals of the Saharan Contested Zone
flavorText.zh-CN: “六臂今天再次发动攻击，达约和勒坎牺牲了。没有复生者的保护，我们就是下一个。”——撒哈拉争议地区编年史

flavorText.en: "If I fail, let me be worm food."
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果我失败了，就让我成为蠕虫的养料吧。”

description.en: Upgrade this Ghost to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this Ghost to Masterwork provides an additional mod socket.
description.zh-CN: 升级此机灵使其能量上限提高1。完全升级此机灵为大师杰作会提供一个额外的模组插槽。

description.en: Upgrade this Ghost to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this Ghost to Masterwork provides an additional mod socket.

description.en: Each stack of Gathering Light improves this weapon's reload, handling, and target acquisition.
description.zh-CN: 每层“光能聚集”均可提升此武器的填装、操控性和目标获取能力。

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

flavorText.en: "In my company, the Ether flows." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “乙太涓流，伴我同行。”——蛛王

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 头盔护甲模组

description.en:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
description.zh-CN:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

description.en: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
description.zh-CN: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

flavorText.en: Don't listen.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要聆听。

flavorText.en: "How you feel is how you look, my dear. And I want you feeling your best!" –Eva Levante
flavorText.zh-CN: “亲爱的，你的感受决定了你的状态。而我希望你感受到你的最佳状态！”——伊娃·莱万特

description.en: Reloads an additional shot at a time.
description.zh-CN: 一次填装一发额外子弹。

description.en: Damaging an opponent temporarily increases speed and handling.
description.zh-CN: 对敌人造成伤害可暂时提高速度和操控性。

flavorText.en: "With stout and unfailing arm, Executors shall defend the principles of monarchy to all who challenge them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6
flavorText.zh-CN: “有着粗壮又坚硬的胳膊，面对所有试图挑战他们的人，执行者们应当捍卫王派准则。”——执行者法则，卷6

description.en: Recoil pattern on this weapon is more predictably vertical. Fires a 4-round burst.
description.zh-CN: 在垂直方向上的后坐轨迹更加规则。可进行4发点射。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: Show them you can contain multitudes, and your interiority will spawn nightmares.
flavorText.zh-CN: 向他们展示你的心胸之广，你心中的力量便是他们的噩梦。

flavorText.en: This cannot go unchallenged.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这不可能不受质疑。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Malfeasance. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变渎职的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Defeat enemies in strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV leg armor.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在打击中消灭敌人可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV腿部护甲上解锁。

flavorText.en: Even the meekest among us deserve to be cared for.
flavorText.zh-CN: 即使是我们之中最温柔的存在也应得到照顾。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: Heh, heh, heh.
flavorText.zh-CN: 嘿嘿嘿。

flavorText.en: III - You are hollowed.
flavorText.zh-CN: III - 你被掏空了。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

description.en: Completing all clan challenges in a week grants an Ascendant Alloy.
description.zh-CN: 完成一周中的所有公会挑战可奖励一个上维合金。

description.en: This item comes with randomized perks.
description.zh-CN: 此物品自带随机特性。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Equip this item to change your Ghost's projection.
description.zh-CN: 装备此物品以改变机灵投影。

flavorText.en: "A Sacred Splicer can change much, but I never dreamed our lives would change so quickly." —Mithrax
flavorText.zh-CN: “神圣熔岩军团可以改变很多东西，但我做梦也想不到我们的生活会变化得如此之快。”——米瑟拉克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Season of the Splicer Activities

flavorText.en: We light the candle for those we've lost.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们为逝者点上一支蜡烛。

description.en: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
description.zh-CN: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的资源。

name.zh-CN: 赫拉斯盆地资源探测器

flavorText.en: Hunters are born survivors.
flavorText.zh-CN: 猎人是天生的生存专家。

flavorText.en: You're a difficult one to find.
flavorText.zh-CN: 找寻你如同大海捞针。

flavorText.en: “We armed the Sindu with a fleet of golden ships. Their interceptors are a shield for the Leviathan, as the Shadows are my sword.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们给信德装备了一支黄金飞船舰队。他们的拦截者就是利维坦的护盾，就像暗影是我的利剑一样。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Well-rounded, reliable, fires a 3-round burst.
description.zh-CN: 全面，可靠，可进行3发点射。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Necrotic Grip. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变亡灵之握的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

description.en: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
description.zh-CN: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: You're talking big. Let's see you back it up.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你说话口气不小。让我们看看你能否兑现。

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: "Our mysterious defender slew a Kell today. Kandak has banned other Risen and put a bounty on the so-called Red Moon Phantom's head." —Annals of the Saharan Contested Zone
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们神秘的保护者今天干掉了一个凯尔。坎达克已经封杀了其他复生者，还要悬赏血月幻灵的项上人头。”——撒哈拉争议地区编年史

flavorText.en: Sit like a Warlock.
flavorText.zh-CN: 像术士一样坐下。

description.en: Every seventh bullet from this weapon ricochets to nearby targets.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的每第七发子弹会弹向附近目标。

flavorText.en: Three drops is all it takes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 只要三发。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: We were all strangers once. Even the Traveler.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们都曾是陌路人。旅行者亦然。

description.en: Deliver these unknowable alabaster spheres to Ikora Rey in the Tower Bazaar.
description.zh-CN: 把这些不可知的雪花球状物送给高塔集市里的艾可拉·蕾伊。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 已发现的食谱

flavorText.en: A finger of death from which to hang.
flavorText.zh-CN: 悬吊其上的一根死亡之指。

description.en: Claim Vanguard Tactician reward engrams during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It's unlocked for all Crucible armor sets.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间领取先锋战术家记忆水晶奖励以获得此皮肤。所有熔炉竞技场护甲套装均可解锁此皮肤。

flavorText.en: Some things never go out of fashion.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有些东西永远不会过时。

flavorText.en: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."

flavorText.zh-CN: 爱的原则不是等价交换。

flavorText.zh-CN: “船长，7066涅索斯的轨道与发射基地的计算结果不同。”——飞行官萨曼莎·布莱兹

An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.

一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.en: To Serve and Protect.
flavorText.zh-CN: 效命和保护。

description.zh-CN: 装备此物品以改变机灵投影。

flavorText.en: I wish to be renowned.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿名扬四海。

description.en: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.
description.zh-CN: 填装此武器会自动收集附近的弹药。

flavorText.en: Titans honor their armor, no matter its strength.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦珍视自己的盔甲，无论它是否精良。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the end of all things. The novenary, the Awoken Queen, the sad, strange little man on his rickety boat. They believe they've seen the same. What they don't know will destroy them." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见了一切的终末。玖，觉醒者女王，还有那个站在摇摇欲坠的飞船上悲伤而奇怪的小家伙。他们相信自己也看到了相同之事。他们的无知将引领他们走向灭亡。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: "Weyloran never rescinded an oath once granted." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “维洛然从不背弃誓言。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: The Disciple has no time for this.
flavorText.zh-CN: 门徒可没时间干这个。

description.en:
Equip this ornament to enhance the appearance of your Solstice armor with a Solar-aligned armor glow.

The effect shines brightest when equipped with a matching subclass.
description.zh-CN:
装备此皮肤，用烈日护甲炫彩强化您的至日护甲外观，使其发出烈日特性光芒。

装备对应的分支职业时，效果最为亮眼。

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: "Future War Cult has an artifact they call 'The Device' which may be Vex in origin." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “未来战争狂热者拥有一个被他们称为‘装置'的神器，它的原始形态模型可能是Vex。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

description.en: Complete tickets in Trials of the Nine during Season 2 to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在玖的试炼中完成入场券可解锁并装备此皮肤。

flavorText.en: "He was more wolf than Human, we used to say." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们过去常常说，他似狼胜似人。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: To warm our bodies in the chill of the night.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在霜降寒夜中，使我们的身体温暖。

flavorText.en: Dance like nobody's watching.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一种完全不在意别人的舞蹈。

flavorText.en: Step into the inferno.
flavorText.zh-CN: 步入炼狱。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: This one is a real looker.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这真是个尤物。

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Banshee-44.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：班西-44处获得升级包。

description.en: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.
description.zh-CN: 使用你的职业技能会将此武器的伤害类型更改为匹配你已装备超能的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

description.en: You are healed in a burst of mending [Solar] Solar Light.
description.zh-CN: 你在一束修复烈日光能中痊愈了。

flavorText.en: It's all for the sake of appearances.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这一切都是形式。

flavorText.en: “What was she? A creature of the Light? Or the other end of the spectrum? The Councilors never finished their analysis.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “她是什么？光能生物？还是光谱上的另一端？议员们永远不会终止分析。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: Strange treasures wash up on the Shore.
flavorText.zh-CN: 奇异的宝藏被冲刷上了海岸。

sourceString.en: Source: Eliminate all Barons on the Tangled Shore.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在纷争海岸消灭所有公爵。

description.en: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.
description.zh-CN: 射弹命中后产生范围效果爆炸。提高填装速度。

description.en:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine.

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine. Improves magazine size.
description.zh-CN:
处于增幅状态时，弹药会逐渐从备弹转移到弹匣中。

拥有速度加成时，弹药回复更快并会过量填充弹匣。提升弹匣容量。

flavorText.en: Forged in honor of Nirwen, and the righting of foolish wrongs.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为向讷温及其纠正谬误之功致敬而铸造。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.
description.zh-CN: 造成伤害会在短时间内赋予你更高的移动速度和空中效率。造成最后一击会提升这些效果。

flavorText.en: I wish to be indestructible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿金刚不坏。

flavorText.en: "Send a deep-space probe toward the anomaly. I want to know what it is." —Dr. Shanice Pell
flavorText.zh-CN: “向那个不规则物体发射一个深空探测器。我想知道它是什么。”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士

flavorText.en: "As birds are touched by a sudden and invisible instinct to fly to safer ground, so are we." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII
flavorText.zh-CN: “如同鸟儿被突然且无形的本能驱使而飞向安全地带，我们也一样。”——《启程记》，颂歌第七章

description.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Nessus.
description.zh-CN: 在涅索斯上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

name.zh-CN: 增强版涅索斯缓存箱探测器

flavorText.en: If they're close enough to see it start, then they'd better run.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如果他们近到看到它的开始，那最好赶紧跑路。

flavorText.en: The little shimmy is for extra intimidation.
flavorText.zh-CN: 小幅晃动是为了增加威慑力。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Graviton Lance. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变引力子长枪的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: THE DISTANT FIRE: Cabal dirge, age circa 1200 years, narrating the life of a spark from a forge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 远方之火：大约1200年前的卡巴尔挽歌曾描绘迸出熔炉的火花的一生。

description.en: Original manufacturer's magazine, with no modifications.
description.zh-CN: 原厂弹匣，未经过改装。

flavorText.en: "Have I the aspic in my lips?"
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的唇间是否有毒蛇？”

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

flavorText.en: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我可以向你展现我们最辉煌的时刻。你只需问，哦，我的学生啊。

flavorText.en: Spoken aboard the Malphas Contemptus and quickly hushed: "It was never so under the empress."
flavorText.zh-CN: 马尔法斯轻蔑号上曾有人说出却又很快消声的话：“在女帝的统治下从未这样。”

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Auric Disabler. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变金耀禁能者的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Crota's End" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.
description.zh-CN:
此模组特性仅在“克洛塔的末日”突袭中生效。

多个此模组可以叠加和强化其效果。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: Forget your UV protection.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别管你的紫外线防护了。

flavorText.en: "For those who seek not protection, but a closer connection to the universe." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了那些不追求精准，但追求与宇宙联系更紧密的人。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "For one who seeks centered moments in war." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了想在战争中寻求禅意的人。”——玖的使者

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Navigator. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变领航员的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills and it gains improved range, charge rate, and handling.
description.zh-CN: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得更多额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Something Something.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变巴拉巴拉的外观。

flavorText.en: "A curious mind is a violent thing—always at war with the unknown." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “好奇心本性凶残——总在同未知事物鏖战。”——先知

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变永恒战士的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: You move, unseen, through the field of battle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你悄无声息地穿梭于战场之间。

flavorText.en: "The Clipse worship guns. That's why Rull and I have an understanding. Even if he's not bright." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
flavorText.zh-CN: “克里普斯崇尚枪支。所以我可以和鲁尔达成共识，即使他不怎么聪明。”——颅骨刺穿者，法尔绰克

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：世界吞噬者，利维坦突袭巢穴。

description.en: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的近战攻击在武器装填有弹药的情况下可造成更高的伤害并让目标减速。

flavorText.en: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.
flavorText.zh-CN: 领主萨拉丁让战死的爱国同胞的回忆留存了下来。

flavorText.en: By our works we are remembered.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们就活在自己的著述之中。

flavorText.en: They'll see you from space.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们可以从太空中看到你。

flavorText.en: You sprint nimble. Untouchable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你灵活奔跑，无法触及。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成全盛智谋比赛并提高你的排名等级。

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变突进（巴洛克）的外观。解锁皮肤后，此皮肤将能供你帐户中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: You stand ready. Immovable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你稳扎稳打，不可动摇。

Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: "Some things in the universe are unknowable. What matters is that they're destructible." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “宇宙中有些东西是不可知的。重要的是，它们是可以被摧毁的。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许那不是正确的选择，但却是合理的选择。”——亚斯明·埃尔德

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Choir of One. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变单人合唱的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: An Earth artifact, refashioned to suit the Emperor's modest tastes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件地球古物，经过翻新以迎合大帝的高雅品味。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the Menagerie aboard the Leviathan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 由利维坦上的奇珍异兽园获得。

flavorText.en: "Visualization was unexpectedly drawn toward images suggestive of the past. Experiment terminated at lead investigator's frantic demand." —RECORD 457-CHASM-7002
flavorText.zh-CN: “视野中意外出现了暗示过去的景象。实验在主要研究者的疯狂要求下终止了。”——记录457-裂谷-7002

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从拉克希米-2处获得升级包。

flavorText.zh-CN: “黑暗之中，光则更闪耀；光闪耀之处，也定存阴影。”——乌兰-坦

flavorText.en: The molten remains of a Cabal magma launcher barrel still sing with the Solar Light that ended its fire. The heavens open at your command, and from them rains vengeful flame.
flavorText.zh-CN: 融化的卡巴尔岩浆发射器炮管，仍然蕴含着破坏它的烈日光能之力。天堂等待你一声令下，降下复仇之火。

flavorText.en: A radiant cinder, still crackling as you hold it. With it, you could set the world aflame.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一块余温尚存的余烬，握着它还在噼啪作响。有了它，你可以点燃整个世界。

flavorText.en: A singed tome, bound in leather with notes scratched in the margins. You hold immeasurable knowledge of the approaching dawn.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一本用皮革装订，页边空白处划有记号的烧焦巨著。你对即将到来的黎明有着无穷的了解。

flavorText.en: A golden feather, drifting in the wind. One gust carries you where you need to go.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一根在风中飘动的金色羽毛。一阵风就能把你带到该去的地方。

flavorText.en: When the City fell, humanity went into exile. Except the Hunters. They went home.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当圣城陷落，人类便踏上流亡之路。猎人却不同。他们回家了。

description.en: Lift and rise with renewed strength.
description.zh-CN: 用新的力量一跃而起。

flavorText.en: Far from home I bear this pale flame. Far from my birth I walk this burning road.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我远离家园，背负这团苍白之火。从诞生的那一天起，我便走上这条燃烧之路。

flavorText.en: Spicy! So spicy!
flavorText.zh-CN: 好辣！真的好辣！

flavorText.en: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许那不是正确的选择，但却是合理的选择。”——亚斯明·埃尔德

flavorText.en: "Do I miss my arm? I miss my empire. I would give everything to have it back. And I will." —Valus Nohr
flavorText.zh-CN: “我想念我的手臂吗？我想念的是我的帝国。我本该为了夺回它付出一切。我现在依然愿意。”——军政官诺阿

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

flavorText.en: Where you stand, they will fall.
flavorText.zh-CN: 所到之处，万般皆殒。

flavorText.en: "Humanity can only rely upon itself in these dire times." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “在这种悲惨的时代，人类唯一能依靠的只有自己。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "There is no warrior fiercer than one shielding hatchlings from harm."  —Eliksni proverb
flavorText.zh-CN: “保护幼崽不受伤害的战士是最勇猛的。”  ——埃里克斯尼族谚语

flavorText.en: "Due respect, Commander? I was there when the Hive found us on Earth. I was there when we stopped them on Titan. And I'll be there when we wipe them out." —Sloane
flavorText.zh-CN: “指挥官，应有的尊重？当邪魔族在地球上找到我们的时候我在那里。当我们在土卫六上阻止他们的时候我在那里。当我们彻底摧毁他们的时候，我也会在那里。”——斯隆

description.en:
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw your Praxic Blade, which will seek out multiple targets. Attacking recalls the Blade while it is in flight.
[Heavy Attack]  : Hold to perform a more powerful throw, sending the Blade on a straight path in the direction of your aim. Releasing the button recalls the Blade.
description.zh-CN:
[重攻击]：投掷你的英勇利刃，它会追踪多个目标。在飞行途中进行攻击可召回英勇利刃。
[重攻击]：按住可进行更强力的投掷，英勇利刃会沿直线朝你的瞄准方向飞去。松开按钮即可召回英勇利刃。

flavorText.en: Tend the gardens of your heart.
flavorText.zh-CN: 照料你的内心花园。

flavorText.zh-CN: 亿万年以来，诸神和宇宙智慧，破坏者和强大的帝国，他们都不断地前来考验我们。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我遇到的每个民族都只有一个暗影。但光能如此之多，我的时间又如此之少……”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是相互关联的。我承认这一点，尽管我不愿与少数…有些…很多人共享超因果联系。”——奥斯里斯

flavorText.zh-CN: “已经无处可逃了。”——艾莎，人类猎人

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: There was life, and He spoke unto it; and it was silent, and lived no more.
flavorText.zh-CN: 曾有生命，祂对其有言；然其沉默不语，不复再生。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

description.en: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.
description.zh-CN: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。

flavorText.en: "Mercy has no place in the Crucible. Going easy does no one any favors." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “熔炉竞技场中没有仁慈可言。手下留情于对任何人都毫无益处。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: "The hurricane will overtake you. It's inevitable. Take stability where you can get it." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “飓风会追上你，其势难违；在可以稳住自己的地方不要松手。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

description.en: Complete challenges in strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It's unlocked for all Crucible armor sets.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间完成打击挑战以获得此皮肤。所有熔炉竞技场护甲套装均可解锁此皮肤。

flavorText.en: Death by a murder.
flavorText.zh-CN: 烦死人的乌鸦群。

description.en: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药会装填一枚可粘附于各种表面的高爆弹药，命中后不久引发更强力的爆炸并施加疲惫。

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

flavorText.en: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无路可循时，就开辟出自己的道路。

flavorText.en: Head to head.
flavorText.zh-CN: 头碰头。

flavorText.en: He was claimed by the Vault. His armor and myth are all that remain.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他死在保险库中，只留下了他的护甲和传说。

description.en: Deliver this frozen delicacy to Variks on Europa.
description.zh-CN: 给木卫二的瓦里克斯送去这冰封的佳肴。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 已发现的食谱

description.en: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.
description.zh-CN: 精准最后一击会在目标附近生成一块冰影水晶。

flavorText.en: Cling to this world, oh departed friend, that its wonders will never slip your grasp.
flavorText.zh-CN: 远行的挚友啊，请将牵挂系于这个世界，它的奇观将永存你的指尖。

flavorText.en: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.
flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

flavorText.en: "To gain power, you must sacrifice. Exos have known this long before the Guardians' rise."  —Taeko-3
flavorText.zh-CN: “想获得力量，就必须有所牺牲。早在守护者的崛起之前，Exo就已经明白这一点了。”  ——妙子3号

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: "Jumpship logs indicate she visited Venus, the Moon, the Reef, and several locations on Earth. Her last position before surrendering herself was Mars." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
flavorText.zh-CN: “飞船日志显示她去过金星、月球、暗礁和地球上的几个地方。她投降前的最后所在位置是火星。”——《先锋安全报告》节选

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.
description.zh-CN: 刀剑格挡拥有较低综合防御，但充能效率增加。

flavorText.en: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “祝贺你找到为其拼搏一生的真正职业。你是一名……合格的助手。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: Who said disco was dead?
flavorText.zh-CN: 谁说迪斯科过时了？

flavorText.en: "Some friendships, even death itself cannot sunder." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些友谊，连死亡都无法使其破裂。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson
flavorText.zh-CN: “调整航向两度。朋友们，距离开普勒-186还有很长一段路。我们没有时间游览涅索斯。”——马苏德·雅各布森船长

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: A Titan without a discipline is like a computer without programs.
flavorText.zh-CN: 缺少纪律的泰坦如同缺少程序的计算机。

description.en: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.
description.zh-CN: 这个模组已经被弃用，失去了功能。你可以用另一个模组进行替换。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 弃用的护甲模组

flavorText.en: "Sometimes the difference between survival and eradication is just pure, simple stubbornness." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “有时候，生与死之间只差一股简单纯粹的犟劲。”——浪客

description.en: Final blows and precision hits build up Dynamic Charge. Swapping to Arc Seeker mode increases damage and partially reloads the magazine based on the number of charges. Charged Arc Seeker hits grant, and can spend, Bolt Charge.
description.zh-CN: 最后一击和精准命中会积累动态充能。切换至电弧追踪弹模式时，根据充能数量增加伤害并填装部分弹匣。充能电弧追踪弹命中可获得和消耗电光充能。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Folded Root. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变折叠根源的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Braaaaaaiiiiiins…
flavorText.zh-CN: 脑脑脑浆浆…

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: This is the shape and the point of the tooth: nothing has ever lived that will not die.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是一个不争的事实：有生之物固有一死。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “你身上最宝贵的器官就是你的大脑。用这块特制的碳纤维头饰来保护它的安全吧。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

flavorText.en: "Life's all about timing. You gotta know when to pull the trigger, when to go in for the kiss, and—most of all—when to make for the exit." —Cayde-6
flavorText.zh-CN: “人生在于时机的选择。你应当知道何时该扣动扳机，何时该主动上前亲吻，还有——最重要的是——何时该转身离开。”——凯德6号

flavorText.en: Skinned in the membranes of the Hezen Vex. There is very little risk they will become permanently attached to your body.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从光芒Vex上剥离的表膜。它有小几率会永久附着在你的身体上。

flavorText.en: "Remember, the universe is a chaotic system. This frippery won't protect you from the continuum." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住，宇宙是一个混乱不堪的系统。这件无用之物不能保你渡过四生百劫。”——阿什·米尔

description.en:
Something went wrong when equipping your loadout, and the mod you had saved in this socket could not be inserted.

It is safe to select any other mod for this socket.
description.zh-CN:
装备你的配置时出现了错误，你在此插槽中已保存的模组无法插入。

为稳妥起见请选择其他模组。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.
flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

flavorText.en: Let them rally. You will shatter their courage to fight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们集结吧，你将粉碎他们战斗的勇气。

flavorText.en: Let them rally. You will shatter their courage to fight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们集结吧，你将粉碎他们战斗的勇气。

flavorText.en: Let them rally. You will shatter their courage to fight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们集结吧，你将粉碎他们战斗的勇气。

flavorText.en: "You will face cutlass and cannon fire… nothing you need fear." —Mithrax
flavorText.zh-CN: “你会面对弯刀和炮火…都没什么好怕的。”——米瑟拉克斯

flavorText.en: "Let them have the Great Machine. They deserve it." —Mithrax, trans. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “就让他们拥有那伟大的机器吧，他们应得的。”——米瑟拉克斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

description.en:
Maximized stats.

Applies additional stats to this weapon equal to the weapon's tier.
description.zh-CN:
最高属性。

为此武器应用等同于武器阶级的额外属性。

flavorText.en: "Remember why we fight." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住我们为何而战。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "Ultra-light ion-shielding keeps you protected AND mobile in a radiated, rapidly changing climate." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “超轻离子屏蔽层能在具有高度辐射性的多变气候中为你提供防护和足够的机动性。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

description.en:
One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher with remote detonation. 
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
description.zh-CN:
具备远程引爆功能的单发手持式榴弹发射器。
[射击] ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: "Let us describe the art of mapping a dream. First, all former dreams must be crushed. This makes the ink with which we draw." —The Book of Departures, Canto III
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们来形容一下描绘梦境的艺术。首先，所有曾经的梦境都必须先被粉碎。破碎的梦境就是我们的颜料。”——《启程记》，颂歌第三章

flavorText.en: It's OK, I'm fine. Everything is fine…
flavorText.zh-CN: 没关系，我很好。一切都很好……

flavorText.en: Most helmets protect the mind from the universe. Not this one.
flavorText.zh-CN: 大多数头盔保护思想不受宇宙的影响，但这个头盔不同。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Though we fight horrors beyond the walls, never forget your opponents here are your brothers and sisters." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的敌人是墙外的恐怖力量，别忘了你在这里的对手都是你的兄弟姐妹。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Complete runs through the European Aerial Zone, land precision final blows, and defeat Hive combatants.
flavorText.zh-CN: 通关欧洲空中区，造成精准最后一击，以及消灭邪魔族士兵。

flavorText.en: "A forge represents limitless opportunity." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “锻炉代表着无限的机遇。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: These worlds have need for your might. Stand strong.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这些世界需要你的力量。坚定你的信念。

flavorText.en: Dance like everyone's watching.
flavorText.zh-CN: 像在大庭广众之下般舞蹈。

flavorText.en: "It's not about protecting our battlements; it's about protecting what's inside them." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “重点不是保护我们的城垛，而是保护里面的人民。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "His influence doesn't end at his Fourth Tomb. I will find the rest… by any means necessary." —Nessa, Acolyte of Nezarec
flavorText.zh-CN: “他的影响不止于第四古墓。我会想尽办法…找到其余所有的。”——内萨，奈扎雷克的仆从

flavorText.en: Alone, unending, peerless.
flavorText.zh-CN: 独行无终，举世无双。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Bygones. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变故人往事的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Final blows or rapid hits with this weapon's frontal blades heal you and provide Soulfire Charges, which cause rounds fired by this weapon to inflict potent corruption. These frontal blades deal increased damage to targets afflicted by corruption.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器的前端利刃造成最后一击或快速命中会治疗你并提供魂火充能，使此武器射出的子弹对目标施加强效腐化。前端利刃能对被腐化的目标造成更高伤害。

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: Pardon me. Coming through.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不好意思。借过一下。

description.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains a greater amount of stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.
description.zh-CN: 脱离战斗一定时间后，此武器的稳定性、填装速度和操控性获得更多提升。这些加成会在你重新进入战斗后逐渐衰减。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en: Missing 2 shots returns a bullet to the magazine after a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 射偏2发子弹会在短时间后将1发子弹返回弹匣。

flavorText.en: Above the cloud with its shadow is the star with its light.
flavorText.zh-CN: 投下影子的云层之上是熠熠生辉的星辰。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.
description.zh-CN: 此武器升级为大师杰作后将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Complete challenges in strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV arms armor.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在打击中完成挑战可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV手臂护甲上解锁。

flavorText.en: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - III
flavorText.zh-CN: 奈扎雷克的仆从：科拉西斯 - III

flavorText.en: "That last flare burned my engines out. Holliday's mad at me." —Ariadne Gris
flavorText.zh-CN: “那最后一次耀斑烧毁了我的引擎。哈利迪气疯了。”——阿里阿德涅·格里斯

flavorText.en: "For you as much as it is for them. They seek to observe your absolute force." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了你，也为了他们。他们想要膜拜你的绝对力量。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "A signifier of force." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “力量的意义。”——玖的使者

description.en: Capable of healing allies and hurting foes. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and bestows restoration to your allies.
description.zh-CN: 能够治疗盟友和伤害对手。对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并为盟友提供恢复。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en:
"Dance! In public, in private… that does not matter so much. Find a beat and let yourself move to it, ah?" —Eva Levante
Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“舞动起来吧！在外面，在家里……都可以。跟着节奏律动吧，好吗？”——伊娃·莱万特
在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Revelry event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在狂欢季节活动中获得。

flavorText.en: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相就像日出，孩子。它很漂亮，适合用来写诗，但到最后，它根本不在乎你会不会被灼伤。”——帕里斯·肖，隐秘者调查员

flavorText.en: "He bore it well." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “他使得不错。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Skinned in the membranes of the Hezen Vex. There is very little risk they will become permanently attached to your body.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从光芒Vex上剥离的表膜。它有小几率会永久附着在你的身体上。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: How has it come to this?
flavorText.zh-CN: 怎么会沦落至此呢？

flavorText.en: When a Warlock wears this helmet, it's bigger on the inside than it is on the outside.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当术士带上这件头盔，就会觉得头盔里面的世界比外面的世界要大得多。

description.en: An engram with a Gear Tiered weapon. Gear Tier depends on reward score.
description.zh-CN: 一块包含一件带有装备阶级武器的记忆水晶。装备阶级取决于奖励得分。

flavorText.en: Requiem-45: SUROS invites you to honor the dead.
flavorText.zh-CN: 安魂曲-45：SUROS邀你缅怀逝者。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Mars.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在火星上获得升级包。

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: I reach for nothing. I am subdued. I shall remain useless.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我别无所求。我闷闷不乐。我毫无用处。

description.en: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Getaway Artist.
description.zh-CN: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变逃逸艺术家的外观。

flavorText.en: I'm busy right now, OK?
flavorText.zh-CN: 我现在很忙，好吗？

flavorText.en: They look to you for inspiration. Be brave.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们希望从你身上得到启示。勇者无畏。

flavorText.en: "Multiple analyses confirm: the milky radiolarian fluid found in Vex chassis is organic in nature." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “多次分析确认的结果：在Vex机体中发现的乳白色放射液体实质上是有机的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: "Five Lights. Too many to fight. I loosed web grenades and fled." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
flavorText.zh-CN: “五个光能者。人太多了我打不过。我扔下网格手雷就跑了。”——恶犬公爵，赛克里斯

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：世界吞噬者，利维坦突袭巢穴。

flavorText.en:
A charnel but effulgent orb—beacon in a loathsome dark—
Fêted, fetid corpses rise—a too-long-absent gibbous spark.
flavorText.zh-CN:
可怖但耀眼的光球——可憎黑暗之中的信标——
腐尸复生——一丝消逝已久现将再现的火花。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。

flavorText.en:
They sowed the First, now reap the Last; forever narrows to a line
Where Light will fade into the past—when all's converted, nothing shines.
flavorText.zh-CN:
前世的因，承担现世的果，造就来世的景
当光消逝于过往，当一切斗转星移，再无闪烁之物。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。

flavorText.en: The tune is the same, but the aim couldn't be more different.
flavorText.zh-CN: 调子没变，但是目标非常不同。

sourceString.en: Source: Flawless Chest in Trials of Osiris
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼中的无瑕宝箱

flavorText.en: "We're notifying fireteam members and life partners as we identify the Ghost remains. It's going to take a while."  —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们在确认机灵遗体身份的同时，正在通知火力战队成员和生活伴侣。这需要一段时间。”——《先锋安全报告》节选

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: Missing a shot has an improved chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
description.zh-CN: 子弹未命中时有更高几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

flavorText.en: Has this wealth found you or have you found it?
flavorText.zh-CN: 是财富找到了你还是你找到了财富？

flavorText.en: "Look after the people. The Traveler can take care of itself… I hope." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “照顾好民众。旅行者可以照顾好自己…我希望如此。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

flavorText.en: Warlocks should refrain from "hilariously" vaporizing friends until Ghosts can prove they've regained their full strength.
flavorText.zh-CN: 术士们应该克制自己不将朋友“滑稽地”蒸发殆尽，直到机灵证明他们完全恢复力量。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the victories that your wisdom shall win in my name. Over and over." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你的智慧将以我之名赢得胜利。一次又一次。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: "Some know the legend. We were forged in the fires of a burning world." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些人知道这则传说：我们是在一个熊熊燃烧的世界中历练出来的。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.
description.zh-CN: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。

flavorText.en: "You've sunk enough time into circles. Consider the enduring legacy of the pyramid." —Osiris to Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “你已经浪费了够多的时间，想想金字塔的恒久遗产吧。”——奥斯里斯致艾可拉·蕾伊

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

Apply this weapon mod to add a celebratory visual effect when defeating combatants.

此模组仅适用于5阶武器。

flavorText.en: "Warrior-scholars. Reality breakers. Weapons of mass destruction. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “智勇双全的学者、现实破坏者还有大规模杀伤性武器。你的部族将成为出色的暗影。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: Rumor has it that the exile Osiris came too close to understanding the Vex.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有传言说，放逐者奥斯里斯对于Vex的理解有些太深了…

flavorText.en: Hope burns brightest among broken things.
flavorText.zh-CN: 破碎之物中能燃起最猛烈的希望之火。

flavorText.en: The mind is malleable, filled with transient and fleeting ideas. Let us shape it, so that you may see the infinite splendor of the universe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 思想可以拓展，充满了稍纵即逝的想法。让我们为它塑形，这样你就能看见宇宙的无穷壮丽。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: Everyone is summoned to dance!
flavorText.zh-CN: 所有人都被召来跳舞！

flavorText.en: Embrace the chaos, for you are entropy incarnate.
flavorText.zh-CN: 拥抱混沌吧，因为你就是无序的化身。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

flavorText.en: "Efrideet walks her own path." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “艾弗里迪特走出了自己的道路。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: An Earth artifact, refashioned to suit the Emperor's modest tastes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件地球古物，经过翻新以迎合大帝的高雅品味。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the Menagerie aboard the Leviathan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 由利维坦上的奇珍异兽园获得。

flavorText.en: "There is an end to everything." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “万物都有终结。”——玖的使者

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Stand before us, that you may be judged." —Unknown
flavorText.zh-CN: “站到我们面前，你才知自己如何。”——无名氏

flavorText.en: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “念虽有畏，心无所愧。其若冰清，天塌而不惊。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: Let them run. You will hunt them where they hide.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们逃走吧，你将找到他们的藏身之处。

flavorText.en: If there is no road, then it cannot be long.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无路可走，又何谈漫长。

description.en: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.
description.zh-CN: 高伤害，充能时间适中。进行一次水平齐射。

flavorText.en: You know that you will fight forever.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你深知自己将永无止境地战斗。

description.en: This weapon is Full Auto, does extra damage to Cabal, and penetrates Phalanx shields.
description.zh-CN: 全自动武器，可对卡巴尔造成额外伤害，可穿透方阵士兵护盾。

description.en: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.
description.zh-CN: 多次同时造成最后一击会积累可叠加的伤害增益。持续时间更长的计时器在下次武器射击时开始；造成最后一击会延长此计时器。

flavorText.en: Look now, with sullen eyes, to those long lost worlds no one has ever walked.
flavorText.zh-CN: 用那对布满哀愁的双目，远眺那些失落已久的蛮荒世界。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.en: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson
flavorText.zh-CN: “调整航向两度。朋友们，距离开普勒-186还有很长一段路。我们没有时间游览涅索斯。”——马苏德·雅各布森船长

flavorText.en: It never starts out scary.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从不以惊悚开篇。

flavorText.en: "Lost things have a way of washing up on the Tangled Shore." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “遗失之物终会被冲上纷争海岸。”——蛛王

description.zh-CN: 使用极星长枪击败战斗人员以解锁此升级。

flavorText.en: "The shining halls of peace have been torn down and turned into the battered plate of war."
flavorText.zh-CN: “充满光辉的和平殿堂被摧垮，变成了硝烟弥漫的战场。”

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: "You know what velocity refractors are? Me neither, but the manual says this baby's got six of 'em!" —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “你知道什么是速度折射镜吗？我也不知道，不过说明书上说这东西包含了六个那玩意儿！”——浪客

flavorText.en: "It is our burden to bear. It never gets easier. But we must carry it." —Zavala

description.en: Destroying a Tangle spawns Threadlings.
description.zh-CN: 摧毁缠结会生成线虫。

description.en: Gain an additional melee charge.
description.zh-CN: 获得额外一次近战充能。

description.en: Your Rift provides damage reduction to allies standing in it.
description.zh-CN: 你的裂痕为在裂痕内的盟友提供伤害减免。

description.en: Grenades recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy.
description.zh-CN: 手雷会从赋能武器伤害中充能，且赋能武器最后一击可提供更多能量。

description.en: Temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
description.zh-CN: 超能结束后，暂时获得大幅提升的近战和手雷回复。

description.en: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves.
description.zh-CN: 裂痕定期释放电弧冲击波。

description.en: Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.
description.zh-CN: 使用近战对目标造成伤害会施加强效腐化。击败腐化的目标会扩散此状态。

description.en: Your grenades recharge quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
description.zh-CN: 你的手雷命中时充能更快。急冻手雷产生的追踪弹移动得更远。

description.en: Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element grant you Super energy.
description.zh-CN: 使用伤害类型与你的超能元素匹配的武器造成最后一击，会为你提供超能能量。

description.en: Casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
description.zh-CN: 施放一个强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

description.en:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
description.zh-CN:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重弹道攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

description.en: Deals improved bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
description.zh-CN: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成更多额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

description.en: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Hellas Basin.
description.zh-CN: 有机会在赫拉斯盆地中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

description.en:
This battery simultaneously exists in multiple timelines, causing the weapon to Overcharge.

  •  Greatly increases magazine size
description.zh-CN:
此电池同时存在于多条时间线，致使武器过充。

  •  大幅增大弹匣容量

flavorText.en: Our sweat, our sacrifice, our responsibility.
flavorText.zh-CN: 吾辈之汗水，吾辈之牺牲，吾辈之使命。

description.en: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
description.zh-CN: 当你装备冰影超能时，快速冰影最后一击会提供冰霜护甲。你获得冰霜护甲时回复少量生命值。将你的职业技能替换成冰影能量爆发，它会冻结附近战斗人员，减速附近对手，并为你提供更强的冰霜护甲。

flavorText.en: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经学会不以畏惧为耻；既知身为何人，亦在意料之中。”——帕维尔·诺格

flavorText.en: Feel free to offer it for bandages and tourniquets.
flavorText.zh-CN: 随时可以用它来做绷带和止血带。

flavorText.en: The double-headed phoenix that fights itself represents Guardians who strengthen each other in the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 互相争斗的双头凤凰代表着熔炉竞技场中彼此砥砺的守护者们。

flavorText.en: – Wrapped in purpose and wreathed in meaning the old life withers away –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 被意图包裹，被意义环绕，旧日生活渐消散 –

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Mercury-A. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变水星-A的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "If this is a test, we shall not fail." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果这是场考验，那我们绝不会失败。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: The eyes which bear down upon you from a place you cannot see. Strike your enemies before they see you coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从你看不见的隐秘之处向你不断逼近的双眼。在敌人发现你之前发动打击。

flavorText.en: The wiles of a seasoned interlocutor; dodge any unwanted affronts and slip by unseen.
flavorText.zh-CN: 言谈老到之人的花招诡计；避开任何不必要的冒犯，遁形于无迹。

flavorText.en: The boast which sucks the air from the room. Let your enemies know your might before you take them down.
flavorText.zh-CN: 自我吹嘘，惊艳全场。让敌人在你把他们打趴下前知道你的能耐。

flavorText.en: A roughly hewn hatchet, covered in dirt and moss. A remnant that does not boast of killing, but attests to survival.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一把沾满了泥土和苔藓的粗糙斧头。这把残斧并不是在炫耀杀戮，而是生存的证明。

description.en: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.
description.zh-CN: 被包围时，提高偃月的填装速度和近战伤害。偃月近战最后一击会在弹匣中溢装一发子弹。偃月射弹最后一击会引起爆炸。

flavorText.en: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
flavorText.zh-CN: “唤醒之物再难沉眠。”——灵巫卡丽

flavorText.en: Can't outrun the ending.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无法摆脱结局。

flavorText.zh-CN: “黑暗逼迫邪魔族和傀儡为其牺牲，对其敬奉。旅行者让我们生存。”——术士阿诺尔·玛哈

flavorText.en: The cutting edge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 削铁如泥。

flavorText.en: Spread your wings and don your sapphire mail.
flavorText.zh-CN: 展翼翅，披碧裳。

flavorText.en: "Get back in there. I want to see action! I want to see motes popping out of bodies! I want blood!" —Blue
flavorText.zh-CN: “回去继续打！我要看到战斗！我要看到萤光乱飙！我要见血！”——布鲁

description.zh-CN: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

flavorText.en: "Sometimes it's a cosmic event. Sometimes it's a beast from hell. Sometimes it's one man." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “时而是寰宇大典，时而是地狱凶兽，间或区区一人。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "I stopped counting the Armageddons." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经不再憧憬末世决战。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们也许最终要在涅索斯停下了。我们的右舷引擎报废了。”——薰·佐伊科娃总工程师

flavorText.en: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn

flavorText.en: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The silence borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “以我对未来的了解，以及你所看到和做过的一切……它所承载的静默……到了一切的终末，还有什么能阻止我们呢？”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: There is much to ponder…
flavorText.zh-CN: 有很多事情需要考虑…

flavorText.en: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
flavorText.zh-CN: “星光吾母，黑暗吾父。”——玛拉·索维女王

flavorText.en: "One day we too will meet our final deaths. How do you want to be remembered?" —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “总有一天我们也会死去。你想让人们记住怎样的你？”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "Move quickly. The world never waits." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “动作要快。世界不等人。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: A small carved effigy of a Pouka, found in the Neomuna wreckage. With clarity of mind, you stride between this world and the next.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在内欧姆那残骸中发现的一尊普卡小雕像。带着清晰的思路，你在这个世界和另一个世界之间迈步穿梭。

flavorText.en: Your call weaves a path into existence. A chirp rings out, eager to answer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的召唤编织出了一条道路。一声鸣叫响起，渴望着回应。

flavorText.en: Formless, shapeless… until you say otherwise. Shape reality as you see fit.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无形，无状…直到你令其改变。任凭你塑造现实。

flavorText.en: A ring of twisted silver, set with a glittering emerald. Deftly, expertly, effortlessly—one possibility is unsewn and another is born.
flavorText.zh-CN: 弯曲的银戒指上镶嵌着一颗闪亮的绿宝石。在一种可能性解开的瞬间，另一种可能性随即诞生。可谓是巧夺天工，浑然天成。

flavorText.en: Don't let them see you sweat.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别让他们看见你流汗。

flavorText.en: "The nights are long and cold. We must take care of each other." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “夜晚漫长而寒冷。我们必须照应彼此。”——泰拉·卡恩

description.en: Improved recovery.
description.zh-CN: 更强的恢复力。

flavorText.en: All your rivals will see are your contrails in the distance.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的对手只能看见你在远处留下的尾迹。

flavorText.en: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “最后，梦境之幕，这样你方可以己之目，洞察梦魇。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "Many followed him when he left—if not with their feet, then with their hearts." —Fractal Scrolls
flavorText.zh-CN: “许多人在他离开时都跟随其后——有些人身随其行，而有的人则心随其后。”——破碎的卷轴

flavorText.en: "…and after that, there will be time for questions."

flavorText.zh-CN: “军政官诺阿带着几千人杀到我们的首都。我们顽强抵抗了数周。但军政官毕竟是军政官。她击溃了我们。”——卡佳·克里普斯之枪鲁尔

在上行震荡波发生后立即进行后续攻击，会发射一次主动搜寻目标的制导打击。

flavorText.en: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 德弗里姆·卡伊让守护者护甲套装的款式更新潮。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages in the EDZ.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

description.en: Aspects modify your subclass with new actions for your Guardian to bring to combat.
description.zh-CN: 星相会为你的守护者的分支职业提供新的动作以带入战斗之中。

flavorText.en: Leave a mark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 留下痕迹。

description.en: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
description.zh-CN: 在幽梦之城中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

name.zh-CN: 增强版幽梦之城缓存箱探测器

flavorText.en: "We've progressed into a liminal space. Corridors folding on each other. Psychometer is spiking here; are we sure this is safe?" —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 2nd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们进入到了一处阈限空间。廊道相互折叠。心理测试仪在这里达到了峰值；我们确定这样安全吗？”——隐秘者心像空间探险第2次通讯

flavorText.en: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果我在王座上被击败，那我便会死去。我的伟业将终结。”

description.en: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Weapons stat.
description.zh-CN: 以牺牲少量武器属性为代价，提升此护甲的调整属性。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 一般护甲模组

flavorText.en: I remember saying I was bored of the view from the Tower. I wish I'd shut my mouth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我记得说过厌倦了在高塔上看到的风景。我希望能让自己闭嘴。

flavorText.en: To unearth mysteries long forgotten.
flavorText.zh-CN: 揭开早已被遗忘的谜团。

flavorText.en: "They don't make Dark Age tech like this anymore. Lucky for you I kept all mine." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们不再制造这样的黑暗纪元科技了。你真幸运，我都留着呢。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete the "Breakneck" quest from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成来自浪客的“极速快感”任务。

flavorText.en: All that power just jumps out of your hands. Hold on tight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 那么大的能量就这样从你手中发射出来。握紧了。

sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: A familiar tool in the face of failure.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在面对失败时的一件熟悉的工具。

flavorText.en: "And Ghosts? I don't think they really understand what we are. Light is pretty hard to simulate. Paracausality and all that." —Sagira
flavorText.zh-CN: “而机灵们呢？我觉得它们无法真正理解我们是谁。要模拟光能相当困难。超因果等等等等。”——萨吉拉

flavorText.en: "The mysteries of the universe lie before you. Unresolved. Threatening. You and I will face them together. As true Cabal." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “宇宙的奥秘就在你的面前。悬而未决。极具威胁。你我将共同面对它们。以真正的卡巴尔之姿。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: “The Ace-Defiant burned his mind to fly my golden ship. Being a Loyalist costs you. Being a Shadow costs dearly.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “那个王牌猎手一定是丧失了心智才会驾驶我的黄金飞船。忠于王室的代价高昂。身为暗影的代价更甚。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: You don't realize that I'm all around you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你无法发现，我就在你身边。

description.en: Grants slightly increased ammo generation.
description.zh-CN: 小幅提升弹药生成速度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化武器模组

flavorText.en: "Persevere, or die in darkness. The choice is yours." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “坚持不懈，或在黑暗中殒命。由你选择。”——玖的使者

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "The athenaeum worlds lie before you. Everything from the Empire of old that was—and has been lost. You and I will rediscover them together. As true Cabal." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “宝藏世界就在你的眼前。旧帝国的一切——曾经失去的一切。你我会共同将它们发掘出来。作为真正的卡巴尔。”——卡鲁斯大帝

sourceString.en: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

flavorText.en: Always keep one up your sleeve.
flavorText.zh-CN: 永远要藏一手。

flavorText.en: The double-headed phoenix that fights itself represents Guardians who strengthen each other in the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 互相争斗的双头凤凰代表着熔炉竞技场中彼此砥砺的守护者们。

flavorText.en: Nobody's hands will be clean in the end.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最终，没有人的双手是干净的。

flavorText.en: We celebrate those who brought us here, whether or not they yet stand around the bonfire with us.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂带我们来到这里的人，无论他们是否还在篝火旁陪伴我们。

flavorText.zh-CN: “你将行前人未行之路，请谨小慎微。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: The hotter you burn, the stronger you become.

flavorText.zh-CN: 它们不是人偶！而是玩具人！

flavorText.zh-CN: “我见过守护者消灭怪物，击溃大军。但悲痛是一种决然不同的敌人。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.zh-CN: “现实的刀刃可将世界点燃。我们都要谨慎对待我们的目标。”——术士阿诺尔·玛哈

flavorText.zh-CN: “体温过低在木卫二是非常严重的威胁，而保存身体的热量则是对抗这种症状的关键。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

flavorText.en: "We have a duty to this solar system that goes deeper than blood, deeper than oaths." —Paladin Devi Cassl
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们对这个太阳系的使命，比血缘更深入，比誓言更坚定。”——圣骑士戴维·卡瑟尔

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。

flavorText.zh-CN: “她是什么？光能生物？还是光谱上的另一端？议员们永远不会终止分析。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.
flavorText.zh-CN: 领主萨拉丁让战死的爱国同胞的回忆留存了下来。

description.en: Fusion Grenades gain increased throw speed, explode on impact, and stun Unstoppable Champions. Final blows with Fusion Grenades grant grenade energy.
description.zh-CN: 融合手雷投掷速度提高，命中时发生爆炸，并可眩晕势不可挡勇士。融合手雷造成最后一击会提供手雷能量。

description.en: Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.
description.zh-CN: 使用近战攻击或终结技击败目标会提供不断增加的近战伤害，但此加成会随着时间衰减。更高等级的燃烧之拳会提供更高的武器伤害。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Tractor Cannon. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.

flavorText.en: When have you ever known Hunters to do as they were told?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你见过受命令约束的猎人吗？

flavorText.zh-CN: Exo梦见：冰封的尸骸。尸骸像陨星那样落下。充满恐慌、狂热和堕入迷睡的世界。

flavorText.en: "Time is called; we win. I win. One more round, just one more round."
flavorText.zh-CN: “时间已到，我们赢了。我赢了。再来一局，就一局。”

flavorText.en: "Better alone than in unwanted company." —Jjenr, Husk
flavorText.zh-CN: “孤独，胜过不想要的陪伴。”——躯壳，杰恩尔

description.en: Defeat combatants with Worldline Zero.

flavorText.en: Are you the immovable force, or the unstoppable object?

flavorText.zh-CN: “人类需要保护。黑色军械库能给他们保护。”——H·拉斯穆森

flavorText.zh-CN: 这副护臂比旅行者之光要有用多了。

flavorText.en: What is quicker than the light, if not the dark?

flavorText.en: Where we stop, nobody knows.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们在哪里停下，没人知道。

flavorText.en: Complete playlist strikes, collect Solar orbs in Gambit, and unlock Solstice Packages.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成打击列表，在智谋中收集灼烧光球，以及解锁至日包裹。

description.en: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
description.zh-CN: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

description.en: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
description.zh-CN: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

flavorText.en: The most challenging opponent of all.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最具挑战性的对手。

flavorText.en: Grip the universe. Reshape it. Disregard the screams.
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧握宇宙，将其重塑。无视那些尖叫声。

flavorText.en: Vanguard policy still urges Guardians to destroy this weapon on sight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 先锋政策依然敦促守护者一看到这种武器就将其摧毁。

flavorText.en: "Get back in there. I want to see action! I want to see motes popping out of bodies! I want blood!" —Blue
flavorText.zh-CN: “回去继续打！我要看到战斗！我要看到萤光乱飙！我要见血！”——布鲁

在上行震荡波发生后立即进行后续攻击，会发射一次主动搜寻目标的制导打击。

flavorText.zh-CN: “一个被称为先知的人却难得说出一句有用的话来，你不觉得奇怪吗？”——信徒警句

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: We celebrate those who brought us here, whether or not they yet stand around the bonfire with us.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂带我们来到这里的人，无论他们是否还在篝火旁陪伴我们。

flavorText.en: Good Night!
flavorText.zh-CN: 晚安！

description.en: Smooth shotgun barrel. Greatly increases range at the cost of more projectile spread.
description.zh-CN: 平滑型霰弹枪枪管。大幅度提高射程，但会增大弹头散布范围。

flavorText.en: Didn't you see the glasses? Your argument is irrelevant.
flavorText.zh-CN: 没看到眼镜吗？你说什么都没用的。

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

description.en:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to challenging enemies and trigger health regeneration on precision kills. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest. Choosing this upgrade will lock the selected perks on the mask.
description.zh-CN:
此面具可通过升级提高对高阶敌人的伤害，且精准击杀会触发生命值回复效果。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。选择此升级将锁定面具上的所选特性。

description.en:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to enemies and provide near-invulnerability while airborne. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest. Choosing this upgrade will lock the selected perks on the mask.
description.zh-CN:
此面具可通过升级提高对敌人的伤害，且在空中时会处于近乎无敌状态。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。选择此升级将锁定面具上的所选特性。

description.en:
This mask can be upgraded to increase damage to Terrors and grant grenade and melee energy on precision kills. Unlock these upgrades by defeating Terrors in the Haunted Forest.

These perks are active only inside the Haunted Forest. Choosing this upgrade will lock the selected perks on the mask.
description.zh-CN:
此面具可通过升级提高对恐魔的伤害，且精准击杀会获得手雷和近战能量。在鬼蜮森林中消灭恐魔来解锁这些升级。

这些特性只能在鬼蜮森林中激活。选择此升级将锁定面具上的所选特性。

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

flavorText.en: Keeping our greatest minds safe and warm.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让我们最伟大的思想享受安全与温暖。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 手臂护甲模组

sourceString.zh-CN: 需要守护者等级6：商人挑战

flavorText.en: Knowledge is a responsibility.
flavorText.zh-CN: 知识乃责任。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of MIDA Multi-Tool. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变米达多功能的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Complete Lost Sectors off Earth while pledged to Dead Orbit to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Anti-Extinction Grasps, Gauntlets, and Gloves.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间完成在地球外的遗失区域可获得此皮肤。于抵殇护手、臂铠和手套上解锁。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Black Talon. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变黑色利爪的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: Don't let them change you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别让他们改变你。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete Glory Rank playlist activities, Nightfall strikes, or matches in Trials of Osiris.
- Collect Arc Elemental Orbs in the European Aerial Zone activity.
- Defeat powerful Hive.
flavorText.zh-CN:
至日英雄2021期间：
-完成荣耀等级游戏列表活动、日落打击或奥斯里斯试炼中的比赛。
-在欧洲空中区活动中收集电弧元素能量球。
-消灭强力邪魔族。

flavorText.en: Complete Legendary or Master Lost Sectors to enable this armor's white glow.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成传说或大师遗失区域来开启此护甲的白色荧光。

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

flavorText.en: "I walk without hesitation toward my destiny." —Shayura, Awoken Warlock
flavorText.zh-CN: “我毫不犹豫地走向自己的宿命。”——沙玉拉，觉醒者术士

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: Tomorrow we'll hear ourselves again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 明日我们将再次听见自己的声音。

sourceString.en: Source: Season of the Wish Activities

description.en: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
description.zh-CN: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

description.en: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
description.zh-CN: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强劲的方向控制升到空中。

description.en: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
description.zh-CN: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并凭借强大的初始爆发动量升到空中。

description.en: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot.
description.zh-CN: 元素最后一击会提升此武器的下一击伤害。

flavorText.en: "The Light was once what separated us from our enemies." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “光能曾是划分敌我的泾渭。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

description.en:
No perk currently selected.

More perks become available as the weapon level increases.
description.zh-CN:
当前未选择特性。

随着武器等级的提升，可用的特性也会越来越多。

flavorText.en: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “念虽有畏，心无所愧。其若冰清，天塌而不惊。”——埃里斯·摩恩

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

description.en: This weapon fires a Harvester Spike projectile. Dealing final blows with this weapon creates a single Vestige at the target's location. Impaling more powerful combatants with the projectile creates a steady stream of Vestiges from the target.
description.zh-CN: 此武器发射收割者尖刺射弹。使用此武器造成最后一击会在目标位置产生一个残余。使用射弹刺穿更强大的战斗人员可以使目标产生一波残余。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: It breaks the rules of reality as ruthlessly as it shatters your foes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 它能像击碎你的对手那般无情破坏现实规则。

description.en: Maximized stats.
description.zh-CN: 最高属性。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: The lord of the city grants the blessing of precision.
flavorText.zh-CN: 城主赐予精准的祝福。

flavorText.en:
Two siblings cleaved by time and space, reflections never found alone,
The ending of the eldritch race—a path long seen but never known.
flavorText.zh-CN:
被时间和空间分开的双生子，永不孤单的倒影，
怪异种族的结局——早被预见却不为理解的道路。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。

flavorText.en: Nyah!
flavorText.zh-CN: 喵呜！

flavorText.en: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson
flavorText.zh-CN: “调整航向两度。朋友们，距离开普勒-186还有很长一段路。我们没有时间游览涅索斯。”——马苏德·雅各布森船长

flavorText.en: "We will make a new home out among the stars, and then we will know peace. Until that day..." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们将在恒星间建立新的家园，那时，我们将拥抱和平。直到那天……”——蛛族杰尔拉

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从蛛族杰尔拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

description.en: Equip this ornament with Ophidian Aspect to activate a unique visual effect.
description.zh-CN: 为毒蛇面貌装备此皮肤来激活独特的视觉效果。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: The quickening beat is in step with your wanderer's stride.
flavorText.zh-CN: 频仍的悸动与游子的脚步交相辉映。

flavorText.en: As that forgotten Age lost its golden sheen, they stood defiant against the coming end. —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"
flavorText.zh-CN: 当遗忘的时代失去其光辉时，他们却冷眼傲视即将降临的结局。——《至尊卫士历史》节选

description.en:
One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher with remote detonation. 
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
description.zh-CN:
具备远程引爆功能的单发手持式榴弹发射器。
[射击] ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

flavorText.en: We all get closer every day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们每天都在靠近。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。
