description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Skull of Dire Ahamkara. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变阿罕卡拉之颅的外观。当你解锁一个皮肤后，你账户中的所有角色都将获得解锁。

name.en: The Want of Lies and Wishes

flavorText.en: Give me your arm, oh bearer mine. Let me help you fill the world with teeth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你借我双臂，我给你双翼。容我助你让这个世界利齿满盈。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在至日期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of One Thousand Voices. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变千语的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Original manufacturer's grip, with no modifications.
description.zh-CN: 原厂握把，未经过改装。

flavorText.en: You put the "snicker" in "snicker-snack."
flavorText.zh-CN: 你用“窃笑”炒出一盘“窃笑小吃”。

flavorText.en: Complete Gambit matches, collect Elemental Orbs using a matching [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] subclass, and defeat enemy combatants with Void grenades.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成智谋比赛；使用匹配 /  / 的分支职业收集元素光球；使用虚空手雷消灭敌方士兵。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Dead Messenger. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变死亡信使的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: There is a knife for you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有一把利刃给你。

description.en: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
description.zh-CN: 在幽梦之城中探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

flavorText.en: "Think of all the old mysteries that are now ours to solve anew!" —Timur, learning of SIVA
flavorText.zh-CN: “思索现在属于我们的所有古老秘密，重新解开它们！”——帖木儿，湿婆研究

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Multiple analyses confirm: the milky radiolarian fluid found in Vex chassis is organic in nature." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “多次分析确认的结果：在Vex机体中发现的乳白色放射液体实质上是有机的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: "I haven't forgotten the vows I took. I still have the bow." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我没有忘记曾经立下的誓言。那把弓我还留着。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：熔炉竞技场中的荣耀比赛

flavorText.en: "Send a deep-space probe toward the anomaly. I want to know what it is." —Dr. Shanice Pell
flavorText.zh-CN: “向那个不规则物体发射一个深空探测器。我想知道它是什么。”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士

flavorText.en: "Perun and Gheleon are so serious. Never yet seen a target I couldn't hit. What've I to worry about? " —Efrideet, before the Ironsbane
flavorText.zh-CN: “佩纶和盖里恩可不算儿戏。还没见过我打不中的目标。我还有什么可担心的？”——艾弗里迪特，钢铁灾星前留字

flavorText.en: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——

flavorText.en: "We called her Ashraven for her flight, and the ruin she left in her wake." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们称她为灰烬渡鸦，因其飞行之姿，以及留下的毁灭。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "I see a submerged Earth. I see humanity in crude boats, battered, drifting. I see them fight what rises from the deeps. Fight and win." —RECORD 463-CHASM-3102
flavorText.zh-CN: “我看到了一个被淹没的地球。我看到了简陋船只上的人性，随着破碎的船只漂流。我看到了他们和地球深处涌出的生物的战斗。战斗，和随之而来的胜利。”——记录463-裂谷-3102

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从拉克希米-2处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Have you ever considered that the Traveler might be just as chaotic and arbitrary as everything else?" —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “你是否想过，也许旅行者同其他一切事物一样，毫无秩序，飘忽不定呢？”——阿什·米尔

description.en: Fires a powerful short-range burst of Solar damage.
description.zh-CN: 发射一次威力强大的近距离冲击，造成烈日伤害。

flavorText.en: When the Last City was just a patchwork of campfires, the Iron Lords stood guard.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当最后的城市只闪烁着点点营火时，钢铁领主便已在守卫着她了。

description.en: No mod currently selected.
description.zh-CN: 当前未选择模组。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 一般护甲模组

description.en: Increases Tripmine Grenade duration and blast radius. Ability damage grants Tripmine Grenade energy.
description.zh-CN: 延长感应手雷的持续时间和爆炸范围。技能伤害可提高感应手雷的能量。

description.en: Increases Sidearm airborne effectiveness, ready speed, and reload speed. While you're critically wounded, swapping to a Sidearm reloads it and increases its damage. While this effect is active, Sidearm final blows reload the weapon and extend the effect's duration.
description.zh-CN: 提高手枪的空中效率、举枪速度和填装速度。身受重伤时切换至手枪可立即填装并提高其伤害。当此效果生效时，手枪最后一击会填装武器并延长效果的持续时间。

flavorText.en: “All ground gives way.” —Unknown Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “每片土地都有惊喜。”——无名泰坦

description.en: This weapon fires small auto-tracking rockets. Rockets lock onto targets when aimed.
description.zh-CN: 可发射自动追踪的小型火箭。瞄准目标时，火箭会自动锁定目标。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: Haunt the paths yet tread, that your wake may guide those brave enough to follow.
flavorText.zh-CN: 笼罩未涉之途，汝之寒彻乃勇者之信标。

description.en: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage and an improved amount of reload speed and handling until the wielder's death.
description.zh-CN: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予武器伤害，以及更多的填装速度和操控性，直到使用者死亡。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en: If knowledge is the coin that buys tomorrow, seek it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如果知识是通往明天的筹码，就该去探寻它。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: A new kind of Guardian is born.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一种新的守护者诞生了。

flavorText.en: "I've seen Guardians slay monsters and level armies. But grief is an enemy of a very different sort." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我见过守护者消灭怪物，击溃大军。但悲痛是一种决然不同的敌人。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: Tex Mechanica custom-made mark, warning vagabonds that you mean business.
flavorText.zh-CN: 特克斯机械定制印记，警告那些闲汉你说到做到。

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一副末世既临之容，一双厄土天赐之眼；观其形貌，便知逃无生天。”——浪客

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变渎职的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这件守护者护甲是用黑色移民号船员的套装改造而成的。

flavorText.en: An Earth artifact, refashioned to suit the Emperor's modest tastes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件地球古物，经过翻新以迎合大帝的高雅品味。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the Menagerie aboard the Leviathan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 由利维坦上的奇珍异兽园获得。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the Menagerie aboard the Leviathan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 由利维坦上的奇珍异兽园获得。

flavorText.en: Guardians don't need to ignite their Light to shine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 即便未点燃光能，守护者也将闪耀。

description.en: Deliver this timeless classic to the Exo Stranger on Europa.
description.zh-CN: 给木卫二的Exo陌客送去这份永不过时的经典。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 未被发现的食谱

flavorText.en: …always lead to new places.
flavorText.zh-CN: ……总是通向全新的境界。

description.en: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
description.zh-CN: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: A single word etched inside the barrel: "Sylvie-1."
flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“希尔薇-1”

flavorText.en: "Petra Venj, I formally request that you take the Queenship." —Paladin Leona Bryl
flavorText.zh-CN: “佩特拉·万吉，我郑重请求您登上女王之位。”——圣骑士蕾欧娜·布蕾尔

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

description.en: Fires a Solar trace beam that creates a field of heat energy that grows as the weapon is fired. Sustained damage applies scorch to the target.
description.zh-CN: 发射一束烈日追踪光束，产生的热量场会随着武器的发射而增长。持续伤害对目标施加灼烧效果。

flavorText.en: Can't wait to have a slice!
flavorText.zh-CN: 等不及想吃一块！

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: – Let your mind be split into the many facets of thought it so craves to embody –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 让你的意识按其所愿，分裂成多重思维面 –

description.en: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器多次造成最后一击可为使用者提供吞食效果。

flavorText.en: "Is it always this violent? And, Guardian, this is important—will anyone be selling hot dogs in the stands?" —Lodi
flavorText.zh-CN: “这里一直都是这么暴力吗？还有，守护者，这很重要——会有人摆摊卖热狗吗？”——洛迪

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "Don't you find it strange that the one called the Speaker rarely has anything useful to say?" —Sayings of the Disciples
flavorText.zh-CN: “一个被称为先知的人却难得说出一句有用的话来，你不觉得奇怪吗？”——信徒警句

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: A shattered bond marks a broken promise.
flavorText.zh-CN: 破碎的臂环代表一个破碎的承诺。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Felwinter's Lie. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器装饰品以改变“邪冬的谎言”的外观。当你拥有此皮肤后，你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁该皮肤。

description.en: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
description.zh-CN: 精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

description.en: No mod currently selected.
description.zh-CN: 当前未选择模组。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 腿部护甲模组

sourceString.zh-CN: 需要已塑形或已强化武器

flavorText.en: “Calus could not heal our air. My planet is still dying. But as long as I serve, I have hope.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
flavorText.zh-CN: “卡鲁斯无法治愈我们的大气。我的星球依旧濒临灭亡。不过只要我为他效劳，就还有希望。”——卡佳·克里普斯之枪，鲁尔

flavorText.en: A gift for the Titan with Ghaul's strength.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赠予如同盖欧一般强壮的泰坦的礼物。

flavorText.en: Loot chests in the European Aerial Zone, complete Solstice bounties, and defeat combatants in the European Aerial Zone while equipped with an Arc subclass.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在欧洲空中区洗掠宝箱，完成至日悬赏，以及装备电弧分支职业在欧洲空中区消灭战斗人员。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

description.en:
Equip this ornament to enhance the appearance of your Solstice armor with an Arc-aligned armor glow.

The effect shines brightest when equipped with a matching subclass.
description.zh-CN:
装备此皮肤，用电弧护甲炫彩强化您的至日护甲外观，使其发出电弧特性光芒。

装备对应的分支职业时，效果最为亮眼。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 腿部护甲炫彩

flavorText.en: "Hey, if it works for computers…" —Marcus Ren
flavorText.zh-CN: “嘿，如果在计算机上能用的话……”——马库斯·伦

flavorText.en: Complete playlist strikes, collect Elemental Orbs of any type in any activity, and defeat opposing Guardians in the Crucible or Gambit.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成打击列表，在任意活动中收集任意类型的元素光球，以及在熔炉竞技场或智谋中击败对方守护者。

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from the Vault of Glass.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从玻璃拱顶中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

flavorText.en: "I never forgot what I saw—the gift the Great Machine could bestow. And Calus promised me more." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
flavorText.zh-CN: “我永远无法忘记我看到了什么——那是伟大机器赐予的礼物。卡鲁斯许诺我会给我更多。”——恶犬公爵，赛克里斯

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：世界吞噬者，利维坦突袭巢穴。

description.en: Increases public event rewards.
description.zh-CN: 提高公共事件的奖励。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更有格调。

flavorText.en: "Logic says we must accept it. Emotion says we will never truly accept it." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “逻辑上我们必须接受，感情上我们永远无法真正承受。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: "Osiris said that he started to pity the Red Legion, getting trapped in here for infinite eternities. I think they're getting exactly what they deserve." —Sagira
flavorText.zh-CN: “奥斯里斯说他开始为猩红军团感到抱歉了，被困在这无尽之中。而我觉得他们真的是活该。”——萨吉拉

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: I am a shield unto myself.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是自己的护盾。

flavorText.en: I wish to be indestructible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿金刚不坏。

flavorText.en: Ensign of untarnished principle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 谨守还未失去光华的准则。

description.en:
Equip this ornament to enhance the appearance of your Solstice armor with an Arc-aligned armor glow.

The effect shines brightest when equipped with a matching subclass.
description.zh-CN:
装备此皮肤，用电弧护甲炫彩强化您的至日护甲外观，使其发出电弧特性光芒。

装备对应的分支职业时，效果最为亮眼。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 胸部护甲炫彩

flavorText.en: "The Traveler is an illusion. A false god. It will not save us. But this might." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者是幻想。一个虚假的神。它无法拯救我们。但这个也许可以。”——蛛族杰尔拉

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: The light of the will of Crota shines down like a vast and inverse sun.
flavorText.zh-CN: 克洛塔的意志之光照耀下来，就像一个被反转的巨大太阳一样。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: "Home is where the Hand Cannon is." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “手炮在哪里，家就在哪里。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: Complete patrols on Io, collect Elemental Orbs of any type in the European Aerial Zone, and defeat enemy combatants with Solar weapons.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在木卫一完成巡逻任务；在欧洲空中区收集任意类型的元素光球；使用烈日武器消灭初级首领。

flavorText.en: Turn your hunger outward, never inward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 把你的饥渴之情对外发泄，不要对内。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete this weapon's associated Vanguard quest.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成与此武器相关的先锋任务。

flavorText.en: "Multiple analyses confirm: the milky radiolarian fluid found in Vex chassis is organic in nature." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “多次分析确认的结果：在Vex机体中发现的乳白色放射液体实质上是有机的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

description.en:
You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

While airborne, [Air Dodge] : Charge your jetpack.

On release, activate your jetpack with a forceful blast of exhausting Arc energy then fly forward a short distance based on the amount charged. Collide with a combatant to unleash a blinding blast of energy and gain a temporary bonus to your melee stat.
description.zh-CN:
你获得空中移动喷气背包。武器和电弧充能近战最后一击可积累喷气背包燃料。

在空中时，[空中闪身] ：为喷气背包充能。

松开时，以强劲的排放电弧能量爆发启动喷气背包，然后根据充能量向前飞行一小段距离。与战斗人员碰撞会释放致盲能量爆破，并暂时提升你的近战属性。

flavorText.en: "Found a hallway, full of statues of Calus in various states of dissection. Sobbing noise coming from the walls."  —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 3rd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “发现一个走廊，里面摆满了处在不同解剖状态下的卡鲁斯雕像。墙上传来呜咽的声音。”——隐秘者心像空间探险第3次通讯

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 腿部护甲模组

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

description.en:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed
description.zh-CN:
额外能量储备。
  • 大幅提高护盾持续时间
  •  降低填装速度

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: "Hey. You see Cayde around, tell him his gun's ready." —Banshee-44
flavorText.zh-CN: “嗨，如果你遇到凯德，告诉他他的枪好了。”——班西-44

sourceString.en: Source: Complete the "Loaded Question" quest from Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成来自萨瓦拉的任务“既定观点问题”。

flavorText.en: You're too kind! …But say it again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你太好了！…但请再说一遍。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Arbalest. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变劲弩的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Hard-hitting four-burst fire.
description.zh-CN: 四发强力冲击射击。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: For the Warlock possessed of Ghaul's wisdom.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赠予如同盖欧一般智慧的术士的礼物。

flavorText.en: “The Fulminator could directly afflict the nervous system of the organics around her. She was pain in all its shades. I will miss her.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “轰鸣者可以直接折磨她周围有机物的神经系统。她就是一切形态的痛苦。我会想念她的。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “我用自己编写的代码给这件护甲编写了程序！如果你挂了，那是你的错。与我无关。”——智能失效保险

flavorText.en: "If you think this world ends well, you are mistaken." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果你觉得这个世界死得其所，那你就错了。”——蛛族杰尔拉

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从蛛族杰尔拉处获得升级包。

description.en:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
description.zh-CN:
经优化大幅提高射击控制的枪管。
  •  可一定程度上控制后坐方向
  •  提高稳定性
  •  提高操控速度
  •  略微提高弹头速度

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化发射器枪管

flavorText.en: "The human condition pushes us. Moves us. We fight because we love. We die because we love." —H. Meyrin
flavorText.zh-CN: “人类的情况逼迫着我们。使我们不得不行动起来。我们战斗是因为我们有爱。我们死去也是因为我们有爱。”——H·梅兰

sourceString.en: Source: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在“往日之苦”突袭中获得。

description.en: Hard-hitting twin-fire rounds.
description.zh-CN: 强硬的双发弹头。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: I am the end of 'morrows.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是明日的终结者。

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变毁灭雕像的外观。当你解锁一个皮肤后，你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: Forged from the cores of Hezen Vex. If you feel a sense of revelation, remove immediately and inject antientheogens.
flavorText.zh-CN: 利用光芒Vex的核心锻造出的物品。如果你有一种豁然开朗的感觉，立即将它脱下并注射抗熵剂。

flavorText.en: Sprinting toward danger.
flavorText.zh-CN: 冲向危险。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: Wait for it… now!
flavorText.zh-CN: 等待时机…就是现在！

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of No Turning Back. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变后无退路的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "It's new to me." —Banshee-44
flavorText.zh-CN: “这对我来说很新奇。”——班西-44

description.en: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Cuirass of the Falling Star. Once you acquire an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变陨星胸甲的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Before, you wouldn't have been caught dead with a tattered cloak. But that was before.
flavorText.zh-CN: 否则，他人便会发现你那遮掩在残破斗篷下的尸体。但那都是以前的事了。

flavorText.en: To undertake vile means to carve a greater end.
flavorText.zh-CN: 欲达宏图，不择手段。

flavorText.en: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的伟业便是死亡，并活在那死亡之中。”

flavorText.en: Get ready for the blizzard. Any minute now…
flavorText.zh-CN: 准备好迎接暴风雪吧。它随时可能会到来…

description.en: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标获取速度。

flavorText.en: "I never forgot what I saw—the gift the Great Machine could bestow. And Calus promised me more." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
flavorText.zh-CN: “我永远无法忘记我看到了什么——那是伟大机器赐予的礼物。卡鲁斯许诺我会给我更多。”——恶犬公爵，赛克里斯

flavorText.en: Cut your way through the darkest forests.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从最黑暗的森林中砍出一条路来吧。

flavorText.en: "Prepare for your arctic adventure with the very best in Bray outfitting!" —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “用最优秀的布瑞科技服饰为你的极地冒险做好准备吧！”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

flavorText.en: Then came the experts of the technology, the eu-techs.
flavorText.zh-CN: 后来，有了精通该科技的专家，巫灵技师。

description.en: Defeat Cabal Psions while pledged to New Monarchy.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠新王派期间击败卡巴尔辅助士兵。

flavorText.en: When it shines at dusk, luck will surely come your way.
flavorText.zh-CN: 它在黄昏闪耀时，幸运必将降临于你。

description.en: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of weapon stability.
description.zh-CN: 以牺牲武器稳定性为代价，大幅提升武器的射程。

description.en: Heat can burn as much as it warms.
description.zh-CN: 热量既可焚毁一切，亦可温暖身心。

description.en: Renewal can begin with just a spark.
description.zh-CN: 星星之火，亦可重生。

description.en: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging temporarily increases this benefit, reloads your equipped weapon from reserves, grants improved movement speed, and increases your class ability stat.
description.zh-CN: 进行闪身可填装所有武器，并在一小段时间内提高移动和武器操控速度。

description.en: Quick successive attacks with Arc Staff increase its damage output, duration and jolt targets hit.
description.zh-CN: 使用电弧法杖快速连续攻击可提高伤害输出，延长持续时间，并震颤击中的目标。

description.en: Arcbolt Grenades have increased chaining capabilities and jolt targets hit. Damaging combatants with jolt or applying jolt to targets grants additional Arcbolt Grenade energy.
description.zh-CN: 电光手雷的连锁能力提升，震颤击中的目标。通过震颤伤害战斗人员或对目标施加震颤，可获得额外的电光手雷能量。

flavorText.en: "Our work is to defend life—and, we cannot forget, to live it. That means stop and smell the roses, Guardian." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的职责是守护生命——也别忘了，去好好生活。这意味着停下来闻闻玫瑰的香气，守护者。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.zh-CN: 用那对布满哀愁的双目，远眺那些失落已久的蛮荒世界。

flavorText.en: Get to higher ground.
flavorText.zh-CN: 占据高地。

flavorText.zh-CN: 你的双眼将看尽世间奇妙，你的思想会再造万亿奇观。

flavorText.en: "You have questions about the Light? The Crucible is the only answer you need." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “对光能存有疑问？熔炉竞技场是你唯一需要的答案。”——领主沙克斯

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.zh-CN: “‘无名泰坦'？不如说是“所有泰坦。每一个泰坦。'”——无名泰坦

description.en: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的每次最后一击都会造成一次更强的元素伤害爆炸。

flavorText.en: Radiance is veiled, lest it scorch the eyes of the beholder.
flavorText.zh-CN: 遮蔽万丈光芒，以免灼烧旁观者之眼。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.
description.zh-CN: 刀剑格挡拥有高持久和低抗性。

flavorText.en: 13.4 billion years ago, the first stars kindled out of darkness, seeding the future of all life.
flavorText.zh-CN: 134亿年前，第一批星辰在黑暗中被点燃，孕育着万物的未来。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更有格调。

flavorText.en: Home is just over the horizon.
flavorText.zh-CN: 家园已露端倪。

flavorText.en: …hides the sins of days forgotten and those yet to come.
flavorText.zh-CN: ……悄悄隐去被遗忘时代和未来新纪元的罪孽。

flavorText.en: "With steadfast pace and upright bearing, we and those who follow us shall prevail." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 9
flavorText.zh-CN: “有着稳健的步伐和如中流砥柱般的忍耐力，我们和那些追随我们的人终将获胜。”——执行者法则，卷9

description.en:
Bolts release an impulse shortly after impact that deals a small amount of damage and has a high chance to cause flinch.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
description.zh-CN:
弩弹在命中后不久释放冲击波，造成少量伤害并有高几率造成抖动。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

flavorText.en: Steadying the ground beneath for the climb to come.
flavorText.zh-CN: 稳住脚下，以迎接前方的高峰。

flavorText.en: "Perhaps we can take it back. You know? Perhaps the Farm can be another City." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “或许我们能将它夺回来。你知道吗，或许农庄可以成为另一个圣城。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: "Inflexibility is its own virtue." —Sloane
flavorText.zh-CN: “顽强不屈本身就是种美德。”——斯隆

flavorText.en: Symbiosis. Not predation. Never predation, o wary one mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 共生。无捕食。永远都不会捕食的，哦，我的怜惜者啊。

flavorText.en: The machines are not invincible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 机器并不是无敌的。

flavorText.en: In the cold of winter, we remember that the warm west wind will blow again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 尽管置身严冬，我们也记得那温暖的西风将再次吹来。

flavorText.en: We all get closer every day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们每天都在靠近。

flavorText.en: Focus not on the death, but on the rebirth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 将注意力集中在重生而非死亡之上。

flavorText.en: "No job too tough, if the price is good." —Renegade Corsair Errol Mayz
flavorText.zh-CN: “价美无难事。”——变节海盗军，埃洛尔·梅兹

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on the Tangled Shore.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在纷争海岸中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: To travel beyond the known horizon.
flavorText.zh-CN: 去往已知之地以外的地方吧。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 胸部护甲模组

flavorText.en: Complete bounties, collect Void orbs in any strike, and defeat enemy combatants with Solar melee attacks.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成悬赏；在任意打击中收集虚空光球；使用烈日近战击杀敌方士兵。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我死过许多次，但那些死都只是暂时的。”

description.en: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害，且持续时间延长。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of the Recluse. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变隐士的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en:
"I'm here to save you." —Isidel Brandor
"Imitate! Observe! Comprehend!" —Unnamed inhabitant(s), Juno Chasma
flavorText.zh-CN:
“我是来拯救你的。”——伊丝黛尔·布兰德
“效仿！观察！理解！”——无名居者，朱诺深谷

description.en: Decrypts into a random event weapon, with a chance of rewarding a Holofoil weapon.
description.zh-CN: 解码为一件随机活动武器，有几率奖励一件全息箔武器。

description.en:
An Exotic catalyst can be inserted into this socket.

Check the Exotic catalysts section in Triumphs to learn where the catalyst can be obtained.
description.zh-CN:
可以将异域催化插入此插槽。

查看成就中的异域催化部分，了解在哪里可以获得催化。

flavorText.en: "What else can we do but take up arms?" —Corsair Amrita Vae
flavorText.zh-CN: “除了拿起武器外，我们还能做什么呢？”——海盗军阿姆丽塔·唯爱

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。

flavorText.en: Complete public events on Nessus, collect Void orbs in the Crucible or Gambit, and unlock Solstice Packages.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在涅索斯上完成公共事件，在熔炉竞技场或智谋中收集虚空光球，以及解锁至日包裹。

description.en: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume a portion of this weapon's reserves to over-pressurize it, causing it to dramatically Weaken targets for a short time. This effect's duration scales with the amount of ammo consumed and is paused while holstered.
description.zh-CN: [替换武器动作]：消耗此武器的部分弹药储备，使其压力过高，从而在短时间内大幅削弱目标。此效果的持续时间随消耗弹药量的增加而增加，武器收起时效果暂停。

flavorText.en: Yes, duty is a burden. Its weight keeps us from blowing away in the wind.
flavorText.zh-CN: 是的，责任是种负担。其重压让我们不会被风卷走。

description.en: Defeat Crucible opponents using SUROS Regime to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN: 使用SUROS政权击败熔炉竞技场对手以解锁此升级。

description.en: After three rapid light melee attacks, quickly [Heavy Attack]  to execute a heavy melee combo.
description.zh-CN: 在三次快速近战轻攻击后，迅速使用 [重攻击]  施展一次近战重攻击连击。

flavorText.en: "Fight forever, Guardians!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “战斗不息，守护者！”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: “The Sindu inhabited gas giants in the spinward marches. They refused my invitation at first. As with all things, they came to see things my way.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “信德在螺旋世界的气态巨行星上居住。起初他们拒绝了我的邀请。但和其他种族一样，他们随后意识到臣服才是唯一的出路。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: The next time we meet.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们再次相遇时。

flavorText.en: A picture's worth a thousand words.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一图胜千言。

flavorText.en: Go, my horde!
flavorText.zh-CN: 去吧，我的大军！

flavorText.en: "Europa has relit the fire in my soul; one that even its freezing winds cannot chill."  —Clovis Bray
flavorText.zh-CN: “木卫二重燃了我灵魂中的火焰，就连这里刺骨的寒风都无法将其冻结。”  ——克洛维斯·布瑞

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

description.en: After briefly sprinting, gain increased ammo generation. Alternatively, gain stability, reload speed, and flinch resistance when not sprinting for a short time.
description.zh-CN: 短暂冲刺后，获得提升的弹药生成。停止冲刺一小段时间后，改而获得稳定性、填装速度和抖动抗性。

flavorText.en: A Legionary packs thousands of slug rounds. A nimble Titan can survive every last one.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一支军团配备了成千上万发子弹。俊敏的泰坦可以穿过枪林弹雨而毫发无损。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: Get it off get it off get it off!
flavorText.zh-CN: 闪开闪开闪开！

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: A soldier's bond is eternal.
flavorText.zh-CN: 士兵的纽带是永恒的。

description.en: Complete the Gauntlet challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 完成铁拳厅挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

name.zh-CN: 禁卫军猎人腿部装饰品

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete a flawless Trials ticket.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成一次完美试炼入场券。

flavorText.en: Reach "Legend" Crucible Rank.
flavorText.zh-CN: 达到熔炉竞技场等级“传说”。

description.en: Reloading after a kill loads magazine with a few extra-damage bullets. Grants radar while aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 击杀后填装会加入一些具有额外伤害的弹药。瞄准时启动雷达。

flavorText.en: When you pick up strange new firearms every day, sturdy gloves are a must.
flavorText.zh-CN: 每天都有无数新奇武器攀上你的双手，一副结实的手套必不可少。

flavorText.en: Trust him.
flavorText.zh-CN: 信任他。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the apex of your slaying potential. Should you wish it, this system shall die—from the inside—and make way for what's coming. O champion mine." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你杀戮潜能的极限。只要你愿意，整个星系将会灭亡——从内部死去——为即将到来的一切让路，让我的勇士通行。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: Learning a new language isn't easy.
flavorText.zh-CN: 学习一门新语言并不容易。

flavorText.en: Before the fight, prepare. In the fight, improvise. After the fight? Exaggerate.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战斗之前，做好准备。战斗之中，临场发挥。战斗之后？肆意夸耀。

flavorText.en: Honor from glory. Pride from worth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 荣誉来自荣耀。高傲来自认可。

flavorText.en: "We bear the burden of protecting the Last City. And we bear it proudly." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们肩负着保护圣城的重任，并为此而自豪。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Thanks for the hot tip.
flavorText.zh-CN: 谢谢你的“箭”议。

flavorText.en: "The truth outlives us. You can put a bullet through my heart and win an argument, but it doesn't make your account any more or less honest." —Amrit Vo, Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相比我们更长命。你可以一枪射穿我的心脏来赢得争论，但你的说法不会因此变得更真或更假。”——阿姆里特·沃，泰坦

flavorText.en: I am the words that tell of the end.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是诉说终末的话语。

description.en: Hard-hitting twin-fire rounds.
description.zh-CN: 强硬的双发弹头。

description.zh-CN: 快速命中会将你的下一发子弹充能成高爆弹药，造成额外伤害并加速能量积累。强化后，每一发子弹都具有爆炸效果。

Maximized stats.

Applies additional stats to this weapon equal to the weapon's tier.
description.zh-CN:
最高属性。

为此武器应用等同于武器阶级的额外属性。

description.en: Fires self-propelled micro-missiles that explode on impact for high damage.
description.zh-CN: 发射自推进微型导弹。命中时会爆炸，造成高额伤害。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Ace of Spades. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变黑桃A的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: Running toward the fire.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赴火疾行。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: You hold the means to control worlds.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你掌握着控制世界的方法。

description.en: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.
description.zh-CN: 这个模组已经被弃用，失去了功能。你可以用另一个模组进行替换。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 弃用的护甲模组

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: Stained with years of combat.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有经年累月的战斗留下的痕迹。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: Prepare to back up your boasts.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有胆吹，就该有胆做。

flavorText.en: Make your enemy's strength your own.
flavorText.zh-CN: 将敌人的力量据为己有。

flavorText.en: What lies beyond the horizon?
flavorText.zh-CN: 地平线的尽头之外有什么？

flavorText.en: SUROS invites you to pick up the pace.
flavorText.zh-CN: SUROS邀你加快节奏。

description.en: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Mataiodoxía. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变虚荣自负的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: You can peck, but it will not yield.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你可以一点点啄食，但它不会屈服。

flavorText.en: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我可以向你展现我们最辉煌的时刻。你只需问，哦，我的学生啊。

description.en: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
description.zh-CN: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得一段时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

flavorText.en: When they have your back to the wall, when all seems lost—steel yourself! Command your future!
flavorText.zh-CN: 当敌人把你逼到无路可退、当一切似乎已成定局之时——要坚强地挺住！掌握自己的未来！

sourceString.en: Source: Complete this weapon's associated Crucible quest.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成与此武器相关的熔炉竞技场任务。

description.en: Maximized stats.
description.zh-CN: 最高属性。

description.en: Upgrade this armor to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this armor will forge a Masterwork, which provides a bonus to all stats.
description.zh-CN: 升级此护甲，使其能量上限提高1。完全升级此护甲至大师杰作可提供全属性加成。

flavorText.en: "It will take all the best that our best have to offer. The question hangs before us, ready for the grasping: who will claim the title?"  —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “这需要我们最好的战士倾尽全力。冠军虚位以待，问题就摆在我们面前：谁会摘得桂冠？”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: "They don't know about the Vex. They don't know they're being watched." —Isidel Brandor, to her Ghost
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们不了解Vex，也不知道自己正被监视。”——伊丝黛尔·布兰德对她的机灵说

description.en: Hits with projectiles decrease this weapon's charge time for a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用射弹命中会在短时间内缩短此武器的充能时间。

flavorText.en: Forged from the cores of Hezen Vex. If you feel a sense of revelation, remove immediately and inject antientheogens.
flavorText.zh-CN: 利用光芒Vex的核心锻造出的物品。如果你有一种豁然开朗的感觉，立即将它脱下并注射抗熵剂。

description.en: Equip this ornament with Shards of Galanor to activate a unique visual effect.
description.zh-CN: 用加拉诺碎片装备此皮肤配备来激活独特的视觉效果。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

description.en: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.
description.zh-CN: 精准最后一击会产生元素伤害爆炸，该爆炸会根据先前造成的快速精准命中次数造成额外伤害。

flavorText.en: The hotter you burn, the stronger you become.
flavorText.zh-CN: 烈焰越甚，汝力越强。

flavorText.en: "Don't think about it as improving yourself. Think about it as improving each other." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “别认为这是自我进步，而应看作共同进步。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 胸部护甲模组

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Wicked Implement. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变邪恶工具的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Let's make some noise.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们来搞点动静吧。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

description.en: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.
description.zh-CN: 此武器升级为大师杰作后将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: "I…was with them again."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我…又和他们在一起了。”

flavorText.en: On the green or in a round, come and gather to this sound.
flavorText.zh-CN: 繁弦奏渌水，难得相聚喜。

description.en:
This weapon has been shaped by the Relic in the Enclave on Mars.

Increase the weapon level by equipping and using this weapon in combat and activities. Higher levels unlock more components and perks to shape or reshape a weapon.
description.zh-CN:
这件武器由位于火星飞地中的圣物塑造成形。

通过在战斗和活动中装备并使用这件武器来提高武器等级。提升等级可以解锁更多的组件和特性，以塑造或重塑武器。

description.en: While pledged to Dead Orbit, complete the Sanctum of Bones Lost Sector in the Rupture on Io.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间，完成位于木卫一裂口中的骸骨圣地遗失区域。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “最后，梦境之幕，这样你方可以己之目，洞察梦魇。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: When in doubt, you use your head. Your headbutts are renowned.
flavorText.zh-CN: 犹疑不定时，就用你的脑袋。你的铁头功久负盛名。

flavorText.en: For the more Light the worms consume, the hungrier they become.
flavorText.zh-CN: 随着蠕虫吞噬的光能变多，他们也变得更饥饿。

flavorText.en: Beware!
flavorText.zh-CN: 当心！

description.en: Aspects modify your subclass with new actions for your Guardian to bring to combat.
description.zh-CN: 星相会为你的守护者的分支职业提供新的动作以带入战斗之中。

flavorText.en: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经学会不以畏惧为耻；既知身为何人，亦在意料之中。”——帕维尔·诺格

description.en:
Red-dot. Medium zoom. 
  •  Greatly increases range
description.zh-CN:
红点。中倍率变焦。
  •  大幅增加射程

description.en:

flavorText.en: "When the ship goes down, you can't save it. You just gotta choose: go under, or swim." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “沉船的时候，你救不了它。你只能选择：沉下去，或者游上来。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

description.en: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.
description.zh-CN: 使用这款武器瞄准可在短时间内减少抖动。

description.zh-CN: 造成伤害可提升填装速度与操控性。

description.zh-CN: 虚空火箭压制战斗人员。烈日火箭可造成灼烧。

description.en: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it. Handling is improved.
description.zh-CN: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

flavorText.en: Be astonished by my flawless precision and accuracy!

flavorText.zh-CN: 在这层防护衣之下，蕴藏着无穷的力量。

 —Aodh, Second Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker

"Have you ever stared into the green soulfire flame? There is terror, but also… something warm."
—Eris Morn

flavorText.zh-CN: 完成探险，在任意打击中收集电弧光球，以及完成熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛。

flavorText.en: "Today, young Guardians, you will learn how to run a Cabal naval blockade. Both ways." —Unknown
flavorText.zh-CN: “而今天，年轻的守护者，你将学习如何进行卡巴尔海上封锁。双管齐下。”——佚名

flavorText.en: Some Hunters will offer you hope. Others just know how to track fresh water.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有些猎人会给你希望。其他猎人只懂如何找到淡水。

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Ribbontail. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.

description.zh-CN: 闪身会立即填装你的所有武器并提升你和附近盟友的填装和操控性。此增益生效时，额外的闪身会提升增益强度并刷新计时器，5层时达到上限。造成持续伤害会提供职业技能能量。

flavorText.en: "I pushed the sun. I can push you, too." —Inscription inside the helm
flavorText.zh-CN: “我推动过太阳，也能推动你。”——头盔内的铭文

flavorText.en: "Even from the deck of a Ketch, your Light can shatter the stars." —Mithrax
flavorText.zh-CN: “就算你在一艘双桅船的甲板上，你的光能也能击碎星辰。”——米瑟拉克斯

flavorText.en: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是沐浴在同一光能下的独特气息。”——永劫教派

description.en: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.
description.zh-CN: 命中三个不同目标可提高伤害，持续时间延长。

description.en: Defeating targets grants stacks of Gun and Run for a longer duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this improves draw speed for longer.
description.zh-CN: 击败目标可在更长时间内获得边打边跑层数。短暂冲刺消耗一层效果并从储备弹药中部分填装此武器的弹匣。如为弓箭，则在更长时间内提升拉弓速度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en: Absolutely not.
flavorText.zh-CN: 绝对不行。

flavorText.en: The weak will be consumed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 弱者将被吞噬。

flavorText.en: "We are the last hope. We must be unbreakable. I demand nothing less." —Radegast, defying Segoth
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是最后的希望。我们必须变得坚不可摧。除此之外，我别无他求。”——反抗希格斯的拉德加斯特

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Well, you've looked better. But hey, you've looked worse.
flavorText.zh-CN: 哦，你之前的气色更好啊。嘿，你之前的气色更差呢。

flavorText.en: "Let the heat melt your body so your soul might flow with the river of time." —Parables of the Allspring
flavorText.zh-CN: “让热力融化你的身体，你的灵魂将会随着时间之河流淌。”——万春寓言

description.en: Reloading immediately after a kill grants a brief period of invisibility.
description.zh-CN: 完成击杀后立即填装可在短时间内隐身。

flavorText.en: "Best part of having been inside the Traveler? I've got an argument to win." —Peach the Ghost
flavorText.zh-CN: “进入旅行者的最大收获是什么？我找到了之前争论的答案。”——机灵桃子

flavorText.en: Shine bright to light the path ahead.
flavorText.zh-CN: 闪耀光芒，照亮前路。

flavorText.en:
"See here, everyone is laughing, joking. Does that not fill your heart with joy?" —Eva Levante
Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“看看这里，每个人都在嬉闹、开玩笑。你的心难道也没有充满欢乐吗？”——伊娃·莱万特
在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Revelry event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在狂欢季节活动中获得。

flavorText.en: Free finger hearts for everyone!
flavorText.zh-CN: 给所有人免费比心！

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

description.en:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed
description.zh-CN:
握把使用较轻质材料制作。
  •  提高操控速度

flavorText.en: When you have gone your farthest, you have not gone far enough.
flavorText.zh-CN: 尽管你走到了最远处，但走得还不够远。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Verglas Curve. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变雨淞弧线的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.
flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Thy duty is thy bond. Inspire the hopeless. Conquer eternity." —A tenet of the Iron Will
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的职责就是你的契约。激励那些失去希望的人吧。去征服永恒。”——钢铁意志教条

flavorText.en: It reflects whatever it sees, no matter how ugly.
flavorText.zh-CN: 它能反映出它所看到的一切，无论多么丑陋。

flavorText.en: Reach the combustion point.
flavorText.zh-CN: 抵达燃烧点。

flavorText.en: Don't worry, your secret is safe with me…
flavorText.zh-CN: 别担心，我不会透露你的秘密…

description.en: Defeat enemies in strikes with Super abilities during Season 3 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense cloak, Mark of Shelter, and Xenos Vale Bond.
description.zh-CN: 第3赛季期间在打击中使用超能消灭敌人可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、避难所印记和陌路溪谷IV臂环上解锁。

flavorText.en: "Temper your resolve like gunmetal, because you must become the true weapon." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “坚定你的决心，因为你必须成为真正的武器。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: Bare your blade.
flavorText.zh-CN: 亮出你的利刃。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：熔炉竞技场中的荣耀比赛

description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

name.zh-CN: 榴弹发射器弹药回收器

flavorText.en: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这副头盔可以把穿戴着它的人的头从肉体和/或外神经元的组合转化为纯粹的精神体。

flavorText.en: Heed counsel.
flavorText.zh-CN: 听从劝告。

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: “Okay, then… Let's fight.” —Unknown Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “好的，那么……开打吧。”——无名泰坦

flavorText.en: "Let their souls sing along." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “让他们的灵魂共同歌唱吧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "Her jumpship was full of dead Ghosts. Some of them were just pieces. We haven't determined how many dead, yet." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
flavorText.zh-CN: “她的飞船上全是死去的机灵。有些只剩下碎片。我们尚未确定有多少机灵死亡。”——《先锋安全报告》节选

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "To know the universe, you must first know yourself." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “要理解宇宙，必须先理解自己。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: The true test of a Titan's worth is how she endures defeat.
flavorText.zh-CN: 对泰坦自我价值的真正考验便是她如何面对失败。

flavorText.en: Choose what you will become next.
flavorText.zh-CN: 选择你接下来要成为什么样的人。

flavorText.en: "With steadfast pace and upright bearing, we and those who follow us shall prevail." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 9
flavorText.zh-CN: “有着稳健的步伐和如中流砥柱般的忍耐力，我们和那些追随我们的人终将获胜。”——执行者法则，卷9

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：执行者秀夫处获得升级包。

flavorText.en:
Teach self-belief.

Each piece of event armor enhances the Good Moods effect during the 2019 Revelry.
flavorText.zh-CN:
教导自我信仰。

在2019年狂欢期间，装备的每一件活动护甲都将加强好心情的效果。

flavorText.en: "I can't believe what I'm seeing!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “眼前这一切真是令人难以置信！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: II - You are held.
flavorText.zh-CN: II - 你被紧握了。

flavorText.en: These arms will never tremble.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这些手臂将永远不会颤抖。

flavorText.en: Satiate wisdom, and be unleashed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 智慧餍足，方得解放。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: When traveling far from the City, one must be prepared for all conditions and enemies.
flavorText.zh-CN: 远离圣城踏上旅途，你必须准备好应付所有状况和敌人。

description.en: Chance to receive an additional Simulation Seed when one is collected on Mercury.
description.zh-CN: 在水星上收集到一颗模拟种子时，有机会获得额外一颗。

flavorText.en: "It's what gets left out, what gets reemphasized that you have to pay attention to." —Esila, daughter of Sila
flavorText.zh-CN: “你需要留意的是何处未被揭露，何处被反复强调。”——茜拉的女儿，艾希拉

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

description.en: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.
description.zh-CN: 更多弹药储备。弹匣打空时可略微提高填装速度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: "All endings are beginnings."
flavorText.zh-CN: “所有终局亦是开始。”

flavorText.en: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道你怎么想的，但我越来越喜欢欧洲无人区了。真的，到处都是苔藓。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相就像日出，孩子。它很漂亮，适合用来写诗，但到最后，它根本不在乎你会不会被灼伤。”——帕里斯·肖，隐秘者调查员

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Hazardous Propulsion. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变危险推力的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

description.en:
This item applies an orange glow to all Solstice arms armor. Once you unlock it, it's available for all three classes.

This elemental armor glow shines brightest when your subclass element matches.
description.zh-CN:
此物品会为所有至日手臂护甲提供一个橙色炫彩效果。所有三个职业都将获得解锁的物品。

当分支职业元素与元素护甲炫彩相匹配时，效果最闪亮。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 手臂护甲炫彩

flavorText.en: Complete the Payback Redux mission, collect Void orbs, and complete patrols.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版偿还任务，收集虚空光球，完成巡逻。

description.en:
Remaining invisible grants this weapon increased damage for a brief duration.

Hitting a target with this weapon's projectiles while Shot in the Dark is active weakens them. Defeating a target with this weapon while Shot in the Dark is active turns you invisible once more.
description.zh-CN:
保持隐形会在短时间内提高此武器的伤害。

启用暗地一击时，使用此武器的射弹击中目标会对其造成虚弱效果。启用暗地一击时，使用此武器击败目标会使你再次隐形。

flavorText.en: "Don't think about it as improving yourself. Think about it as improving each other." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “别认为这是自我进步，而应看作共同进步。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: – Let your mind be split into the many facets of thought it so craves to embody –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 让你的意识按其所愿，分裂成多重思维面 –

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I are pillars of this existence, and shall be until all comes crashing down." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有。没有任何东西能阻止我们。你我就是这存在的支柱，直到一切都分崩离析。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: Inexorable force is the quickest path between two destinations.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不可阻拦之力是两个目的地之间最短的路径。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: Bum! Bum! Bum! Bum!
flavorText.zh-CN: 咚！咚！咚！咚！

flavorText.en: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这件守护者护甲是用黑色移民号船员的套装改造而成的。

flavorText.en: It's your neck on the line, pal.

flavorText.en: "Let the heat melt your body so your soul might flow with the river of time." —Parables of the Allspring
flavorText.zh-CN: “让热力融化你的身体，你的灵魂将会随着时间之河流淌。”——万春寓言

flavorText.en: "Give a little, but take a little more." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “付出一点，但要多拿回一点。”——浪客

flavorText.en: Modesty is highly overrated as a virtue.
flavorText.zh-CN: 谦虚是一种被严重高估的美德。

flavorText.en: I wish to be renowned.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿名扬四海。

description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成伤害或击败目标可逐渐提供更高的稳定性、操控性、填装速度和充能速度。此效果会随时间逐渐减弱，但在靠近盟友时会更快获得。

description.en: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.
description.zh-CN: 更多弹药储备。弹匣打空时可略微提高填装速度。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Dunemarchers. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变沙丘行者的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "The Kells are dead or mad. The era of Houses is over. So I came to the Shore." —Arrha, trans. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “凯尔非死即疯，氏族时代已经结束，我因此来到海岸。”——阿尔拉，译自埃里克斯尼语

description.en: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成最后一击会产生职业技能能量。使用你的职业技能会在短时间内提升此武器的稳定性。

description.en: Hold too tight and it could all slip away.
description.zh-CN: 好似流沙，握越紧，越易逝。

flavorText.en: "All this in service of one purpose. You have their attention. Let us see if you can keep it." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “所有这些都是为了一个目的。你引起他们的注意了。看看你能不能保持住。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: Titans are taught to repair their armor after every battle. These gauntlets are a lost cause.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦聆听教诲，在每次战斗之后都会修补自己的盔甲。这幅臂铠便是注定失败之物。

flavorText.en: Have you ever felt your hand act of its own accord? Never? We can fix that.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你是否曾觉得自己的手有自己的意识？未曾有这种感觉？我们可以帮你纠正。

flavorText.en: "The shining halls of peace have been torn down and turned into the battered plate of war."
flavorText.zh-CN: “充满光辉的和平殿堂被摧垮，变成了硝烟弥漫的战场。”

flavorText.zh-CN: 他强壮的手中紧握着一支玫瑰。而他的气场亮得发烫。

flavorText.en: "I see six armies, locked in battle, across far systems. Now I see four armies. And now I see one." —RECORD 579-CHASM-3360
flavorText.zh-CN: “我看到了六支军队，被困在战争中，遍布在遥远的星系中。我看到了四支军队。现在我只能看到一支了。”——记录579-裂谷-3360

description.zh-CN: 回收弩弹会在更长的时间内提升填装速度和操控性。

flavorText.en: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “念虽有畏，心无所愧。其若冰清，天塌而不惊。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "If the Vex had achieved what we would call 'time travel,' surely none of us would now exist." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果Vex能够进行我们所谓的‘时间旅行'，我们就不可能存在。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

description.en: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.
description.zh-CN: 站在裂痕之中可以产生寻找盟友并治愈他们的高贵追踪弹。站在强能裂痕之中可以产生赋予你和你的盟友伤害加成的高贵追踪弹。每当高贵追踪弹找到盟友时，你会获得职业技能能量。提升手炮流明的空中效率属性。

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

flavorText.en:
> No one has ever died wearing me.

flavorText.zh-CN:
>没有谁在戴着我时死掉。
#这是事实。在没有价值的人栽倒之前她便扬长而去。

flavorText.zh-CN: 用那对布满哀愁的双目，远眺那些失落已久的蛮荒世界。

flavorText.zh-CN: “夜晚漫长而寒冷。我们必须照应彼此。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: "Nothing has changed. The Light gives us strength, and we must treat it with respect." —Lord Shaxx

flavorText.en: "An adventurer's spirit is a tool so few possess. Own it. Enjoy it." —The Speaker

flavorText.zh-CN: 我看到你在那里做了什么。

flavorText.zh-CN: 无以言表。

description.en: While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
description.zh-CN: 装备烈日超能时，在空中瞄准可使你在短时间内滞留在半空中。当此效果生效时，你对伤害的抗性增加，战斗人员的精度下降。武器命中可延长此效果的持续时间，烈日武器最后一击可提供恢复，从储备弹药中填装其他武器。大幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

description.en: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.
description.zh-CN: 获得额外的融合手雷充能，并可从赋能武器伤害中充能，且赋能武器最后一击可提供更多能量。使用融合手雷击败目标可提供裂痕能量。

description.en: [Arc]Arc final blows grant an escalating damage bonus with Arc weapons. While using Fist of Havoc, activating your Super grants an overshield; final blows extend its duration. When it ends, gain a damage bonus to your Arc weapons.
description.zh-CN: 电弧最后一击可为电弧武器提供递增的伤害加成。使用浩劫之拳时，激活超能会提供覆盖护盾，最后一击可延长其持续时间。在结束时，可获得电弧武器伤害加成。

flavorText.en: What you asked for or your money back!
flavorText.zh-CN: 未达要求，钱款包退！

flavorText.en: "I did not think I would see the Farm again. It seems smaller now." —Mithrax
flavorText.zh-CN: “没想到我还会看到农庄。它现在看起来好像小了点。”——米瑟拉克斯

flavorText.en: "They gave us nothing… so we'll take everything." —Elykris, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们什么都没给我们……那我们就把所有东西都带走。”——埃里克瑞斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

sourceString.en: Source: Eliminate all Barons on the Tangled Shore.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在纷争海岸消灭所有公爵。

flavorText.en: An ancient war horn, herald of countless battles. Let them know you're coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 古老的战争号角，无数场战役的先驱。让他们知晓你即将到来。

flavorText.en: An aged pauldron, dented and scarred. Be the front line.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件老旧的护肩甲，凹迹斑斑，伤痕累累。身居前线。

flavorText.en: A tattered banner, every tear and faded stitch a lesson you will not forget. As long as it still waves, you rise to meet any challenge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一面破烂的旗帜，每个破洞和褪色的针脚，都是你不会忘却的教训。只要它仍在飘扬，你就会奋起迎接任何挑战。

flavorText.en: Shards of a broken blade, memento of a duel long won. Yours will not share its fate.
flavorText.zh-CN: 残破的刀剑碎片，纪念着一场很久以前的胜利。你绝不会沦落到和这碎片一样的下场。

flavorText.en: Has this wealth found you or have you found it?
flavorText.zh-CN: 是财富找到了你还是你找到了财富？

flavorText.en: "There is nothing more unknowable than all we have forgotten." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有任何事物比吾辈忘却之物更加难以认知。”——先知

flavorText.en: Only bones for your feast. Only death for my victory.
flavorText.zh-CN: 唯有骸骨是你的盛宴。唯有死亡令我感到胜利。

flavorText.zh-CN: 以现实之繁荣扩展吾等领地。

flavorText.en: "Some speculate that the radiolarian fluid is the last vestige of a biological life-form that became the Vex." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"

flavorText.zh-CN: “他们不了解Vex，也不知道自己正被监视。”——伊丝黛尔·布兰德对她的机灵说

flavorText.zh-CN: 空中的盛宴。大快朵颐，直到所有星光都黯淡下去——届时宇宙将随着你的怒吼而颤抖。

flavorText.en: "It's good to see the Traveler from my balcony again. Reminds you of what we do this for, eh?" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “又能从我家阳台上看见旅行者了，感觉真好。让我们想起了拼搏的意义，对吧？”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：熔炉竞技场中的荣耀比赛

flavorText.en: "From the first whisper, I knew it spoke truth." —Aisha, Human Hunter
flavorText.zh-CN: “从第一声低语开始，我就知道它说的是真理。”——艾莎，人类猎人

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness
description.zh-CN:
经优化提高对后坐力控制的弹匣。
  •  大幅提高稳定性
  •  略微缩短射程
  • 增加空中效率

description.en: Increased damage versus powerful combatants. Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.
description.zh-CN: 提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，极低热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。在极高热量时手动排气将大幅提高排气速度。

name.zh-CN: 布瑞科技钢铁雄心引擎

flavorText.en: The air is cold, but our hearts are warm.
flavorText.zh-CN: 空气很冷，但内心温暖。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在至日期间获得的火种和余烬来升级此物品。

flavorText.en: The moment when wings and limbs are held on tenterhooks, and the pin enters the thorax.
flavorText.zh-CN: 羽翼和肢体被钩住，别针插入了胸腔。

description.en: Chance to receive a Legendary engram when completing Heroic adventures on Mercury with your clan members.
description.zh-CN: 与公会成员在水星上完成英雄探险后有几率获得一个传说记忆水晶。

flavorText.en: "It is our burden to bear. It never gets easier. But we must carry it." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是我们肩负的重担，它从未减轻，但我们必须扛下去。”——萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: Bravery in the blaze.
flavorText.zh-CN: 烈火中的英勇。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: The sea covers all the world with its outspread hand. I am in the sea but not of it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 海洋以其广袤无垠覆盖世界。我虽身在其中，却似游离之外。

flavorText.en: Macabre in its brilliance.
flavorText.zh-CN: 令人毛骨悚然的辉煌。

description.en:
Picking up ammunition increases this weapon's flinch resistance and range, which lasts until it is fired again.

Swords gain a large increase to charge rate instead.
description.zh-CN:
拾取弹药可提高此武器的抖动抗性和射程，并可持续至再次射击。

而刀剑则可大幅提高充能速度。

flavorText.en: It's right here! Seriously!
flavorText.zh-CN: 就在这儿啊！真的！

flavorText.en: "The signs are always there, if you know what to look for. Most folks don't." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “其实征兆一直存在，如果你知道该去找些什么的话。但大多数人都不知道。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

description.en: [Grenade]  : Throw a device charged with [Stasis] Stasis matter and [Solar] Solar energy that attaches to surfaces or targets, then erupts into a slowing storm. After a short duration, the device ignites, creating a deadly scorching cyclone.
description.zh-CN: [手雷]  ：投掷出一个由冰影物质和烈日能量充能的装置，附着在表面或目标上，然后爆发为减速风暴。一小段时间后，装置会点燃，产生致命的灼烧旋风。

flavorText.en: Warm hands, warm heart.
flavorText.zh-CN: 温在手，暖于心。

flavorText.en: Feast on the sky. Gorge yourself until all starlight has been gnawed to black—then the cosmos will tremble with your roar.
flavorText.zh-CN: 空中的盛宴。大快朵颐，直到所有星光都黯淡下去——届时宇宙将随着你的怒吼而颤抖。

flavorText.en: "I give you this, to be sure that we meet again." —Lakshmi-2
flavorText.zh-CN: “我将它送给你，我们一定会再见。”——拉克希米-2

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.

flavorText.en:
"Earth's destiny is to move beyond the Earth."

"It was. Now we turn space stations into battle armor."
flavorText.zh-CN:
“地球的命运便是超越地球的界线。”

“确实如此。如今，我们将空间站化作我们的战甲。”

description.en:
No perk currently selected.

description.zh-CN:
当前未选择特性。

flavorText.en: With a paracausal eye, what can be scried?
flavorText.zh-CN: 超因果之眼能看见什么？

flavorText.zh-CN: “这是燃料，带着它更努力地战斗。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: The perfect disguise.

flavorText.en: Brr, it's cold…
flavorText.zh-CN: 啧，很冷诶……

description.en: Improved resilience.
description.zh-CN: 更强的韧性。

flavorText.en: To keep our feet moving when the ground runs dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在前路渐暗时，使双脚继续前行。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.zh-CN: “你看到了吗？你看到我的能耐了吗？”——第三百夫长泰坦，雅尔达姆-4

flavorText.en: A sigil of solidarity between two cities.
flavorText.zh-CN: 两座城市之间团结的标志。

sourceString.en: Source: Season of the Lost Ritual Playlists
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：神隐赛季仪式游戏列表

flavorText.en: "Feast, my comrades. Torobatl may be lost, but its spirit lives on in our traditions." —Empress Caiatl
flavorText.zh-CN: “盛宴吧，我的战友们。图罗巴特尔也许已经离我们而去，但是它的精神永存。”——女帝查厄托

flavorText.en: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “我用自己编写的代码给这件护甲编写了程序！如果你挂了，那是你的错。与我无关。”——智能失效保险

目标受不稳定虚空能量影响，在受到额外伤害时产生爆炸。

description.en: Dealing damage builds Latent Power; precision hits and final blows build more. At full power, hold [Alternate Weapon Action] to trigger Unleashed Power, empowering the weapon with increased rate of fire and hip-fire accuracy and causing shots to weaken targets. After a short time, it becomes Overwhelming Power, which deals damage to you over time. Reload or stow the weapon to end these effects.
description.zh-CN: 造成伤害会积累潜藏能量；精准命中和最后一击会积累更多能量。能量全满时，按住[替换武器动作]即可触发“释放力量，提升武器射速和腰射精度，并且射击会削弱目标。短时间后转化为压迫能量，持续对自身造成伤害。填装或收起武器即可结束这些效果。

description.en: While a Solar Super is equipped, weapon final blows grant class ability energy. Defeating targets with your weapon while standing in a healing rift creates a pulse that grants Radiant to you and nearby allies; an empowering rift instead grants Cure to you and nearby allies. Daybreak final blows grant both effects.
description.zh-CN: 装备烈日超能时，武器最后一击可提供职业技能能量。站在治愈裂痕内用武器击败目标会生成脉冲，为你和附近盟友提供焕光；站在强能裂痕内则转而为你和附近盟友提供治愈。黎明最后一击同时提供两种效果。

description.en:
Dash forward, slashing combatants as you pass through them. Deals significantly increased damage to Void-debuffed targets, or targets marked by On The Prowl.
 
Generate Void Overshield for each combatant hit. Defeating at least one combatant grants additional Overshield and refunds melee ability energy.
description.zh-CN:
向前冲刺，穿过战斗人员时对其猛击。对受到虚空减益的目标或被伺机而动标记的目标造成显著提升的伤害。
 
每命中一名战斗人员都会生成虚空覆盖护盾。击败至少一名战斗人员提供额外覆盖护盾并返还近战技能能量。

description.en:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
description.zh-CN:
投掷一个烟雾弹，它会附着在表面上，发信号给敌人的雷达，然后引爆为一团使人迷失方向的烟云，削弱附近的目标。烟云内的目标会受到持续伤害。

部署后，让附近的盟友隐身。

flavorText.en: Oh, to read a pulpy golden age detective novel… just once more.
flavorText.zh-CN: 简陋通俗的黄金时代侦探小说…能再读一次就好了。

description.en:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.

使用虚空伤害击败目标有几率提供递增的虚空武器伤害加成。使用虚空近战击败目标可提供超能能量。

Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

flavorText.en: Long march. Stone road. Old city. Know the land.
flavorText.zh-CN: 漫长旅途。岩石之路。古老城邦。吾之故乡。

flavorText.en: Taut sails. Wide rivers. Battered towers. Watch the seas.
flavorText.zh-CN: 绷紧的船帆。宽阔的河流。残损的高塔。临海的守望。

flavorText.en: Old kings. Sharp swords. Epic songs. Take the throne.
flavorText.zh-CN: 年迈国王。犀利剑光。史诗赞歌。坐拥王座。

flavorText.en: To warm our bodies in the chill of the night.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在霜降寒夜中，使我们的身体温暖。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Do not be afraid. Our fate cannot be taken from us. It is a gift.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无需畏惧，没人能抢走我们的宿命，这是一份礼物。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Mars.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在火星上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Do not concern yourself with how many horns I bear." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “不用在意我身上有多少瘢痕。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：闪点里程碑；传说记忆水晶。

Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: "Light isn't power. Light isn't magic. It's a skill. Be unthoughtful in its use and you will fail every time." —Warlock Aunor Mahal.
flavorText.zh-CN: “光能不是能量；光能不是魔法。它是一种技能。使用时小心，你随时可能失败。”——术士阿诺尔·玛哈

flavorText.en: Sometimes you forget which side you're on.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有时候你会忘记自己的立场。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on the Tangled Shore.

flavorText.en: "You have truly grown fat from strength. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “你果然变得又强又壮，了不起。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.zh-CN:
“剑可以施放两种法术：招架，还有斩切。”

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的敌人以为自己是神，是王者。让他们知道他们错了。”——卡丽斯托·殷

成功的近战命中可让此武器在短时间内增加伤害，减少充能时间，并提升填装速度。使用大部分弹丸爆发击中目标可在短时间内提升近战伤害。

flavorText.en: "The face of war continues to change. In this timeline, Cabal. In another, Vex. And in this other one—we have no name for what we saw." —RECORD 614-CHASM-8299
flavorText.zh-CN: “战争的表象不断改变。在这条时间线里，是卡巴尔。在另一条中，是Vex。而在这条中——我们甚至叫不出我们面对的是什么。”——记录614-裂谷-8299

flavorText.en: Take the hits. Give the hits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 承受打击。顺势输出。

flavorText.en: Flip a coin. Heads, the Hunter wins. Tails, the other guy loses.
flavorText.zh-CN: 抛一枚硬币。正面朝上，猎人赢。反面朝上，对手输。

flavorText.en: "Do you really have to keep doing that?" —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “你一定要继续这样吗？”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: The best defense is offense, because then your enemy's dead. The second-best defense is good armor.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最好的防守就是进攻，因为你杀死敌人他们就无法还击。第二好的防守则是精良的护甲。

flavorText.zh-CN: 为向佩纶及其正义坚定之决心致敬而铸造。

flavorText.en: I wish to be cunning.

description.en:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
description.zh-CN:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

flavorText.en: "Let them try to break through." —Lord Citan
flavorText.zh-CN: “让他们试试突破吧。”——领主西坦

flavorText.en: This Guardian armor was repurposed from old Exodus Black crew flight suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这件守护者护甲是用黑色移民号船员的套装改造而成的。

flavorText.en: When your enemies behold your power, let them know fear. Turn your gaze to them and let them know death.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当敌人见识到你的力量时，让他们心涌恐惧；怒视他们，让他们饮恨黄泉。

flavorText.en: "You who seek the Forge: your journey will be long, but your destination is closer than you think." —Ouros
flavorText.zh-CN: “寻找锻炉的人：你的旅程很长，但终点比想象的近。”——奥罗斯

flavorText.en: Worse things happen at sea.
flavorText.zh-CN: 海上会发生更糟糕的事。

sourceString.en: Source: The Edge of Fate Campaign

flavorText.en: "Vex structures on Venus and Mercury predate the Golden Age, and possibly Humanity itself." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “金星和水星上的Vex建筑是在黄金时代之前，甚至可能在人类出现之前建造的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: "They who entered the Speaker's chambers as master and apprentice were bitter rivals when they left." —Brother Vance
flavorText.zh-CN: “那些以主仆的身份进入先知的房间的人，在离开时就变成了死对头。”——万斯修士

flavorText.en: "Truth is difficult. And that's fine. I don't trust anyone who doesn't like a challenge." —Chul Sobong, Hidden instructor
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相难寻。这没关系。我不信任那些不喜欢挑战的人。”——哲索邦，隐秘者导师

flavorText.en: "I stopped counting the Armageddons." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经不再憧憬末世决战。”——浪客

During Solstice 2021:
- Complete strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.
- Open Solstice packages.
- Defeat Fallen.

至日英雄2021期间：
-完成打击、熔炉竞技场或智谋游戏列表活动。

flavorText.en: Never, ever, look back.

flavorText.en: "With the arrival of the Pyramids, and now these Eliksni joining us in the Last City, I can't help but feel like we haven't ever truly understood the war we're fighting. But I believe we are learning quickly now." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “随着金字塔的到来和这些埃里克斯尼族住进我们的圣城，我不禁觉得，我们并不真正理解我们正在经历的这场战争。但我相信我们很快就会知道了。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: "Was Wolf once. Still Wolf after Scatter, but… different. Then Queen's. Wolf again. Bannerless. Then Spider's." —Avrok
flavorText.zh-CN: “曾为狼族，散战后依旧，但却……不同。接着属于女王，又为狼族，无名之狼。再隶蛛王。”——埃弗罗克

flavorText.en: We celebrate the future we will build together.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂我们将会共同构建的未来。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the end of all things. The novenary, the Awoken Queen, the sad, strange little man on his rickety boat. They believe they've seen the same. What they don't know will destroy them." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见了一切的终末。玖，觉醒者女王，还有那个站在摇摇欲坠的飞船上悲伤而奇怪的小家伙。他们相信自己也看到了相同之事。他们的无知将引领他们走向灭亡。”——卡鲁斯大帝
