description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: You pride yourself on your ability to protect.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你为自己的保护能力感到自豪。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 胸部护甲模组

sourceString.zh-CN: 需要守护者等级6：商人挑战

flavorText.en: The pommel stone of a battle-scarred war hammer, radiant with an inner fire. You reclaim this once-hallowed ground.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战痕累累战锤的锤柄石，闪耀着内在的火光。你要夺回这片曾经神圣的土地。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 烈日星相 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 烈日星相 | 光能技能

flavorText.en: A handful of lavender ribbons, gently wrapped around your forearm. This gift from the Saint reminds you not to just roll with the punches—send them back twice as hard.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一把紫色缎带，轻轻缠绕在你的前臂上。这份来自圣人的礼物提醒你不仅要承受打击，更得加倍奉还。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空星相 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空星相 | 光能技能

flavorText.en: A weapon of Vex origin frozen at the moment before it lets its ordnance fly—like an arm, spear in hand, forever paused at the apex of its throw. It is the embodiment of action forever postponed, desperate to be unleashed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件源自于Vex的武器，停留在它甩出军械的前一刻。就像一只拿着长矛的手臂永远定格在了投掷的顶点。它是无限延期动作的化身，拼命想要释放出来。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 冰影星相 | 暗影技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 冰影星相 | 暗影技能

flavorText.en: An orb of dancing plasma, you hold the power of raw lightning in your fist. One strike is all you need.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个舞动的等离子能量球，你的拳中握有原始闪电的力量。一击就足够。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧星相 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧星相 | 光能技能

flavorText.en: An ancient war horn, herald of countless battles. Let them know you're coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 古老的战争号角，无数场战役的先驱。让他们知晓你即将到来。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 缚丝星相 | 暗影技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 缚丝星相 | 暗影技能

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Forerunner. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变先驱者的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration
description.zh-CN:
从护盾转移的能量。
  •  大幅增加射程
  • 降低护盾持续时间

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

flavorText.en: "Prepare for your arctic adventure with the very best in Bray outfitting!" —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “用最优秀的布瑞科技服饰为你的极地冒险做好准备吧！”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

description.en:
Increases weapon handling and reload speed. Gain the following effects while you are the last living member of your fireteam:
• Increased target acquisition
• Increased handling and reload speed
• Reduced flinch from incoming fire
description.zh-CN:
提高武器操控性和装填速度。当你作为你的火力战队最后一名存活的队员时获得以下效果：
·增强目标锁定
·增强操控性和装填速度
·减少收到伤害时的屏幕抖动

flavorText.en: "I'm more interested in where I'm going." —Banshee-44
flavorText.zh-CN: “我对我要去的地方更感兴趣。”——班西-44

flavorText.en: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
flavorText.zh-CN: “唤醒之物再难沉眠。”——灵巫卡丽

flavorText.en: You stand ready. Immovable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你稳扎稳打，不可动摇。

flavorText.en: Tech|Notice|42| All—use of the sample decommission tool is restricted to accredited researchers. If you need to contain something, call security.
flavorText.zh-CN: 技术|通知|42| 全体注意——所有样本处理工具仅限经认可的研究人员使用。如果你需要隔离处理某物，请联系安保人员。

flavorText.en: "All the pain, all the guilt, welled up at once and then was gone."
flavorText.zh-CN: “所有的痛苦，所有的内疚，一下涌上心头，然后消失。”

flavorText.en: Show them you can contain multitudes, and your interiority will spawn nightmares.
flavorText.zh-CN: 向他们展示你的心胸之广，你心中的力量便是他们的噩梦。

description.en: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
description.zh-CN: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之提高。

description.en: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的每个快速击杀将在短时间内累积增加装填速度。

description.en: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.
description.zh-CN: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还两枚弹药。

description.en: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.
description.zh-CN: 精准击杀可大幅缩短填装时间。

flavorText.en: "It's from 'Paladin Oran.' 'Use less data, route electron notices forward over Uranus-Neptune divide." —Paladin Hallam Fen
flavorText.zh-CN: “来自‘圣骑士奥兰'，‘欧洲无人区顿时陷入一片黑暗，已派人前往，希望可以找到原因。'”——圣骑士霍拉姆·凡

description.en: Rapidly landing precision hits causes targets to become slowed. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
description.zh-CN: 快速精准命中会使目标进入减速状态。克制过载勇士。

flavorText.en: You value risk. You crave reward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你重视冒险，你渴望回报。

flavorText.en: It's important to stretch thoroughly after each resurrection.
flavorText.zh-CN: 每次复活后的认真伸展都很重要。

flavorText.en: "Maybe you leave your first apocalypse. But your second one never leaves you." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许你已逃脱天启初降，但你永难摆脱天启再临。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

description.en: Complete Heroic strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV head armor.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间完成英雄打击可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV头部护甲上解锁。

flavorText.en: "Ten paces, sidearms or Hand Cannons only. Usually to the third rez. Do NOT target Ghosts." —"Duels for the Road" by Cayde-6
flavorText.zh-CN: “走十步，只准使用手枪或手炮。祈祷第三次复活的神迹吧。切勿瞄准机灵。”——凯德6号所著的《道路的决斗》

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Unfall. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变事故的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

description.en: This armor reduces incoming damage while your Super is active.
description.zh-CN: 当超能激活时，护甲可减少所受到的伤害。

flavorText.en: There are some who call me… the Guardian.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有些人称我为…守护者。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: This weapon was forged by Devrim Kay VIII for the survivors.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是德弗里姆·卡伊VIII为幸存者铸造的武器。

flavorText.en: Lose yourself in the moment.
flavorText.zh-CN: 此刻迷失自我。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: I will outlive you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 看谁活得久。

flavorText.en: "We're momentary creatures, and the future is distant and vast. But many stones, in time, change the river's course." —Briar, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是短暂的生物，而未来既遥远又广阔。但随着时间的推移，积石也会改变河水的流向。”——云端行者，蔷薇

description.en: Final blows with Unrepentant superbursts automatically reload your weapon and provide an Unrepentant superburst.
description.zh-CN: 使用不知悔改超级爆发击杀可自动重新填装武器并提供不知悔改超级爆发。

flavorText.en: "Initial entry matches the Guardian's description, a… theater? Psychometer is picking up weird background noise here." —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 1st Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “最初的记录与守护者的描述相符，一个……剧院？”心理测试仪在这接收到了奇怪的背景噪音。”——隐秘者心像空间探险第1次通讯

flavorText.en:
"How can you protect humanity if you do not know what it is like to be human? To revel in simple pleasures?" —Eva Levante
Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“如果你不知道作为人类是什么感觉，不知道陶醉于简单快乐的感觉，你又如何能够保护人类呢？”——伊娃·莱万特
在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

flavorText.en: – With knife in hand and violence in heart, a proposal is made and refused –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 手握利刃，心怀暴力，做出提议并被拒绝 –

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 头盔护甲模组

description.en: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.
description.zh-CN: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。

flavorText.en: This armor won't stop a Cabal round, but it'll buy you some time before you die.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这件护甲抵挡不住一颗卡巴尔子弹，但能在你死之前为你争取一些时间。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 手臂护甲模组

flavorText.en: Tug at the threads of causality.
flavorText.zh-CN: 拉扯因果的绳索。

flavorText.en: Complete adventures, collect Arc orbs in the Crucible or Gambit, and unlock Solstice Packages.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成探险，在熔炉竞技场或智谋中收集电弧光球，以及解锁至日包裹。

flavorText.en: "On the day our ships are ready, the City will see us blast into the sky." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们飞船就绪的那天，圣城将见证我们直冲云霄。”——蛛族杰尔拉

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从蛛族杰尔拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "As sharp as Psion rotgut and twice as strong." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “像灵能劣酒一样浓烈，强度加倍。”——浪客

description.zh-CN: 使用蠕虫低语打败目标。

description.zh-CN: 此武器会发射一个直线前进的高速微型导弹并造成较少的自我伤害。装备此武器时移动速度更快。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

description.en: Equip this item to change your Ghost's projection.
description.zh-CN: 装备此物品以改变机灵投影。

description.en: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a more powerful homing micro-missile.
description.zh-CN: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚更强力的制导微型导弹。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en: The Jaisalmer pattern in this helmet carries redundant transmitters, in case of cranial dislocation.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这件头盔的贾沙梅尔设计为防颅骨错位而搭载了多余的发射器。

flavorText.en: "Why were we Risen if not to defend the helpless?" —Lord Radegast
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果不去保护无助的人，我们为什么成为复生者呢？”——领主拉德加斯特

description.en:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage
description.zh-CN:
充能时间缩短。
  •  缩短充能时间
  •  降低命中伤害

flavorText.en: Is there a light on up there?
flavorText.zh-CN: 突然有个好点子是吗？

flavorText.en: It's time to have a serious conversation.
flavorText.zh-CN: 是时候认真谈一谈了。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

flavorText.en: Archival|Castor|231| —don't understand. We're all excited for successful code injection, but it's much too early for insertion into a chassis—
flavorText.zh-CN: 档案|卡斯托|231| ——不明白。代码注入成功我们都很兴奋，但现在就插入底架还为时过早——

flavorText.en: The Dawning's familiar warmth can thaw even the coldest of hearts.
flavorText.zh-CN: 曙光节熟悉的温暖可以融化最冰冷的心。

flavorText.en: The killer robot killer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 杀手级的机器人杀手。

flavorText.en: "Perun's strikes would hit so fast and true that our enemies wouldn't realize their fate until it was too late." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “佩纶的打击又快又猛，当敌人意识到他们的命运时已为时已晚。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.zh-CN: “我会永远保护黑色军械库，这个使命高于一切。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: An antique radio transmitter from the Golden Age. Listen close and you can hear the chirping of its last transmission, yearning to be free.
flavorText.zh-CN: 黄金时代的古老无线电发射器。仔细聆听，你可以听到它最后一次发出的鸣叫，渴望自由。

flavorText.en: A long-forgotten experiment that draws strange adherents. Bring to mind the products of its charge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个失传已久、吸引奇怪拥护者的实验。思维可利用其充能的产物。

flavorText.en: An improvised electro-magnet, coils crudely wound. Displace and electrify, forces beckon from within you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一块简易电磁铁，线圈粗略地缠绕其上。位移生电，力量在体内召唤。

flavorText.en: An electric eel poised for attack. Electrons sing at your approach. Another familiar joins your ranks.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一只准备攻击的电鳗。在你靠近时电子在吟唱。又一名仆从加入了你的麾下。

flavorText.zh-CN: 再大胆一些，再专注一些。你就要准备好……施放暗影了。——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: Not far now.
flavorText.zh-CN: 触手可及。

flavorText.en: "Life is lies. Comfort? Justice? Love? They're things we made up. Don't make the mistake of assuming true and false are the same as good and bad. What's important is being able to tell them apart." —Omar Saint Croix, Hidden handler
flavorText.zh-CN: “生活就是谎言。慰藉？正义？爱？都是我们编造出来的。别误以为真与假就是好与坏。重要的是要能区分它们。”——奥马尔·圣克鲁瓦，隐秘者顾问

description.en:
Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots explode
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
description.zh-CN:
武器可自适应目标。造成伤害时：

• 较弱目标：子弹爆炸
• 较强目标：使目标变得疲惫
• 守护者：武器的抖动抗性提升

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

先知的最爱肯定拥有一个完美的悖论。

flavorText.en: We have much to teach each other.

flavorText.en: Isidel hoisted herself back up over the chasma edge, turned to help the man behind her. But he was gone. Everyone was gone. The chasma was empty.
flavorText.zh-CN: 伊丝黛尔攀上深谷边缘，转身帮助她身后的人。但他不见了，所有人都不见了。峡谷空空荡荡。

flavorText.en: Complete the Homecoming Redux mission, collect Arc orbs in strikes, and complete a meditation for Ikora.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版再见圣城任务，在打击中收集电弧光球，为艾可拉完成一个冥想。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the work that will bring this system together. I'll need your wisdom." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了统一这个星系的过程。我会需要你的智慧。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Opening Hidden Caches during Exotic quest "Presage" will unlock this objective faster.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

在异域任务“前兆”中打开隐藏的宝箱可更快解锁此目标。

description.en:
Hipfiring: Projectiles will track marked targets, dealing increased body shot damage on impact.

Aiming: Projectiles have greatly increased velocity and cause extra damage when dealing precision final blows to marked targets.
description.zh-CN:
腰射时：射弹追击已标记的目标，命中时造成更高的身体射击伤害。

瞄准时：射弹拥有大幅提升的速度，并且对已标记的目标进行精准最后一击时造成额外伤害。

flavorText.zh-CN: “船长，7066涅索斯的轨道与发射基地的计算结果不同。”——飞行官萨曼莎·布莱兹

flavorText.zh-CN: “没有誓言能将我缚于过往。”——被抹去者，克瑞夫

flavorText.en: Well deserved.

flavorText.zh-CN: 德弗里姆·卡伊让守护者护甲套装的款式更新潮。

flavorText.en: Perfect for chilly nights.

flavorText.en: With this, I topple Heracles.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有了这个，我就能战胜赫拉克勒斯。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的敌人是墙外的恐怖力量，别忘了你在这里的对手都是你的兄弟姐妹。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Victory is a process, not a finality.
flavorText.zh-CN: 胜利只是一个过程，而不是终点。

flavorText.en: "Think of all the old mysteries that are now ours to solve anew!" —Timur, learning of SIVA
flavorText.zh-CN: “思索现在属于我们的所有古老秘密，重新解开它们！”——帖木儿，湿婆研究

flavorText.en: "What is this junk from, that old moon base? What do you mean, 'just refurbish it'?!" —Exodus Indigo Quartermaster
flavorText.zh-CN: “这些垃圾是从哪儿来的，那个旧月球基地？什么叫‘只是翻新一下'？！”——靛蓝移民号军需官

flavorText.en: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的传承鼓舞着我们，这样我们才有力量把手伸向未来。没有哪个云端行者是在孤军奋战。”——云端行者，洛汗

flavorText.en: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.
flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

flavorText.en: A forceful brace: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件强力护腿：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

flavorText.en: Digging leaves a mark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 挖掘会留下痕迹。

Weapons of Light persists after exiting Ward of Dawn. While Weapons of Light is active, final blows or sustained damage grant stacks of The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage sources also trigger a suppressing burst.

description.en:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
description.zh-CN:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

flavorText.en: Measure twice, fire once.

flavorText.en: It's all in the glutes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 重点在臀大肌。

description.en: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.
description.zh-CN: 电池满能时，下一次冲击将造成额外伤害并使敌人在死亡时爆炸。

flavorText.en: Bring floaties and friends.
flavorText.zh-CN: 带上泳圈和朋友。

flavorText.en: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise
flavorText.zh-CN: “船长，7066涅索斯的轨道与发射基地的计算结果不同。”——飞行官萨曼莎·布莱兹

flavorText.en: In history's long shadow.

description.en: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.
description.zh-CN: 此武器可在持用者保持移动时获得稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成。

flavorText.en: "And lastly, a shroud of dreams, so that you might see these nightmares with open eyes." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “最后，梦境之幕，这样你方可以己之目，洞察梦魇。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "The Reef grieves for Uldren Sov, lost in the Taken War. He will be remembered as a voice for peace." —Paladin Devi Cassl
flavorText.zh-CN: “暗礁为欧顿·索维于傀儡战争殒命而哀痛，他将作为和平使者为人铭记。”——圣骑士戴维·卡瑟尔

flavorText.en: The loop is made. Over and over until the collision. At that moment, severed fission.
flavorText.zh-CN: 循环已成。在碰撞之前将生生不息。在碰撞的那一刻，断绝裂变。

flavorText.zh-CN: 伊丝黛尔攀上深谷边缘，转身帮助她身后的人。但他不见了，所有人都不见了。峡谷空空荡荡。

flavorText.zh-CN: 卡丽斯托·殷用她的燃烧印记将胜利之焰带出了圣城。

flavorText.en: Hey, Guardian, it'll be OK.

flavorText.en: "I have no use for mawkish sentimentality. What I do need is an assistant who stays alive as often as possible." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “多愁善感对我而言如草芥一般。我真正需要的，是一名知道如何随时活下去的助手。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: "Humanity's been waging war for as long as we've been humanity. Don't forget the old lessons." —Valus Saladin Forge
flavorText.zh-CN: “自我们成为人类起，就从未停止过战争。别忘了古老的教训。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

flavorText.en: Sometimes you've got to dance like nobody's watching.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有时候你要旁若无人一样地跳舞。

description.en: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely. Gain a bonus to the Bow's damage when released, based on how long perfect draw was held. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Bows.
description.zh-CN: 弓箭可以不限时地完美拉弓。根据完美拉弓持续时间，箭矢在射出时会得到相应的伤害加成。中幅提高弓箭的空中效率属性。

description.en: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.
description.zh-CN: 飞刀最后一击会减少超能的冷却时间。一轮齐射中被利刃弹幕飞刀命中最多的目标会释放一次剧烈的烈日爆炸，发射灼烧烈日碎片。使用利刃弹幕造成命中和最后一击将于超能结束后返还超能能量。

flavorText.en: The fire in your eyes reveals all truths.
flavorText.zh-CN: 眼中的怒火揭示了所有真相。

sourceString.en: Source: Crafted in a Black Armory forge.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在黑色军械库锻炉中制造。

flavorText.en: Complete the "Leviathan" raid on Prestige difficulty.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成巅峰难度的“利维坦”突袭。

flavorText.en: Prepare for everything, or the wilds will take everything.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为一切做好准备，否则荒野将夺走一切。

description.en: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 低射速，高伤害。保持不动、缓慢移动以及瞄准目标时，此武器精度更高。

flavorText.en: "Iterate and advance. That's what we do. No time to dwell on failures, only learn from them." —Kestrel, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “迭代和前进。这就是我们的做派。没时间沉湎于失败，只能从中吸取教训。”——云端行者，茶隼

description.en: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内降低其弹道分布。

flavorText.en: There are some helmets that will change your tactics forever. This is just a helmet.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有些头盔能永远改变你的战术。但这只是个头盔而已。

flavorText.en: "Let them have the Great Machine. They deserve it." —Mithrax, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “就让他们拥有那伟大的机器吧，他们应得的。”——米瑟拉克斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

flavorText.en: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们也许最终要在涅索斯停下了。我们的右舷引擎报废了。”——薰·佐伊科娃总工程师

flavorText.en: "What has been awoken can slumber no more." —Techeun Kalli
flavorText.zh-CN: “唤醒之物再难沉眠。”——灵巫卡丽

flavorText.en: "Perun and Gheleon are so serious. Never yet seen a target I couldn't hit. What've I to worry about? " —Efrideet, before the Ironsbane
flavorText.zh-CN: “佩纶和盖里恩可不算儿戏。还没见过我打不中的目标。我还有什么可担心的？”——艾弗里迪特，钢铁灾星前留字

flavorText.en: Those who walk through fire have burned away their fear.
flavorText.zh-CN: 浴烈焰而重生者，无所畏惧。

flavorText.en: A Scout Rifle, modified by Dead Orbit's superb technicians and specialists.
flavorText.zh-CN: 经过死亡轨道的优秀技师和专家改造的一把斥候步枪。

flavorText.en: Just a little boost.

flavorText.en: To be an Exo is to forget. But sometimes there are clues in the shapes of the holes…
flavorText.zh-CN: 成为Exo就要遗忘一切。但有时候空洞的形状也能透露出蛛丝马迹……

flavorText.en: This weapon was forged by Devrim Kay VIII for the survivors.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是德弗里姆·卡伊VIII为幸存者铸造的武器。

description.en: Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.
description.zh-CN: 使你的暮域手雷的影响范围大幅增加。处于暮域内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，并且该区域内的目标造成的伤害会减少。

flavorText.en: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The wisdom borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “以我对未来的了解，以及你所看到和做过的一切……它所承载的智慧……到了一切的终末，还有什么能阻止我们呢？”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

flavorText.zh-CN: 当你的肌肉酸痛，前路却不见尽头的时候，想想你已经走了多远。

flavorText.en: Sun's hanging low in the sky.
flavorText.zh-CN: 太阳低垂在空中。

flavorText.en: Be a pain in their side.
flavorText.zh-CN: 成为他们的肉中刺。

flavorText.en: Place like this ain't home to the faint of heart.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这里不是胆小鬼该来的地方。

flavorText.en: "Calculate infinity that it may be held and redirected for the common good." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “将无穷量化，将其掌握并投入到我们共同的宏图之中。”——先知

flavorText.en: "Due respect, Commander? I was there when the Hive found us on Earth. I was there when we stopped them on Titan. And I'll be there when we wipe them out." —Sloane
flavorText.zh-CN: “指挥官，应有的尊重？当邪魔族在地球上找到我们的时候我在那里。当我们在土卫六上阻止他们的时候我在那里。当我们彻底摧毁他们的时候，我也会在那里。”——斯隆

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成日落打击“萨瓦图恩之歌”。

description.zh-CN: 操控性极佳。装备时移动速度提高。

flavorText.zh-CN: 值得更加响亮的掌声。

flavorText.en: "We tracked the thing all the way to the ruins of Old Chicago, down into the tombs. We weren't hunting it. It was luring us." —Aisha, Human Hunter
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们跟着那东西一路来到旧芝加哥的废墟，深入墓穴之中。并不是我们在猎杀它。而是它在引诱我们。”艾莎，人类猎人

flavorText.en: "The first step toward truth is to let go of all that we know and hold dear." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “迈向真实的第一步，就是放下我们所知道且珍视的一切。”——蛛族杰尔拉

flavorText.zh-CN: “多年以来，觉醒者的领土一直在逐渐沦陷，纷争海岸首当其冲。”——蛛王

flavorText.en: "You never know what lies ahead." —Ada-1

"Earth's destiny is to move beyond the Earth."

"It was. Now we turn space stations into battle armor."

“地球的命运便是超越地球的界线。”

“确实如此。如今，我们将空间站化作我们的战甲。”

description.zh-CN: 魂火晶体被摧毁时会释放强效腐化，并在目标接近时自动引爆。

flavorText.zh-CN: “知识本身就是目的。”——破碎者，托兰

flavorText.en: Rest satisfied with doing well, and leave others to talk of you as they please.

flavorText.en: Trace the ancient course of cosmic civilizations. You will, inevitably, arrive at the Traveler.
flavorText.zh-CN: 探寻宇宙文明的古老轨迹。你终将到达旅行者的身边。

flavorText.en: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 德弗里姆·卡伊让守护者护甲套装的款式更新潮。

flavorText.en: OK, team, what's the plan?
flavorText.zh-CN: 好了大伙，计划是什么？

description.en: Hide your true face from the sun, lest you get burned.
description.zh-CN: 唯恐灼伤，将真正面容隐于烈日之下。

description.en: Be renewed in mind and spirit.
description.zh-CN: 让思维和心灵重焕新生。

flavorText.en: Make yourself dreadful to your enemies and indispensable to your allies.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让敌人惧怕你，让盟友依靠你。

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Banshee-44.

flavorText.en: The reign of Light will be long and peaceful.
flavorText.zh-CN: 光明之治千秋万世。

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Banshee-44.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：班西-44处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: I will draw them in, then take them out.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我把他们引进来，然后一个也出不去。

description.en: Capable of healing allies and hurting foes. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and bestows restoration to your allies.
description.zh-CN: 能够治疗盟友和伤害对手。对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并为盟友提供恢复。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.en: The Valence has dimmed, but the nature of the Echoes grows clearer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 原子光已经黯淡下来，但回响的本质愈发清晰。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and additional damage resistance from combatants.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供更高的生命值以及对战斗人员的额外伤害抗性。

flavorText.en: For some, a nest. For the rest, a crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 对于某些东西来说，这是巢穴。但对于其他东西来说，这里就是熔炉。

flavorText.en: "I consider them enemies of the Light, no matter what powers they command." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “无论他们拥有何种力量，我都将他们视作光能的敌人。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: For the more Light the worms consume, the hungrier they become.
flavorText.zh-CN: 随着蠕虫吞噬的光能变多，他们也变得更饥饿。

description.zh-CN: 最后一击后短时间内进行填装时可以为收起的武器也进行填装。

flavorText.en: "It is our burden to bear. It never gets easier. But we must carry it." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是我们肩负的重担，它从未减轻，但我们必须扛下去。”——萨瓦拉

flavorText.zh-CN: 与至少一名公会队友共同完成打击。

flavorText.en: It demands a swift and terrible response.
flavorText.zh-CN: 它要求你拥有异常迅捷的反应技能。

description.en: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.
description.zh-CN: 对普通战斗人员造成伤害会提升对高阶敌人的伤害。强力射击会消耗更少层数。

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

description.en: Fires a single heavy-hitting round. Disintegrates targets on impact. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
description.zh-CN: 发射一发高伤害弹药，命中时暴力分解目标。克制屏障勇士。

description.en: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.
description.zh-CN: 与此武器相克的元素最后一击会在短时间内提升伤害。暗影最后一击强化电弧、烈日和虚空武器。光能最后一击强化冰影、缚丝和动能武器。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Imperial Decree. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变帝国法令的外观。解锁皮肤后，此皮肤将能供你帐户中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.
description.zh-CN: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。

flavorText.en: It's very popular.
flavorText.zh-CN: 非常流行。

flavorText.en: Energy output depends upon mass input.
flavorText.zh-CN: 能量输出取决于质量输入。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.zh-CN: 可粘附在目标身上并发生两次爆炸的手雷。

flavorText.en: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “你身上最宝贵的器官就是你的大脑。用这块特制的碳纤维头饰来保护它的安全吧。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter

flavorText.en: The Traveler's arrival rewrote every single theory we used to hold about the Universe and its ways.

description.en: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.

flavorText.en: "If you step to war, you'd best step with a plan." —Lady Perun

flavorText.en: "It's not a game. …Well, it is a game. But it's more than that. Ah, Shaxx says it better. Go ask him." —Cayde-6

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: The tune is the same, but the aim couldn't be more different.

flavorText.en: The sea covers all the world with its outspread hand. I am in the sea but not of it.

description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠新王派期间通过洗掠遗失区域缓存箱来使用声誉。

flavorText.en: The joy of the fight. The call of the battle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战斗的乐趣。战斗的召唤。

flavorText.en: In my experience, there's no such thing as luck.
flavorText.zh-CN: 根据我的经验，世上没有所谓的运气。

flavorText.en: "Lord Kandak is 'considering' our appeal for more protection. Sidenote: When the Warlord took out his Ghost, Enitan fled the assembly. Why? She still claims amnesia." —Annals of the Saharan Contested Zone
flavorText.zh-CN: “领主坎达克正在‘考虑'我们寻求更多保护的诉求。备注：当督军摧毁他的机灵之后，艾妮坦逃离了议会。为什么？她依然声称自己失忆。”——撒哈拉争议地区编年史

flavorText.en: "Some friendships, even death itself cannot sunder." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些友谊，连死亡都无法使其破裂。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "Thy duty is thy bond. Protect the defenseless. Conquer all fear." —A tenet of the Iron Will
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的职责就是你的契约。保护那些手无寸铁的人吧。去征服一切恐惧。”——钢铁意志教条

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: From infinitesimally small parts come great works.
flavorText.zh-CN: 由无限小的组件合成的伟大作品。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: The seed of the unknown, which sprouts into yawning absence. Sustain your allies with the destruction of those who oppose you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在慵懒的虚无中萌发的未知种子。消灭对手来维持盟友的生命。

flavorText.en: Food for the schism between allies and enemies. Protect those close to you with a barrier of distilled time.
flavorText.zh-CN: 盟友和敌人之间分裂的养料。用浓缩时间的屏障保护身边的人。

flavorText.en: A dilation in space used to manipulate the timing of Void abilities. Press the attack to double down on your advantage.
flavorText.zh-CN: 用来操纵虚空技能时机的空间膨胀。按下攻击键，进一步加强你的优势。

flavorText.en: A handful of lavender ribbons, gently wrapped around your forearm. This gift from the Saint reminds you not to just roll with the punches—send them back twice as hard.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一把紫色缎带，轻轻缠绕在你的前臂上。这份来自圣人的礼物提醒你不仅要承受打击，更得加倍奉还。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 头盔护甲模组

flavorText.en: Don't let them see you sweat.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别让他们看见你流汗。

flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

flavorText.en: Don't rest on 'em.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别沉溺于胜利。

description.en:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
description.zh-CN:
此武器会对载具和构造体造成额外伤害。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

flavorText.en: "For one who analyzes battle as the philosopher questions the universe." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了将分析战争作为宇宙哲学问题的人。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "For you as much as for them. They are observing your thoughts." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了你也为了他们。他们在观察你的思想。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "The face of war continues to change. In this timeline, Cabal. In another, Vex. And in this other one—we have no name for what we saw." —RECORD 614-CHASM-8299
flavorText.zh-CN: “战争的表象不断改变。在这条时间线里，是卡巴尔。在另一条中，是Vex。而在这条中——我们甚至叫不出我们面对的是什么。”——记录614-裂谷-8299

flavorText.en: Banshee would be proud.
flavorText.zh-CN: 班西会为你骄傲的。

flavorText.en: "Some know the legend. We rose from the ashes of a dying world to save humanity from itself." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些人知道这则传说：我们从这个垂死世界的灰烬中站起来，就是为了拯救人类不被自己毁灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "The Traveler didn't run, it rose up to meet the enemy."
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者没有逃跑，而是起身迎敌。”

flavorText.en: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——

description.zh-CN: 发射自推进微型导弹，命中时爆炸造成高伤害。使用此武器造成最后一击会填装狂飙并溢装一发额外伤害弹药。

flavorText.en: To be an Exo is to forget. But sometimes there are clues in the shapes of the holes…
flavorText.zh-CN: 成为Exo就要遗忘一切。但有时候空洞的形状也能透露出蛛丝马迹……

flavorText.en: What is the structure of the universe?
flavorText.zh-CN: 宇宙有着怎样的结构？

flavorText.en: I creep unseen through the darkness.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我在黑暗中隐秘潜行。

flavorText.en: You will destroy them one cell at a time.
flavorText.zh-CN: 您将把细胞一个个毁灭。

flavorText.en: The dawn is coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 黎明将至。

description.en: Detect enemies on your radar from farther away.
description.zh-CN: 侦测雷达上位于远处的敌人。

flavorText.en: Complete Gambit matches, collect Elemental Orbs using a matching [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] subclass, and, as a team, defeat opposing Guardians in the Crucible or Gambit using Arc weapons.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成智谋比赛；使用匹配 /  / 的分支职业收集元素光球；组队在熔炉竞技场或智谋中使用电弧武器消灭敌方守护者。

flavorText.en: The weak will be consumed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 弱者将被吞噬。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: Who's up for a cuppa?
flavorText.zh-CN: 谁想来杯茶？

flavorText.en: A metaphysical bust: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件玄学胸甲：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "You have the hands of an artist. Fortunately for us, one of those arts is war." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “你有着一双艺术家的手。对于我们来说，幸运的是，战争也是一种艺术。”——第三百夫长猎人，里斯本-13

flavorText.en: "A hand, lying on the grass, in one future. A head in another. Components scattered across six visions. All identifiable. I agree. We cannot tell her. Take this off the—" —RECORD 784-CHASM-1016
flavorText.zh-CN: “一只手，在一片草坪上，在一个未来。一个头，在另一个未来。身体部位被切割到了六个景象中。均可识别。我同意了，我们不能告诉她。把这个拿下来吧——”——记录784-裂谷-1016

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从拉克希米-2处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: You value risk. You crave reward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你重视冒险，你渴望回报。

flavorText.en: "I will forge you into a weapon stronger than any blade." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我会将你铸造成一件绝世兵器。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是沐浴在同一光能下的独特气息。”——永劫教派

description.en:
Deliver this unfortunate reminder of Asher's past to him in the Rupture on Io.

Available only during the Dawning.
description.zh-CN:
把这个让他想起自己不幸过去的点心送给木卫一裂口中的阿什。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 未被发现的食谱

flavorText.en: The Traveler's arrival rewrote every single theory we used to hold about the Universe and its ways.
flavorText.zh-CN: 旅行者的到来改写了我们过去有关宇宙及其规律的所有理论。

description.en: Fires a three-round burst.
description.zh-CN: 可进行三发连射。

description.en:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
description.zh-CN:
穿梭于位面之间以颠覆物理定律。

[超能附技能]  ：传送一小段距离并放出削弱追踪弹。

[超能主技能]  ：释放一次致命虚空爆发。完全充能的攻击可对目标施加不稳定效果。

description.en:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
description.zh-CN:
向目标抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹可产生一个奇点，将目标拉入其中，并对困在其中的敌人造成持续性伤害。

description.en:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
description.zh-CN:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

flavorText.en: I see the game. I raise the stakes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我看到这游戏，我提高了赌注。

flavorText.en: You're it!
flavorText.zh-CN: 就是你了！

flavorText.en: A bell that shakes with the remembrance of its final toll. It will sound again with the proper touch.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为铭记终结而颤动的钟声。触碰得当将会再次响起。

flavorText.en: A championship ring, dented and dirtied. They'll try to stop you in your tracks. Get up close and personal.
flavorText.zh-CN: 饱经风霜的冠军戒指。他们会尽力阻止你前进。冲上去了结他们。

flavorText.en: An orb of dancing plasma, you hold the power of raw lightning in your fist. One strike is all you need.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个舞动的等离子能量球，你的拳中握有原始闪电的力量。一击就足够。

flavorText.en: A lantern shattered by lightning strikes between dueling Warlords on the front lines of conflict—it is held in time between destruction and reformation. Your voice fills with a commanding thunder as you look upon its light and prepare to charge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在冲突前线的战争领主对决中，一盏灯笼被闪电击碎，屹立于毁灭与重塑之间。当你注视它的光芒准备冲锋时，你的声音充满了雷霆般的威严。

description.en: Gain an additional bonus engram on a Daily Focus activity in Ops.
description.zh-CN: 在行动的日常专注活动中获得额外的记忆水晶。

description.en: Upgrade this armor to Artifice armor to unlock this mod socket.
description.zh-CN: 将此护甲升级为诡计护甲来解锁此模组插槽。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 诡计护甲模组

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "The Dreadnaught is a blighted hollow gouged into our universe." ―Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “无畏战舰是我们宇宙中的一个凋零空洞。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: I wish to be brave.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿英勇无畏。

flavorText.en: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是沐浴在同一光能下的独特气息。”——永劫教派

description.en: Hold down the trigger to charge up a tracking shot that explodes and burns on impact.
description.zh-CN: 按住扳机充能成为一次追踪射击，可在击中目标时爆炸并燃烧。

description.en: Charging this weapon unleashes a giant continuous beam of death.
description.zh-CN: 充能武器时释放一道持续的巨型死亡光束。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon collapse victims into Void Transmutation spheres.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器完成最后一击可使受害者瓦解为虚空蜕变球体。

flavorText.en: "Every day is a recommitment to my path." —Elsie Bray
flavorText.zh-CN: “每一天都是在重复我所走过的道路。”——艾尔茜·布瑞

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Forerunner. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变先驱者的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "Daito's property? You only own a thing 'till someone takes it from you. So nah, this beauty belongs to you now." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “Daito的所有品？直到夺取之前，这东西都不是你的。所以，现在这东西是属于你的了。”——浪客

flavorText.en: LUSIADS: A sea captain journeys to India to avenge his brother Vali, but finds peace.
flavorText.zh-CN: 卢西塔尼亚人之歌：一个船长前往印度为自己的兄弟瓦利复仇，但却寻得宁静祥和。

description.en: Precision final blows and rapid precision hits briefly grant bonus handling, range, rate of fire, and precision damage with this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 精准最后一击和快速精准击杀会短暂提供武器额外的操控性、射程、射速和精准伤害。

description.en: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield. Also increases weapon handling.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器打破战斗护盾可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。若能量武器与战斗护盾伤害类型吻合，击中目标时可重生弹药。还可提升武器操控性。

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

flavorText.en: "Feast, my comrades. Torobatl may be lost, but its spirit lives on in our traditions." —Empress Caiatl
flavorText.zh-CN: “盛宴吧，我的战友们。图罗巴特尔也许已经离我们而去，但是它的精神永存。”——女帝查厄托

description.en: No mod currently selected.
description.zh-CN: 当前未选择模组。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 胸部护甲模组

flavorText.en: Let them fall. You will salvage what remains.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们倒下吧，你将扫净他们的残骸。

description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: Strand's not the only way to have a green thumb.
flavorText.zh-CN: 搞园艺也能收获一片绿，不一定要靠缚丝。

flavorText.en: "That's no ordinary dust. You're standing on the pulverized remnants of 1 Ceres." —Corsair Anzani Lyle
flavorText.zh-CN: “那不是普通的尘土，你正站在谷神星粉碎遗骸之上。”——海盗军阿扎尼·莱尔

flavorText.en: "You'll never know truth with real certainty. All you can do is hew away at preconception with the facts and pray that whatever shape's left at the end is a reasonable facsimile." —Dagget-4, Hidden analyst
flavorText.zh-CN: “你永远无法真正确定地了解真相。你能做的就是用事实打破先入为主的观念，并祈祷最后留下的形状是个比较还原的描摹。”——达盖特-4，隐秘者分析师

description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球后，此武器造成的下一次最后一击将提供额外特殊弹药量表进度。提升可叠加次数上限。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the apex of your slaying potential. Should you wish it, this system shall die—from the inside—and make way for what's coming. O champion mine." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你杀戮潜能的极限。只要你愿意，整个星系将会灭亡——从内部死去——为即将到来的一切让路，让我的勇士通行。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Increased agility while airborne.
description.zh-CN: 提升腾空时的灵敏度。

description.zh-CN: 提升充能时间和填装速度；蹲伏时射击不产生雷达信号。提高稳定性和填装速度。

flavorText.en: This is hell, nor am I out of it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这就是地狱，而我未曾脱身。

sourceString.en: Source: The Edge of Fate Campaign

flavorText.en: "I was at the Final Attempt. I saw a Guardian wield a gun that left molten gold in her wake. I ran and never looked back." —Avrok, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “我曾在终结之图。我看见一个守护者拿着一把枪，在她所过之处留下熔金之色。我逃跑了，头也不回。”——埃弗罗克，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en: Hold on 'til midnight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 坚持到午夜。

sourceString.en: Source: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在“往日之苦”突袭中获得。

flavorText.en: "We are the trusted dawn. Long forgotten, but now returned." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Herio Sect"
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是被信仰的曙光。被遗忘已久，而今重返尘世。”——《赫罗教派纲领》节选

flavorText.en: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道你怎么想的，但我越来越喜欢欧洲无人区了。真的，到处都是苔藓。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的伟业便是死亡，并活在那死亡之中。”

flavorText.en: It's possible for an Exo to confuse their armor as part of their body: but then, y'see, they'll feel naked.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个Exo也许会将自己的盔甲误认为身体的一部分：但你瞧，那样一来的话，他们就会觉得自己一丝不挂了啊。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我爱圣城。但我不愿回去。我想把圣城建到欧洲无人区来。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

description.en:
While your Solar Super is charged, ability final blows cure you and give stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, grenade and Shieldburst final blows trigger an ignition. Each stack increases grenade regeneration, class ability regeneration, and Super damage. Upon exiting your Super, all stacks are converted into Super energy.
description.zh-CN:
你的烈日超能完成充能时，技能最后一击会治愈你并提供日焰熔炉层数。

日焰熔炉生效期间，手雷和盾爆最后一击会触发一次点燃。每层效果都会增加手雷回复、职业技能回复以及超能伤害。超能结束后，所有层数都会转化为超能能量。

description.en: Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.
description.zh-CN: 超能可生成一颗额外的能量球。生成屏障、在屏障后造成持续伤害或击败目标时会产生一股具有治疗功能的脉冲。治疗盟友可提供屏障能量。

description.en: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves. Final blows with Auto Rifles or Machine Guns boost their stability, ammo generation, and damage. Provides a moderate benefit to their airborne effectiveness.
description.zh-CN: 可从弹药储备中稳步填装已装备自动步枪或机枪的部分弹药。中幅提高自动步枪和机枪的空中效率属性。

During Solstice 2021:
- Complete public events on Europa or Battlegrounds from Season of the Chosen.
- Collect Void or Stasis Elemental Orbs in strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlists.

至日英雄2021期间：
-在木卫二完成公共事件或完成天选赛季的战场。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你启发潜能的极限。只要你愿意，整个星系就会因你的想法所化身而成的武器而灭亡，并敞开道路，让我的勇士通行。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.zh-CN:
“舞动起来吧！在外面，在家里……都可以。跟着节奏律动吧，好吗？”——伊娃·莱万特

description.en:
• Traveler's Blessings have a chance to be awarded from most chests in the Traveler's Pale Heart. This includes Cyst chests, Lost Sector chests, Overthrow Level 2 and Level 3 encounter chests, Pathfinder Field Assignment chests, and Triage chests.

• Each daily reset, a Lost Sector, Cyst, or Overthrow grant a guaranteed Traveler's Blessing upon completion. Look on the Traveler's Pale Heart map to find out which activity grants a guaranteed blessing!

• Traveler's Blessings awarded from the above sources will always be chosen from the list of expired Traveler's Blessings.

• Once acquired, Traveler's Blessings can be used for 27 hours before expiring.
description.zh-CN:
• 旅行者苍白之心的大多数宝箱有一定几率奖励旅行者的祝福。具体而言，包括囊肿宝箱、遗失区域宝箱、颠覆等级2和等级3遭遇战宝箱、寻路者外勤任务宝箱、分诊宝箱。

• 每次日常重置后，遗失区域、囊肿或颠覆活动完成时必定奖励一次旅行者的祝福。查看旅行者苍白之心地图，找出必定奖励祝福的活动！

• 上述来源奖励的旅行者的祝福将始终从已过期的旅行者的祝福列表中选取。

• 获得奖励后，旅行者的祝福将在27小时后过期。

flavorText.en: The galaxy feels smaller now. It's not a pleasant feeling.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如今觉得银河系更小了。这种感觉不太好。

Subroutine IKELOS: Status=reinitiated.
APOTHEOSIS: Status=active…
flavorText.zh-CN:
子程序似像者：状态=已恢复。
神化：状态=激活……

flavorText.en: All that tread below will learn that we, the Optimacy, dwell above.
flavorText.zh-CN: 所有底层人士都将知道我们上层社会。

flavorText.en: Nothing can keep you down. Nothing!
flavorText.zh-CN: 没有任何东西能阻拦你。绝不可能！

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变深埋血脉的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Light the sky.
flavorText.zh-CN: 照亮天空。

description.zh-CN: 此武器升级为大师杰作后将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: "This won't end well for one of us. And darling, it won't be me." —Self-styled "Lady" Olu Alderdice
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们其中一个人下场不会太好看。当然亲爱的，那个人不会是我。”——自封的欧卢·奥德黛丝“夫人”

flavorText.en: Ice can grind mountains to dust. These will get the job done.
flavorText.zh-CN: 冰能将山脉磨成尘埃。这些家伙应该能完成任务。

flavorText.en:
“It is your turn. These people will follow you to the very end. Remember that we were forged in Light.”
 —Aodh, Second Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
flavorText.zh-CN:
“轮到你了，这些人将追随你到最后一刻。谨记光能铸就了我们。”
——奥德，二级炎阳天空法官

flavorText.en:
"Have you ever stared into the green soulfire flame? There is terror, but also… something warm."
—Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN:
“你是否凝视过幽绿的灵魂之焰？那里有恐惧，但也有……温暖。”
——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: When have you ever known Hunters to do as they were told?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你见过受命令约束的猎人吗？

flavorText.zh-CN: “选择吧！原则与力量不可兼得。”——蛛王

flavorText.zh-CN: 一支军团配备了成千上万发子弹。俊敏的泰坦可以穿过枪林弹雨而毫发无损。

flavorText.en: "Hey, if it works for computers…" —Marcus Ren
flavorText.zh-CN: “嘿，如果在计算机上能用的话……”——马库斯·伦

flavorText.en: You rove vicious. Illimitable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你行走于危险之地，无边无际。

flavorText.en: Hold close your own.
flavorText.zh-CN: 把握你拥有的一切。

flavorText.en: "I see our path ahead, full of despair and hardship, and I will walk it with joy in my heart." —Sjur Eido
flavorText.zh-CN: “我看见前方的道路，遍布绝望及苦难，而我将心中充满愉悦踏上旅途。”——苏尔·艾多

flavorText.en: That wasn't funny. Get. Out.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不好笑，滚出去。

flavorText.en: "Bet I can get to 15-6-6 Icarus before you can!" —Tallu Fairwind
flavorText.zh-CN: “我赌我能在你之前抵达15-6-6伊卡洛斯！”——塔鲁·和风

flavorText.en: "They say a little competition brings out the best in everyone. Brings out the worst in me." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们说，一点点小竞争能激发出每个人最好的一面。可这却激发出了我最糟糕的一面。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Remain vigilant. A threat detected may be a threat averted." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “保持警惕。提早发现威胁或许就能加以避免。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: Ornate armor forged by the Lords of Iron beneath the Iron Banner.
flavorText.zh-CN: 由铁旗下的钢铁领主铸造的华丽护甲。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Sometimes it's a cosmic event. Sometimes it's a beast from hell. Sometimes it's one man." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “时而是寰宇大典，时而是地狱凶兽，间或区区一人。”——浪客

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

description.en:
Take a balanced form, setting your tang and grip to focus on both offense and defense.

• Rapid final blows grant ammo to this weapon and trigger health regeneration.
• Increases damage against rank-and-file combatants.
description.zh-CN:
采取平衡形态，设置你的柄芯与握把来兼顾进攻和防御。

• 快速最后一击会为此武器提供弹药并触发生命值回复。
• 提升对普通战斗人员的伤害。

flavorText.en: "Travel far and travel wide, and know that you are always welcome home." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “行路千里，跨疆万顷，莫忘身后便是家。”——先知

flavorText.en: Don't outthink your opponents. Outfly them.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无需智取对手，用速度碾压他们。

flavorText.en: "Fight harder! Any less than your best is an insult to the very core of being a Guardian!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “全力战斗！无法倾尽全力是对守护者的莫大耻辱！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.zh-CN: “Vex现在阻止不了我们了。谁都阻止不了我们。”  ——第三百夫长泰坦，雅尔达姆-4

flavorText.en: "I need more data. And… put the lab on yellow alert."  —Dr. Shanice Pell
flavorText.zh-CN: “我需要更多的数据。另外……把实验室设为黄色预警。”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士

flavorText.zh-CN: 荣誉。你的心随着荣誉而跳动。

flavorText.en: After all, isn't lightning better outside the bottle?

flavorText.en: Mastery is written in a thousand repetitions.
flavorText.zh-CN: 精通源自千百次重复。

flavorText.en: Awoken say they feel a sense of terrible loneliness within the helm… a ghost in the mesh.
flavorText.zh-CN: 觉醒者说戴上头盔会觉得无比孤独……如坠入罗网的机灵。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在黑色军械库锻炉中制造。

flavorText.en: Titans brainstormed this high-end pattern for field make. We're not all punch-crazed lunks.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦绞尽脑汁构思了这种高端设计用于制造作战装备。我们并非都是渴望挨揍的笨蛋。

description.en:
Magnetic levitation massively decreases friction, allowing higher bolt velocity.

  •  Decreases persistence
description.zh-CN:
磁悬浮大幅降低摩擦，促成了更快的弩弹速度。
  •  大幅提高弹头速度

description.en: Complete challenges in strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV arms armor.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在打击中完成挑战可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV手臂护甲上解锁。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the apex of your fighting potential. Should you wish it, this system shall fall and make way for what's coming. O champion mine." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你战斗潜能的极限。只要你愿意，整个星系就会灭亡，并敞开道路，让我的勇士通行。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: "Combat without real death is like meat without salt. And yet I am glad to see you living after defeat. Strange how this bland meal suits!" —Bru'uc, Iron War Beast
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有真正死亡的战斗，就像没放盐的肉，但我很高兴看到你战败后活了下来。这清淡的一餐竟也合我口味！”——钢铁战兽布鲁乌克

flavorText.en: Education is not given to be swallowed and forgotten in a gulp. Its savor lasts a lifetime.
flavorText.zh-CN: 教育不是供人一饮而尽、随即忘却的。它的醇香，将萦绕一生。

flavorText.en: "No supplies. Armor in tatters. But the refugees had asked for help. And she had given her word." —Tale of the Six Coyotes
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有补给。护甲破旧不堪。但难民请求援助。而她许下了承诺。”——六狼传说

flavorText.en: "The first step toward truth is to let go of all that we know and hold dear." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “迈向真实的第一步，就是放下我们所知道且珍视的一切。”——蛛族杰尔拉

flavorText.zh-CN: “这些该死的东西到底有多少？”  ——阿图尔·沃洛宁中尉

flavorText.en: "We welcome the Dawning of a new year with hearts open and arms outstretched." —Eva Levante

flavorText.en: Turn your hunger outward, never inward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 把你的饥渴之情对外发泄，不要对内。

flavorText.en: "Earth is our home. Not Mars, not Venus, not even the Reef. We must ensure it is a place we can continue to live for many generations to come." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “地球才是我们的家。不是火星，不是金星，更不是暗礁。我们要确保那是个我们可以几代长久生存下去的地方。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.

flavorText.en: "Since the Scatter, nowhere in the Reef felt like home. Before I knew it, I found myself on the Shore." —Renegade Corsair Errol Mayz
flavorText.zh-CN: “自从散战以来，无处如暗礁一般有家的感觉。在我意识到这一点之前，我发现自己身在海岸之上。”——变节海盗军，埃洛尔·梅兹

flavorText.en: "…and that's how we mapped the entire Cabal warnet by shredding the dance floor." —Unknown
flavorText.zh-CN: “……我们酣畅淋漓地尽情绘制着整个卡巴尔战争网络。”——佚名

flavorText.en: "I know you." —Lord Felwinter
flavorText.zh-CN: “我认识你。”——领主邪冬

flavorText.en: “You are mine, you shall be mine, you and I are one for ever.”
flavorText.zh-CN: “你是我的，你应当是我的，你我永远是一体。”

flavorText.en: "When one can wield the fire of stars, what use is flesh and bone?"
flavorText.zh-CN: “当你能够挥舞星辰之火时，骨肉之躯又有何用呢？”

flavorText.en: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I shall uphold the pillars of existence until the end comes. And when it does…" —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有。没有任何东西能阻止我们。你我将举起存在的支柱直到终末到来。而到了那个时候……”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: "For one who seeks to reach out... and destroy." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了想要抵达……并摧毁的人。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "For the Light who exercises brute force to win an exchange." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了使用暴力赢得战争的光能者。”——玖的使者

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Your game is over.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你出局了。

flavorText.en: "Was Wolf once. Still Wolf after Scatter, but… different. Then Queen's. Wolf again. Bannerless. Then Spider's." —Avrok
flavorText.zh-CN: “曾为狼族，散战后依旧，但却……不同。接着属于女王，又为狼族，无名之狼。再隶蛛王。”——埃弗罗克

description.en: Rounds pierce targets and inflict corruption. Final blows with this weapon leave behind Remnants.

flavorText.en: Overheard on the Zagan Gloriosus: "Not one more Legionary till he produces results. Invoke Bael if necessary."
flavorText.zh-CN: 在赛共荣耀号上偷听到的：“在他拿出成果前，一个军团士兵也别多派。必要时求助于巴埃尔。”

flavorText.en: The search for full-sized bars continues.
flavorText.zh-CN: 继续搜罗标准大小的巧克力棒。

flavorText.en: A single strike can alter the course of history.
flavorText.zh-CN: 单次攻击便可改变历史的走向。

description.en:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

description.en:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
description.zh-CN:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空超能 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空超能 | 光能技能

description.en:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
description.zh-CN:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 烈日超能 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 烈日超能 | 光能技能

description.en:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一根冰影法杖。当超能激活时：

[超能主技能] ：施放由冰影碎片组成的弹幕，冻结敌人。

[超能附技能] ：施放一个震荡波，粉碎所有被冻结的敌人。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

flavorText.en: If you think you're in charge, you're not.

description.en:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

description.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
description.zh-CN:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成近战能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

flavorText.en: Fate will hear your war cry.
flavorText.zh-CN: 命运会聆听你的战吼。

flavorText.en: "Travel far and travel wide, and know that you are always welcome home." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “行路千里，跨疆万顷，莫忘身后便是家。”——先知

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: Lord Saladin keeps his fallen compatriots' memories alive.
flavorText.zh-CN: 领主萨拉丁让战死的爱国同胞的回忆留存了下来。

description.en:
A pared-down rail improves weapon usability.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases persistence
description.zh-CN:
简约的导轨提升了武器的易用性。
  •  提高操控速度
  • 提升坚韧

description.en: Automatically reloads your weapons when you board the vehicle.
description.zh-CN: 在驾驶载具时自动填装武器。

flavorText.en: I wish to be sure-footed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿步履稳健。

flavorText.en: Open and hostile and ready.
flavorText.zh-CN: 公开、敌意、就绪。

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

description.en: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
description.zh-CN: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内提高稳定性和精度。

description.en: Chance to gain a second Crucible token whenever you receive one.
description.zh-CN: 有几率在获得熔炉竞技场代币时获得一枚额外的代币。

flavorText.en: "Executors shall uphold the rights of others with all their strength until a greater leader arises to take that burden." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6
flavorText.zh-CN: “执行者们应该尽力维护他人的利益，直到可接下重担的强大领袖的出现。”——执行者法则，卷6

description.en:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness
description.zh-CN:
弹匣容量大幅提高。填装速度降低。
  •  大幅增大弹匣容量
  •  大幅降低填装速度
  • 增加空中效率

description.en: Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.
description.zh-CN: 将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: Delivering seasonal cheer with unparalleled attention.
flavorText.zh-CN: 用无与伦比的专注力传递赛季喜悦。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Dawning event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：于赛季曙光节活动期间获得。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 头盔护甲模组

flavorText.en: A Guardian's power makes a rich feeding ground. Do not be revolted. There are parasites that may benefit the host… teeth sharper than your own.
flavorText.zh-CN: 守护者的能量会使供养地更加丰盈。不要心生厌恶。那里的寄生物会让寄主……的牙齿比你的更锋利。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

description.en: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped. When MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped, this weapon grants additional speed benefits and final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.
description.zh-CN: 操控性极佳。装备此武器时，移动速度会提高。装备米达多功能时，此武器提供额外移动速度加成，且最后一击会为米达多功能提供改造进度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: "One day we too will meet our final deaths. How do you want to be remembered?" —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “总有一天我们也会死去。你想让人们记住怎样的你？”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: With the Uzume RR4 on your side, the Darkness doesn't stand a chance.
flavorText.zh-CN: 天钿RR4在手，暗影不堪一击。

flavorText.en: Is it possible to touch another mind?
flavorText.zh-CN: 触碰另一颗心灵，这可能吗？

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“永恒沙漠”史诗突袭

flavorText.en: "Their curses are now your charms. Hold such hatreds close, for they reveal their fears." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “现在它们的诅咒之力庇护你的左右。铭记此仇此恨之刻骨，使它们溺于自身的恐惧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "Hold tight to all that remains. It is fleeting, but doesn't have to be." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “珍视一切残存之物。它会转瞬即逝，但却非必然。”——先知

description.en:
Combat Flairs provide a flourish upon defeating targets. They are available on Tier 5 weapons.

This restores your Combat Flair to its default appearance.
description.zh-CN:
战斗特效会在你击败目标时触发华丽效果。常见于5阶武器。

此选项将重置你的战斗特效为默认外观。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化武器模组

flavorText.en: Geometry is the study of perfect beauty.
flavorText.zh-CN: 几何学是对无上完美的研究。

flavorText.en: Your foes will remember your sting.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的敌人会铭记你的刺痛。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

description.en: Gain 10% more XP while on Nessus.
description.zh-CN: 在涅索斯上获取10%的额外经验值。

description.en: Full auto. Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.
description.zh-CN: 全自动。更多的弹药储备。弹匣打空时可略微提高填装速度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

description.en: Improved recovery.
description.zh-CN: 更强的恢复力。

flavorText.en: "Thy duty is thy bond. Protect the defenseless. Conquer all fear." —A tenet of the Iron Will
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的职责就是你的契约。保护那些手无寸铁的人吧。去征服一切恐惧。”——钢铁意志教条

flavorText.en: "Question everything. Accept nothing." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “质疑一切。拒绝一切。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: To enter the body of a deity would be to unquestionably defile it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。

flavorText.en: We celebrate those who brought us here, whether or not they yet stand around the bonfire with us.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂带我们来到这里的人，无论他们是否还在篝火旁陪伴我们。

flavorText.en: "Always bet on the apocalypse. Best case, you're wrong. Worst case… at least your bag's packed." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一定要赌会有大灾难。最好的情况是你赌错了。而如果遇上最糟糕的情况……至少你的背包是满的。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Smash through the veil.
flavorText.zh-CN: 粉碎帷幕。

flavorText.en: A clever Guardian knows which gates to pass through and which ones to pass by.
flavorText.zh-CN: 聪明的守护者会知道该穿过哪些光门。

flavorText.en: Complete the Chosen Redux mission, collect Solar orbs, complete Heroic public events.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版天选任务，收集烈日光球并完成英雄公共事件。

flavorText.en: Great. Just great. That was really, really great.
flavorText.zh-CN: 棒。好棒。啊那不就好棒棒。

flavorText.en: Finger guns are entry level.
flavorText.zh-CN: 手枪只能算入门级。

flavorText.en: These boots left their mark on victory lane.
flavorText.zh-CN: 穿上这双靴子，在胜利之路上留下足迹。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of MIDA Mini-Tool. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变米达迷你的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Thumbs up for ancient technology!
flavorText.zh-CN: 为远古科技点赞！

description.en: Detonating a large number of rounds embedded in a single target suspends them.
description.zh-CN: 引爆单个目标体内大量嵌入的弹药会施加悬停。

flavorText.en: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
flavorText.zh-CN: “这些该死的东西到底有多少？”  ——阿图尔·沃洛宁中尉

flavorText.en: A forceful gift: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件强力礼物：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

description.en: Melee and projectile damage charge this weapon. When fully charged, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to enable a special projectile attack. Projectile final blows create a volatile detonation and grant Volatile Rounds.
description.zh-CN: 近战和射弹伤害可为此武器充能。完全充能时，按下[替换武器动作] 键来启用特殊射弹攻击。射弹最后一击会造成一次不稳定爆炸并提供不稳定弹药。

description.en: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.
description.zh-CN: 全面型握把，可靠耐用。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性
普通 腿部护甲模组

flavorText.en: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The victories borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “藉由我对未来的洞悉，以及你所见和所做的一切……胜利降临了……还有什么能在一切的终末之时阻止我们呢？”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: Pardon me. Coming through.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不好意思。借过一下。

description.en: Defeat enemies using Merciless to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN: 使用冷酷无情消灭敌人可解锁此升级。

description.en: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
flavorText.zh-CN: “星光吾母，黑暗吾父。”——玛拉·索维女王

flavorText.en: "Be sudden and loud." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “哄然勃发。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: The mathematics of war was ever written in blood.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战争的法则总是以鲜血书写。

flavorText.en: "Though we go where none have walked before, we do not tread lightly." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们走在没有人走过的地方，但我们不会畏手畏脚。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

description.en: Holding down the trigger marks targets within range and loads multiple bullets, which fire in a burst with increased stability on trigger release. Hitting a marked target with a fully charged burst will unravel them.
description.zh-CN: 按住扳机，标记射程内的目标并填装多发子弹，松开扳机时在提升稳定性的情况下发射所有填装弹药。使用完全充能的射击命中已标记的目标会施加瓦解。

flavorText.en: "Everything dies. This is proof." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “万物终有一死。此为证据。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: All are welcome. None shall pass.
flavorText.zh-CN: 尽管尝试吧。没人可以通过。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the work that will bring this system together. I'll need your cunning." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了统一这个星系的过程。我会需要你的狡诈。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Equip this ornament with Starfire Protocol to activate a unique visual effect.
description.zh-CN: 用星火协议装备此皮肤配备来激活独特的视觉效果。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: The hotter you burn, the stronger you become.
flavorText.zh-CN: 烈焰越甚，汝力越强。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Izanagi's Burden. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变伊邪那岐的重担的外观。解锁皮肤后，此皮肤将能供你帐户中的所有角色使用。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.
description.zh-CN: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供近战和手雷属性加成。

description.en: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.
description.zh-CN: 随着射弹在爆炸前飞得越远，造成的爆炸伤害就越高。扩大爆炸范围。

flavorText.en: Cause and effect like a looped corridor. I stand. Ever watchful, forever.
flavorText.zh-CN: 因果关系就像一条环形走廊。我站立其中。始终警戒，直至永远。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "Nothing is free. I know that. Therefore, he knows it too. If our places were swapped, he would do the same." —Tomek I
flavorText.zh-CN: “物皆有价，我明白这个道理。所以，他也明白。如果我们交换立场，他也会做同样的事。”——托梅克I

description.en: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.
description.zh-CN: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚制导微型导弹。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.
description.zh-CN: 最后一击将生成更多手雷能量。使用手雷技能将用储存弹药填装此武器。

flavorText.en: Hodiocentrism: the belief that the Traveler is the center of the universe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 旅行者中心说：认为旅行者是宇宙中心的信仰。

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变蠕虫低语的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是沐浴在同一光能下的独特气息。”——永劫教派

flavorText.en: Join the dance of fire and birth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 加入火焰与诞生之舞吧。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: Great! Great! …Good?
flavorText.zh-CN: 很好！很好！…一般好？

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen what must fall so the Empire may rise. Your mastery of war shall make true Cabal of us all." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了帝国的崛起势必要伴随着某事的殒落。你精通战争的技巧让我们见识到了卡巴尔的典范。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.
description.zh-CN: 在高热量状态下，此武器造成更高伤害，并使目标在被击败时爆炸。

flavorText.en: WARNING: Sudden explosions may occur.
flavorText.zh-CN: 警告：可能会发生突然爆炸。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Ever-Present. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变永存者的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: You crave risk. You value reward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你渴望冒险，你重视回报。

flavorText.en: "All this in service of one purpose. You have their attention. Let us see if you can keep it." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “所有这些都是为了一个目的。你引起他们的注意了。看看你能不能保持住。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "Take your moment, survey your surroundings… then dive headfirst into the fray!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “花点时间，调查周围环境…然后一头扎进战斗当中！”——领主沙克斯

description.zh-CN: 当超能激活时，护甲可减少所受到的伤害。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: My will dissolves those who oppose it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我的意志会打垮所有抵抗它的人。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 线性融合步枪

flavorText.en: In the cold of winter, we remember that the warm west wind will blow again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 尽管置身严冬，我们也记得那温暖的西风将再次吹来。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Dawning event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：于赛季曙光节活动期间获得。

flavorText.en: You'll never hear me coming.

description.zh-CN: 充能重攻击会让附近的刀剑使用者每次攻击时发射追踪微型导弹。

flavorText.zh-CN: 最好的防守就是进攻，因为你杀死敌人他们就无法还击。第二好的防守则是精良的护甲。

flavorText.en: You left me with nothing, but now I have everything.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你没有给我留下任何东西，但现在我拥有了一切。

flavorText.en: “The Sindu fly like surgeons operate. And the Ace-Defiants are the best among them. Only one Shadowed me.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “信德飞起来就像进行外科手术一样精确，王牌猎手又是他们中的精英。但只有一个跟得上我。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Sunshot. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变烈日弹丸的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: Let them fall. You will salvage what remains.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们倒下吧，你将扫净他们的残骸。

flavorText.en: "One day we too will meet our final deaths. How do you want to be remembered?" —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “总有一天我们也会死去。你想让人们记住怎样的你？”——领主萨拉丁

description.en: Reroll the bonus provided by this Masterwork.
description.zh-CN: 重新分配此大师杰作提供的奖励。

flavorText.en: "Told my new recruits about your fisticuffs in Meridian Bay. One of 'em didn't believe me. Wanna give him a talking to?" —Holborn to Wei Ning
flavorText.zh-CN: “跟我的新兵讲讲你在子午线海湾发生的那场战斗吧。他们有人竟然不相信我。想跟他聊聊吗？”——霍尔本对韦宁说

description.en: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的拉弓速度快得难以置信。提高填装速度。

flavorText.en: "If I fail, let me be worm food."
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果我失败了，就让我成为蠕虫的养料吧。”

flavorText.zh-CN: 你需要的一切就是一把好枪和一辆快车。

flavorText.en: Scholars disagree on whether the mythical dragonfly ever really existed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 对神秘蜻蛉是否真正存在过的问题，学者们莫衷一是。

flavorText.en: Your enemies will see the signs of your approach. They will not be able to stop you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的敌人会察觉到你在靠近，但他们无法阻止你。

flavorText.zh-CN: 尸飕曾渴望滋养。融入曾助它实现。

flavorText.en: He was claimed by the Vault. His armor and myth are all that remain.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他死在保险库中，只留下了他的护甲和传说。

flavorText.en: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “这个古老创伤的圣物受到邪魔族魔法的束缚，就像是旧伤疤上的新绷带。”——埃里斯·摩恩

description.en: While holding down the trigger, every fourth bullet becomes a heavy projectile that makes targets volatile on impact.
description.zh-CN: 按住扳机时，每四发子弹中有一发会变成重型射弹，命中时对目标施加不稳定效果。

flavorText.en: The unnerving awareness of the watcher being watched.
flavorText.zh-CN: 监视者受到监视的不安感。

flavorText.en: Then she remembered. The fireteam. The gate. The desperate plan. "Tuyet! Pull me out!" No response.
flavorText.zh-CN: 然后她想起了，火力战队、传送门、孤注一掷的计划。“图耶特！把我弄出去！”没有回应。

flavorText.en: "The more we danced, the more the Cabal battlenet lit up with requests for intelligence…" —Unknown
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的战争舞蹈越甚，卡巴尔战争网络对智慧的要求就越甚……”——佚名

flavorText.en: "All the vastness of our universe is but a blank page on which they scrawl their words of hate and death." ―Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的广袤宇宙只是一张白纸，由他们在上面书写着仇恨和死亡的文字。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.zh-CN: “在危险面前毫无畏惧不是勇敢。那要么是愚蠢…要么是疯狂。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "It is our burden to bear. It never gets easier. But we must carry it." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是我们肩负的重担，它从未减轻，但我们必须扛下去。”——萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “祝贺你找到为其拼搏一生的真正职业。你是一名……合格的助手。”——阿什·米尔

description.en: Increased loot from public events on all destinations.
description.zh-CN: 在所有目的地的公共事件中获得更好的战利品。

description.en: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.
description.zh-CN: 根据填装之前完成的快速击杀数可过量填充弹匣。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: "A fire cannot burn forever. The embers crack and dance, then drift softly into the ether." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “火的燃烧总有尽头。余烬碎裂起舞，然后轻柔地化为虚无。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "It is fuel. Use it to fight harder." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是燃料，带着它更努力地战斗。”——领主沙克斯

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

description.en: Burst fire Grenade Launcher. Each projectile creates a lingering pool on impact that deals damage over time.
description.zh-CN: 具有点射功能的榴弹发射器。每个射弹命中时都会留下一个造成持续伤害的区域。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。
