itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 猎人通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "There's a new player over on the Shore. He calls himself 'Crow.' As if trying to rub our prince's death in our faces." —Report from Paladin Hallam Fen
flavorText.zh-CN: “海岸来了新客，他自称为‘乌鸦'。似乎想当我们的面炫耀我们王子的死。”——圣骑士霍拉姆·凡的报告

description.en: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores an improved amount of health.
description.zh-CN: 在多个战斗人员或梦魇附近完成最后一击可恢复更多生命值。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from the Trials of Osiris.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从奥斯里斯试炼中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

description.en:
Recurve Bow. Draw quickly and move faster while this weapon is equipped. 
[Reload]  : Use while drawn to cancel the shot.
description.zh-CN:
反曲弓。装备此武器时拉弓和移动速度更快。
[填装] ：拉弓时使用以取消射击。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: “The Sindu inhabited gas giants in the spinward marches. They refused my invitation at first. As with all things, they came to see things my way.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “信德在螺旋世界的气态巨行星上居住。起初他们拒绝了我的邀请。但和其他种族一样，他们随后意识到臣服才是唯一的出路。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: The next time we meet.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们再次相遇时。

flavorText.en: You crave risk. You value reward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你渴望冒险，你重视回报。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在至日期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

description.en: Deliver these delicious and nostalgic treats to Eris Morn on the Moon.
description.zh-CN: 给月球的埃里斯·摩恩送去这些美味而怀旧的小食。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 已发现的食谱

flavorText.en: Forged in honor of Weyloran, and roads yet traveled.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为向维洛然及其尚未探索的道路致敬而铸造。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Malfeasance. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变渎职的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: Tex Mechanica custom-made hat. Keeps the eyes clear of every which weather, so your shot is true.
flavorText.zh-CN: 特克斯机械定制帽子。让眼睛不受任何天气的影响，助你百步穿杨。

description.en: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 此武器可在持用者保持移动时获得短时间的稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "You're honest. You're true. If anyone can handle the responsibility of this power, it's you." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “你很诚实。你也很真挚。如果说有谁能承担得了这种力量所带来的责任，那也只可能是你了。”——第三百夫长术士，雷卡纳

flavorText.en: "If I could do everything over again, walk in my shoes a second time, I would do it all differently." —Reed-7, Exo Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “要是我的一切能从头再来，也许我会走一条完全不同的路。”——里德-7，Exo泰坦

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "I was of kings. Then of exiles. Now I'm here. The Shore is bad… but everywhere else is worse." —Brivi, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “吾曾为王，后治流刑，今至此。海岸非善地……奈何他处弥恶。”——布里维，译自埃里克斯尼语

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: Sit like a Titan.
flavorText.zh-CN: 像泰坦一样坐下。

flavorText.en: "Remember why we fight." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住我们为何而战。”——领主萨拉丁

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

description.en: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.
description.zh-CN: 在未装备群居者的情况下，机器人榴弹可快速从储备弹药转移到弹匣中。

description.en: Equip this item to change your Ghost's projection.
description.zh-CN: 装备此物品以改变机灵投影。

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一副末世既临之容，一双厄土天赐之眼；观其形貌，便知逃无生天。”——浪客

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of the Queenbreaker. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变弑后者的外观。你帐号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "Be mindful of the countless miles ahead. They will test even the bravest among us." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “留心漫漫前路，纵使人中之龙也难一马平川。”——先知

flavorText.en: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
flavorText.zh-CN: “这些该死的东西到底有多少？”  ——阿图尔·沃洛宁中尉

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

description.en:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

description.en: Upgrade this armor to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this armor will forge a Masterwork, which provides a bonus to all stats.
description.zh-CN: 升级此护甲，使其能量上限提高1。完全升级此护甲至大师杰作可提供全属性加成。

flavorText.en: "But here you are. This is truly a beginning…" —Shin Malphur
flavorText.zh-CN: “但你来了。这是一个真正的开始…”——骏·马尔福

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: Get Super kills in the EDZ while pledged to New Monarchy to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Sovereign Boots, Greaves, and Legs.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠新王派期间在欧洲无人区完成超能击杀可获得此皮肤。于君主战靴、胫甲和护腿上解锁。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice 2022.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在2022至日英雄期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.en: A metaphysical brace: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件玄学护腿：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Function: Go all in.
flavorText.zh-CN: 功能：赌上一切。

flavorText.en: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I are pillars of this existence, and shall be until all comes crashing down." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有。没有任何东西能阻止我们。你我就是这存在的支柱，直到一切都分崩离析。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Upgrade this armor to improve its 3 lowest stats by 1, up to a maximum of 5 in each when upgraded to a Masterwork.
description.zh-CN: 升级此护甲可提升3项最低属性各1点，升级为大师杰作时单项最高可达5点。

flavorText.en: Take a break from the chaos.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在混乱中小歇一会儿。

flavorText.en: Employ the power of music!
flavorText.zh-CN: 注入音乐的力量！

description.en: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume your grenade to load a large [projectile|shape|language] that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.
description.zh-CN: [替换武器动作] ：消耗你的手雷，为你的武器装填一枚大型[射弹|形状|语言]。命中时它会造成一次元素爆炸，并在超凡生效的情况下造成更高伤害。

flavorText.en: Your heart knows the most pure of innocence.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的内心，藏着最纯净的纯真。

sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "Your work today was more than acceptable. It was adequate." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “你今天的成绩不只是凑合，可以说是相当凑合。”——阿什·米尔

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：木卫一上的探险“悬崖征服者”

flavorText.en: Strike like a serpent.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如毒蛇出击。

description.en: Improves rewards from eliminating Hive enemies.
description.zh-CN: 消灭邪魔族敌人可获得更好的奖励。

flavorText.en: "Lies are manufactured. Truth grows naturally… with or without a gardener." —Nayyir Gimenez, Warlock
flavorText.zh-CN: “谎言是人造的。真理是天然生长的…无论有没有园丁。”——内伊尔·吉梅内兹，术士

flavorText.en: We are all burdened by the chains of our past.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们都背负着过去的枷锁。

flavorText.en: Take the lost by the hand and lead them ever here, ever home.
flavorText.zh-CN: 执失落者之手，带领他们来到这里，返归故乡。

flavorText.en: "They don't make Dark Age tech like this anymore. Lucky for you I kept all mine." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们不再制造这样的黑暗纪元科技了。你真幸运，我都留着呢。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen what must fall so the Empire may rise. Your mastery of knowledge apocryphal shall make true Cabal of us all." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了帝国的崛起势必要伴随着某事的殒落。你对外经的渊博学问让我们见识到了卡巴尔的典范。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.zh-CN: 长按以飞跃到空中。松开后施放一次强力的冲刺攻击，击退目标，并在目标身上粘附一个延迟冰影炸药。

flavorText.en: "Captain, the orbit of 7066 Nessus is different from what Cosmodrome calculated." —Flight Officer Samantha Blaise
flavorText.zh-CN: “船长，7066涅索斯的轨道与发射基地的计算结果不同。”——飞行官萨曼莎·布莱兹

flavorText.en: Your spear leaps to meet your foe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的长矛跃起迎敌。

flavorText.en: Complete the Payback Redux mission, defeat enemies with Arc melee abilities, and complete Heroic strikes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版偿还任务，使用电弧近战技能消灭敌人，完成英雄打击。

description.en: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.
description.zh-CN: 在受到伤害时进行防护可产生职业技能能量。

flavorText.en: "Cut anchor if things get messy. There's always another score." —Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “打不赢就赶紧跑。别在一棵树上吊死。”——浪客

flavorText.en: A Legionary packs thousands of slug rounds. A nimble Titan can survive every last one.

flavorText.zh-CN: 石化之握，抓取某些曾经存在但已经消失的东西。你的双手能从虚无中产生力量。

flavorText.zh-CN: 一个永恒不灭的意识，被晶体化之后停留在单一时刻。被禁锢者将会在你靠近时碎裂。

flavorText.en: Don't leave me hangin'.
flavorText.zh-CN: 别让我在这干等着。

description.en: Increased health recovery.

flavorText.en: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “祝贺你找到为其拼搏一生的真正职业。你是一名……合格的助手。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: That's hilarious.
flavorText.zh-CN: 真有趣。

flavorText.en: "Adjust course two degrees. It's a long way to Kepler-186, folks. We don't have time to tour Nessus." —Capt. Masoud Jacobson

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在土星卫星，土卫六上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Cast down your greatest foes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 击倒你最强大的敌人。

flavorText.en: "I once defended this city from the Fallen. As did many Lights no longer with us today. Now these walls shelter the House of Light. I could be bitter… but there's something poetic in that." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我曾守护这座城市免受堕落者的侵害。许多过世的光能战士也是如此。现在，这些高墙开始庇护光能氏族。我有些不快…但这事确实有点诗意。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: There is no winning the ancient game of blood, tooth, and claw.

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: The mightiest foes cower before you, Guardian.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最强大的敌人也会在你的面前畏缩不已，守护者。

flavorText.en:
Complete the Spark Redux mission, get Super final blows in the Crucible, and defeat Guardians in the Crucible.

Generate Elemental Orbs by wearing the full Solstice armor set during the Solstice event.
flavorText.zh-CN:
完成终极版花火任务，在熔炉竞技场中获得超能最后一击，在熔炉竞技场中击败守护者。

flavorText.en: Hope burns brightest among broken things.
flavorText.zh-CN: 破碎之物中能燃起最猛烈的希望之火。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 已发现的食谱

一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

flavorText.en: There comes a whisper in an ancient tongue: "You are worthy. Remember us."

flavorText.en: Duty. Honor. Pride.

flavorText.zh-CN: 我将是派对上最后熄灭的一道光。

flavorText.en: “Calus had won. But he took nothing from us. Instead he gave us everything we needed to end our perpetual war.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
flavorText.zh-CN: “卡鲁斯赢了。但他没有从我们夺走任何东西。相反，他赐予了我们用以终结这场旷日持久的战争的一切。”——卡佳·克里普斯之枪，鲁尔

flavorText.en: "I might not be a Guardian, but they've reminded us you don't need the Light to be a hero."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我也许不是守护者，但他们提醒我们，成为英雄不一定需要光能。”

flavorText.en: "You will go where none have gone before. Tread carefully." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “你将行前人未行之路，请谨小慎微。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: We celebrate those we fight with, day after day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂与我们并肩作战的伙伴，日复一日。

flavorText.en: "Let them have the Great Machine. They deserve it." —Mithrax, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “就让他们拥有那伟大的机器吧，他们应得的。”——米瑟拉克斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: Ask the question.
flavorText.zh-CN: 问那个问题。

flavorText.en: Everything ends. When you meet yours, take them all with you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一切皆有终结。当你的结局到来时，接纳它的全部。

flavorText.zh-CN: 你引发的故事，是他们悲剧的开始。

flavorText.en: "Long, short, they all end the same way." —Katabasis
flavorText.zh-CN: “长也好，短也好，到头来都会在同一天结束。”——冥界旅行

flavorText.en: "Nothing has changed. The Light gives us strength, and we must treat it with respect." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “一切都没变。光能给予我们力量，而我们必须尊重它。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.zh-CN: 你是否曾觉得自己的手有自己的意识？未曾有这种感觉？我们可以帮你纠正。

flavorText.en: "The greatest compliment you can pay in the Crucible is to fight with everything you've got." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “在熔炉竞技场中，你能表现出的最高敬意便是倾尽全力战斗到底。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Focus not on the death, but on the rebirth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 将注意力集中在重生而非死亡之上。

Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.
description.zh-CN:
在你进入鬼灵利刃隐形状态前，你的每次命中或最后一击都会恢复更多的超能能量。

在靠近目标时离开隐形状态，会在你周围产生一团削弱烟雾。

description.en: Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 获得一次额外的闪身充能。在闪身后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

flavorText.zh-CN: “工作无休止。那并不意味着我们可以弃之不顾。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.zh-CN: 她在朱诺深谷中找到他们。一座基地——不，是一个展柜。人类不知道自己身在牢笼。

flavorText.en: “What was she? A creature of the Light? Or the other end of the spectrum? The Councilors never finished their analysis.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “她是什么？光能生物？还是光谱上的另一端？议员们永远不会终止分析。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

description.en:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.
description.zh-CN:
使用动能武器造成最后一击，会根据你已装备超能的元素产生爆炸，造成伤害并施加相应的元素效果：
•  致盲目标。
•  灼烧目标。
•  削弱目标。
•  减速目标。
•  割裂目标。
元素最后一击会提供临时性爆炸范围提升。精准最后一击直接达到最大爆炸范围。

description.en: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.
description.zh-CN: 站在你的光焰之井中时完成击杀和助攻可返还超能能量。

flavorText.en: "No tomb but the battlefield! No legacy but the scars we etch upon our foes!"
flavorText.zh-CN: “战场是我们的坟墓！刻在敌人身上的疤痕是我们的遗产！”

flavorText.en: "You know what I believe? Whatever I can get my hands on."
flavorText.zh-CN: “你知道我相信什么吗？我相信我能拥有的一切。”

flavorText.en: Defeat combatants in strike playlists using a subclass that matches the [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] Day, defeat combatants in the European Aerial Zone, and defeat Fallen using a subclass that matches the [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] Day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用匹配 /  / 日的分支职业在打击游戏列表中消灭战斗人员，在欧洲空中区消灭战斗人员，并使用匹配 /  / 日的分支职业消灭堕落者。

flavorText.en: "For the Light who seeks to root their stance as their weapon consumes the enemy." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了那些追求消灭敌人后立足于世的光能者。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "For the Light who seeks to be immovable." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了想要变得坚强的人。”——玖的使者

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

Subroutine IKELOS: Status=reinitiated.

Armor configured for Guardians that believe all good plans should include a well-placed explosive.

flavorText.en: Just let me rest my eyes for a minute.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让我的眼睛眯一会儿。

description.zh-CN: 毁灭铭刻炮台部署时，此武器可使用其激光射弹标记目标。炮台会优先攻击被标记的目标，向其发射更强力的弹药。按下[替换武器动作] 切换普通射击或激光射击模式。

description.en:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed for a longer duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
description.zh-CN:
对勇士、初级首领或首领战斗人员造成持续伤害会使他们疲惫，并在更长的时间内赋予此武器操控性和填装速度。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

flavorText.en: What secrets did you bring today?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你今天又带来了什么秘密？

description.en: This weapon's rate of fire is increased significantly, and fires full auto. Final blows auto load ammo from reserves. Powerful targets fully reload the weapon.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的射速显著提升，且全自动开火。最后一击会从弹药储备中自动填装。击败强力目标会完全填装此武器。

flavorText.en: "And stay out!"
flavorText.zh-CN: “给我滚远点！”

description.zh-CN: 在空中进行跳跃可激活跃升，并上升至更高的高度。

flavorText.en: Make them fall.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一鼓涤荡。

flavorText.en: Your true worth has at last manifested.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你真正的价值终于凸显。

flavorText.en: "Deity turned three eyes from me." —Ir Kithana, Preceptor
flavorText.zh-CN: “神有三眼，避不看我。”——训诫者，伊尔·基萨纳

flavorText.en: "The greatest threat to a Guardian is another Guardian." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “对一名守护者来说，最大的威胁是其他守护者。”——玖的使者

description.en: Precision hits and final blows build Guidance Ring energy. Opposing Guardians grant additional energy. At full charge, hip firing creates a Guidance Ring.
description.zh-CN: 精准命中和最后一击会给指引光环充能。击中敌对守护者可获得额外能量。能量充满时，腰射可产生指引光环。

flavorText.zh-CN: 为确保自己安全抵达边缘，你付出了什么？

description.en: A random weapon or armor piece from Kepler.
description.zh-CN: 一件来自开普勒的随机武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: "Another successful mission accomplished, Captain!" —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “船长，又成功完成一项任务！”——智能失效保险

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：涅索斯上的探险“坚不可摧”

flavorText.zh-CN: 每当我想起那个时候，我的心跳就会加速。

Armor configured for Guardians who seek a flexible approach to combat.

Primary Stat: Class
Secondary Stat: Weapons
description.zh-CN:
专为追求灵活作战的守护者配置的护甲。

主要属性：职业
次要属性：武器

flavorText.en: The metamaterial that coats the gauntlet repels Cabal pressure gel. Keep it clean.
flavorText.zh-CN: 臂铠上包裹着的超材料能够抵抗卡巴尔高压凝胶。请保持清洁。

flavorText.en: …THAT'S NOT LOOT!
flavorText.zh-CN: …那不是战利品！

flavorText.en: I am the coming storm.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是即将来临的风暴。

description.en: Eliminate Vex with Nova Bombs while pledged to Future War Cult.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠未来战争狂热者期间使用新星炸弹消灭Vex。

flavorText.en: "Fight harder! Any less than your best is an insult to the very core of being a Guardian!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “全力战斗！无法倾尽全力是对守护者的莫大耻辱！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Are you me, or am I you?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你是我？还是我是你？

flavorText.en: "Silimar's defense broke more assaults than not. His retribution would shake the ground." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “斯利马的防御能够打破大多数的进攻。他的反击则可撼动大地。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: The wilds are your home. Let your instincts guide you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 荒野是你的家。让本能为你指引方向。

flavorText.en: "Sing them a lullaby of death and nothing more."
flavorText.zh-CN: “为他们唱一首死亡的摇篮曲，仅此而已。”

flavorText.en: You don't realize that I'm all around you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你无法发现，我就在你身边。

flavorText.zh-CN: “那个王牌猎手一定是丧失了心智才会驾驶我的黄金飞船。忠于王室的代价高昂。身为暗影的代价更甚。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.zh-CN: 嘛哩嘛哩哄！

flavorText.en: "How many of these damn things are there?"  —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin
flavorText.zh-CN: “这些该死的东西到底有多少？”  ——阿图尔·沃洛宁中尉

flavorText.en: "Suffer no evil." —Lady Efrideet
flavorText.zh-CN: “周身无罪恶。”——艾弗里迪特夫人

description.zh-CN: 能够治疗盟友和伤害对手。对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并为盟友提供覆盖护盾。

flavorText.en: Now, do it again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 现在，再来一次。

description.en: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.
description.zh-CN: 使用永不分离武器造成最后一击会填装此武器，并为弹匣溢装额外伤害弹药。使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会提升永不分离武器的弹匣容量。

description.zh-CN: 当超能激活时，护甲可减少所受到的伤害。

description.en: This weapon tracks the number of enemies you defeated with it.
description.zh-CN: 记录使用武器消灭的敌人数量。

flavorText.en: I am a shield unto myself.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是自己的护盾。

flavorText.en: "They are an insult, a stain that's our duty to wash away." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们的存在是对我们的侮辱和玷污，将其抹除掉是我们的职责。”——领主萨拉丁

description.en: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.
description.zh-CN: 偃月射弹最后一击会增加偃月近战伤害，且持续时间更长。偃月射弹或近战伤害会延长效果持续时间。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of your Arsenic Bite-4b. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变砷毒噬咬-4b的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：《命运2》：《遗落之族》预定奖励礼物。

flavorText.en: "Think of all the old mysteries that are now ours to solve anew!" —Timur, learning of SIVA
flavorText.zh-CN: “思索现在属于我们的所有古老秘密，重新解开它们！”——帖木儿，湿婆研究

flavorText.en: "These gifts were not made for us, but we were meant to have them." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “这些天赋并不适合我们，但我们注定应当拥有它们。”——第三百夫长术士，雷卡纳

flavorText.en: Put down your sword for a moment and breathe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 暂时放下你的刀剑，深呼吸。

flavorText.en: "Humanity's been waging war for as long as we've been humanity. Don't forget the old lessons." —Valus Saladin Forge
flavorText.zh-CN: “自我们成为人类起，就从未停止过战争。别忘了古老的教训。”——军政官萨拉丁·弗吉

flavorText.en: "The Awoken have been bleeding territories for years now. Tangled Shore was just the first to slip between the cracks." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “多年以来，觉醒者的领土一直在逐渐沦陷，纷争海岸首当其冲。”——蛛王

flavorText.en: I am the end of 'morrows.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是明日的终结者。

description.en: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.
description.zh-CN: 举起防御阻挡伤害后会释放出一道使目标迷失方向的短程冲击波。

flavorText.en: Forged from the ruin of Hezen Vex armor. The sensory interface feels more natural than bare skin.
flavorText.zh-CN: 利用光芒Vex护甲残片锻造而成的物品。感官界面的触感比裸露的皮肤还要自然。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the victories that your wisdom shall win in my name. Over and over." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你的智慧将以我之名赢得胜利。一次又一次。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.zh-CN: 装备此限定版武器皮肤以改变陨落铡刀的外观。

flavorText.en: I wish to be brave.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿英勇无畏。

flavorText.zh-CN: 完成任意突袭来开启此护甲的白色荧光。

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021: 
- Complete Altars of Sorrow on the Moon, or Override missions from Season of the Splicer.
- Gain elemental empowerment buffs by collecting Elemental Orbs.
- Defeat combatants with Void weapons.
flavorText.zh-CN:
至日英雄2021期间：
-在月球上完成忧愁圣坛，或者完成永夜赛季的超控任务。

flavorText.en: We are thinkers, daring to dream about the universe and its infinite expanse.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们是思想家，敢于梦想无垠宇宙。

description.en:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
description.zh-CN:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

description.en:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
description.zh-CN:
将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

你的黎明射弹在命中时会灼烧目标。

description.en: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
description.zh-CN: 将你的刀剑刺入地面，对附近目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。刀剑会发出持续的光环，为附近盟友提供焕光和恢复效果，使其免受冰影效果的影响。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的传承鼓舞着我们，这样我们才有力量把手伸向未来。没有哪个云端行者是在孤军奋战。”——云端行者，洛汗

flavorText.en: "The Vanguard didn't understand why the Crucible was necessary at first." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “先锋起初并未理解为什么熔炉竞技场必不可少。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "What we did, we did for humanity. For family." —H. Meyrin
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们所做的一切都是为了人类。为了家人。”——H·梅兰

sourceString.en: Source: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在“往日之苦”突袭中获得。

flavorText.en: Complete the 1AU Redux mission, defeat enemies with Solar grenades, and win non-private Crucible matches.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版1AU任务，使用烈日手雷消灭敌人，赢得熔炉竞技场非私人比赛。

flavorText.en: "Do not be afraid."
flavorText.zh-CN: “别害怕。”

description.en: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.
description.zh-CN: 穿透型箭头，在进入和穿出时均可对目标造成伤害。一发可射穿多个目标。

description.en: No mod currently selected.
description.zh-CN: 当前未选择模组。

flavorText.en: "Not every piece of equipment is optimal for all environments. You see snow. I see a thousand hiding places." —Designer, BrayTech R&D
flavorText.zh-CN: “并非每件装备能完美适应所有环境。你看到的是雪，我看到的是成千上万的藏身处。”——布瑞科技研发团队设计师

description.en: Improved resilience.
description.zh-CN: 更强的韧性。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "Wreath yourself in victory." —Daito product slogan
flavorText.zh-CN: “享受胜利的华冠。”——Daito产品口号

flavorText.en: "Lies are manufactured. Truth grows naturally… with or without a gardener." —Nayyir Gimenez, Warlock
flavorText.zh-CN: “谎言是人造的。真理是天然生长的…无论有没有园丁。”——内伊尔·吉梅内兹，术士

flavorText.en: III - You are hollowed.
flavorText.zh-CN: III - 你被掏空了。

flavorText.en: Gambeson and stitch for long, cold nights, and short, bloody fights.
flavorText.zh-CN: 用厚棉布和针线制作成，适合漫长的寒夜和短暂的血战。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“战争领主的废墟”地牢

description.en: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.
description.zh-CN: 击败目标后填装此武器，会使下次命中发射一枚引爆造成迷失效果的动能射弹。

description.en: Complete a Nightfall strike wearing full New Monarchy armor and while pledged to that faction to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Sovereign Mask, Helm, and Hood.
description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠新王派期间穿戴整套阵营护甲完成一次日落打击可获得此皮肤。于君主面具面具、头盔和兜帽上解锁。

flavorText.en: "I dunno what's more fun: Stealing enemy vehicles, or blowing them up." —Hawthorne
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道哪个更有趣：是偷走敌人的载具，还是直接炸掉。”——霍桑

sourceString.en: Source: Adventure "Unsafe at Any Speed" in the European Dead Zone
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：欧洲无人区中的探险“狂野时速”

flavorText.en: "They're powered by that Hive rock you got me! Sloane gave me permission once I explained the voltmeter readings." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “它们是受你给我的那个邪魔族石头驱动的！我解释了电压表上的读数之后斯隆就给了我许可。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

sourceString.en: Source: Adventure "Siren Song" on Saturn's Moon, Titan
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：土星卫星，土卫六的探险“塞壬之歌”

flavorText.en: "They say you can't reason with these enemies. I dunno—my gun and I seem to manage just fine." —Kei-Ying
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们说你对这些敌人毫无头绪。我不知道——至少我和我的枪都觉得他们还在射程范围之内。”——麒英

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Let's you and them fight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你和它们打一架吧。

flavorText.en: "Nonslip techno treads for maximum arctic mobility."
flavorText.zh-CN: “具有最佳极地机动性的防滑科技战靴。”

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

flavorText.en: The Valence has dimmed, but the nature of the Echoes grows clearer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 原子光已经黯淡下来，但回响的本质愈发清晰。

flavorText.en: Poof! …Oh. What happened?
flavorText.zh-CN: 噗！……噢。发生什么事了？

flavorText.en: A good hood keeps you focused. This one targets nothing but loss.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完好的兜帽能让你心神合一。而这顶兜帽只会令人迷失。

flavorText.en: Restitution will preserve justifiable mercy.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赎罪之人，才配得到宽恕。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器消灭目标以解锁这项升级。

flavorText.en: "Their curses are now your charms. Hold such hatreds close, for they reveal their fears." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “现在它们的诅咒之力庇护你的左右。铭记此仇此恨之刻骨，使它们溺于自身的恐惧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "I will forge you into a weapon stronger than any blade." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我会将你铸造成一件绝世兵器。”——领主沙克斯

description.en: Unlocks an additional weekly bounty for Hawthorne.
description.zh-CN: 额外解锁一个霍桑的周常悬赏。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Forerunner. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变先驱者的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: You got me!
flavorText.zh-CN: 你干掉我了！

flavorText.en: The body is a scaffolding for the mind. Keep the body safe and allow the mind to flourish.
flavorText.zh-CN: 肉体是思想的脚手架，保护好肉体，让思想开花。

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

description.en: Upgrade this Ghost to increase its energy capacity by 1. Fully upgrading this Ghost to Masterwork provides an additional mod socket.
description.zh-CN: 升级此机灵使其能量上限提高1。完全升级此机灵为大师杰作会提供一个额外的模组插槽。

flavorText.en: "X7… what happened to one through six? Probably in a dumpster somewhere. What a waste." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “X7…从一到六都发生了什么？可能都在垃圾桶里吧。太浪费了。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "Thy duty is thy bond. Explore the boundless. Conquer the unknown." —A tenet of the Iron Will
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的职责就是你的契约。探索那无限的世界吧。去征服未知。”——钢铁意志教条

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: A little stronger. A more powerful stance. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow. —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: 再强一些，再强势一些。你就要准备好……施放暗影了。——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：利维坦，星之塔突袭巢穴。

description.en: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Handling is improved.
description.zh-CN: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。提升操控性。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en: "Making guns helps the hours pass. Especially since Suraya never calls…" —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “制作枪械有助于消磨时间，尤其当苏拉娅一直不联系我时……”——德弗里姆·卡伊

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages in the EDZ.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: SUROS invites you to lead.
flavorText.zh-CN: SUROS邀你引领。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在水星上获得升级包。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示使用此武器时击杀敌人的数量。

description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从拉克希米-2处获得升级包。

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变横断之步的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "It's not a game. …Well, it is a game. But it's more than that. Ah, Shaxx says it better. Go ask him." —Cayde-6
flavorText.zh-CN: “这不是游戏。……好吧，这是游戏。但它不只是游戏。啊，让沙克斯来说会更给力。你去问他吧。”——凯德6号

flavorText.en: Fly faster. Cut deeper. Burn harder.
flavorText.zh-CN: 飞得更快。切得更深。烧得更烈。

flavorText.en: The latest dance fad to sweep the City.
flavorText.zh-CN: 席卷了圣城的最火舞步。

flavorText.en: The orbital city of Caer Lerion was one of Earth's crowning achievements in the Golden Age.
flavorText.zh-CN: 开尔·雷利昂的轨道城市曾是地球在黄金时代无与伦比的成就之一。

flavorText.en: We couldn't have done this without you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 没有你，我们可做不到。

description.en:
Deliver these mysterious and obscure treats to Brother Vance in the Lighthouse on Mercury.

Available only during the Dawning.
description.zh-CN:
给水星灯塔上的万斯修士送去这些神秘而模糊的小食。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 已发现的食谱

flavorText.en: "Sudden, swift, and deadly."
flavorText.zh-CN: “骤然，迅捷，致命。”

sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "You need to seek truth out. It's small, and it's ugly, and it's easy to miss. And it's also the only thing in this universe you can orient yourself by." —Hsei-22, Hunter
flavorText.zh-CN: “你需要找出真相。它既渺小又丑陋，很容易被忽略。而它也是这个宇宙中你唯一可以用于引导自己的东西。”——何赛-22，猎人

flavorText.en: Sharpness is a product of both tool and wielder.
flavorText.zh-CN: 人剑合璧，方成利器。

flavorText.en: I wish to be swift.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿健步如飞。

description.en: Rapidly healing allies grants this weapon a period of increased damage.
description.zh-CN: 快速治疗盟友可提升此武器在一段时间内的伤害。

flavorText.en: No living person shall know thy true face.
flavorText.zh-CN: 唯有死者方能一睹汝之真容。

flavorText.en: – A blade carves in wicked intent, claiming this submission is surgery  –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 邪恶意图驱使利刃雕刻，称此等屈服为手术 –

description.zh-CN:
发射一个不稳定的球形虚空能量，在靠近目标的时候引爆，将目标从爆炸中心推开，并使其变得不稳定。

可多次使用。

flavorText.zh-CN: 你已经知道答案了。

flavorText.en: It's all you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 都是你。

flavorText.en: Is it possible to touch another mind?

flavorText.zh-CN:
子程序似像者：状态=已恢复。
神化：状态=激活……

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们贫乏，但不吝分享。如果不然，便会死亡。”——泰拉·卡恩

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: "Logic says we must accept it. Emotion says we will never truly accept it." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “逻辑上我们必须接受，感情上我们永远无法真正承受。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: "I hold faith in the Light, unwavering."—Shayura, Awoken Warlock
flavorText.zh-CN: “我对光能有着不可动摇的信念。”——沙玉拉，觉醒者术士

description.zh-CN: 发射精准的远程能量光束。在垂直方向上的后坐轨迹更加规则。

flavorText.en: "You have truly grown fat from strength. And you are still as wise as ever. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “你果然变得又强又壮，而依旧睿智非凡，了不起。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: The flightless blind, venturing out into the dark. Never to return.

description.en:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.

生命值全满时造成最后一击，或长时间脱离战斗后，你的护盾将缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

description.en:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
description.zh-CN:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 缚丝超能 | 暗影技能

description.en:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧超能 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧超能 | 光能技能

description.en:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
description.zh-CN:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一把精准烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

你的黄金枪可造成大幅增加的精准伤害，穿透目标，并在精准命中时生成能量球。

可从焕光状态中获益。

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 烈日超能 | 光能技能

description.zh-CN:

沉默：制造一场急速冰冻爆炸，冰冻并伤害目标。

狂啸：制造一场冰影风暴以减速和伤害被包裹的目标。

description.en:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy. 

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.

description.en:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.

编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

flavorText.en: "Better alone than in unwanted company." —Jjenr, Husk
flavorText.zh-CN: “孤独，胜过不想要的陪伴。”——躯壳，杰恩尔

flavorText.en: "I dunno what's more fun: Stealing enemy vehicles, or blowing them up." —Hawthorne
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道哪个更有趣：是偷走敌人的载具，还是直接炸掉。”——霍桑

flavorText.en: "They're powered by that Hive rock you got me! Sloane gave me permission once I explained the voltmeter readings." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “它们是受你给我的那个邪魔族石头驱动的！我解释了电压表上的读数之后斯隆就给了我许可。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

flavorText.en: To make the old path your own.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让老路成为你自己的路。

flavorText.en:
"I almost kept these. Fit my tired feet real nice. Who am I kiddin' though? Drifter always takes care of his friends."
—The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN:
“我差点把这个自己留下来。和我疲惫的脚很合适。不过我在逗谁呢？浪客永远照顾到他的朋友。”
——浪客

flavorText.en: Shine bright to illuminate the history of our heroes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 闪耀光芒，照亮英雄的历史。

flavorText.en: Forged in honor of Saladin, of all that has been lost and all that remains.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为向萨拉丁及其失去与遗存的一切致敬而铸造。

flavorText.en: "Everything dies. This is proof." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “万物终有一死。此为证据。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: II - You are held.

description.en: This weapon's rockets have tracking. Lock onto targets when aiming down sights. Landing hits with a full magazine grants ammo and boosts the next magazine with increased tracking strength, stability, fire rate, and cluster bombs.
description.zh-CN: 这款武器的火箭有追踪能力。瞄准时可锁定目标。弹匣全数命中目标可获得弹药并强化下一个弹匣，提升其追踪能力、稳定性、射速，并附带集束炸弹效果。

description.en: Capable of healing allies and hurting targets. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Unraveling projectiles.
description.zh-CN: 能够治疗盟友和伤害目标。对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并生成瓦解射弹。

flavorText.en: An unfinished inscription runs along the barrel: "Tlamus, she who—"
flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管上有一段没有刻完的文字：“特拉姆斯，一位——”

flavorText.en: "Fight forever, Guardians!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “战斗不息，守护者！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Is it possible to touch another mind?
flavorText.zh-CN: 触碰另一颗心灵，这可能吗？

flavorText.en: "We've progressed into a liminal space. Corridors folding on each other. Psychometer is spiking here, are we sure this is safe?" —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 2nd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们进入到了一处阈限空间。廊道相互折叠。心理测试仪在这里达到了峰值；我们确定这样安全吗？”——隐秘者心像空间探险第2次通讯

flavorText.en: The conspirators were too afraid to kill me—rightly so. I am the beloved father of the people, and the glorious mob would not suffer my death. My sentence was exile.
flavorText.zh-CN: 阴谋家们太害怕杀死我了——当然如此。我是人们爱戴的家长，荣耀暴民不会判我死刑的。我的判决是流放。

flavorText.en: Your foes will remember your sting.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的敌人会铭记你的刺痛。

description.en: Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.
description.zh-CN: 基于你拥有的咆哮烈焰层数，提升烈日武器和烈日点燃的伤害。你更难被悬停、减速或冻结。破除异常状态时，你不会受伤，且会同时在身体周围产生一波烈日能量冲击。

flavorText.zh-CN: – 手握利刃，心怀暴力，做出提议并被拒绝 –

flavorText.en: "The Kells are dead or mad. The era of Houses is over. So I came to the Shore." —Arrha, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “凯尔非死即疯，氏族时代已经结束，我因此来到海岸。”——阿尔拉，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en: The unnerving awareness of the watcher being watched.
flavorText.zh-CN: 监视者受到监视的不安感。

flavorText.en: Where does one end and the other begin?
flavorText.zh-CN: 何处是尾，何处是头？

flavorText.en: Do not fear. Be what others fear.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要恐惧。成为他人的恐惧。

flavorText.en: Listen, and you will hear it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 倾听，便能感知。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Saturn's Moon, Titan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在土星卫星，土卫六上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: No one will escape my web.
flavorText.zh-CN: 没人能逃出我的网。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在木卫一上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Bereft of guidance and sanctuary.
flavorText.zh-CN: 失去指引和庇护。

Secondary Stat: Grenade

主要属性：生命值

flavorText.en: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
flavorText.zh-CN: “星光吾母，黑暗吾父。”——玛拉·索维女王

flavorText.en: Best done with a serious expression.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最好表情严肃点。

description.zh-CN: 全面，可靠，可进行3发点射。

flavorText.en: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道你怎么想的，但我越来越喜欢欧洲无人区了。真的，到处都是苔藓。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages in the EDZ.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Adapt or die. It's a core truth of the universe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 适者生存。这是宇宙的终极真理。

flavorText.en: The forces of the universe heed your call and answer with reverence.
flavorText.zh-CN: 宇宙之力响应了你的召唤并回以敬意。

flavorText.en: Goodness, gracious, great flames of soulfire!
flavorText.zh-CN: 神圣华美壮观的魂火！

flavorText.en: Hang on tight and enjoy the ride!
flavorText.zh-CN: 坐稳扶好，尽情享受！

flavorText.en: Sometimes, the monster hunts you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有时，怪物会猎杀你。

flavorText.en: I see the task before me. I wear it with devotion.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我看到了眼前要务。我虔诚地穿上了它。

flavorText.en: The Ghost Primus was strong because of his disfigurement, not in spite of it. He alone had the vision to share my dream of a new, perfect world. Ghaul was a creature of singular beauty, and I loved him.
flavorText.zh-CN: 幽灵军团长的毁容相貌正是他强大的原因。他会和我分享我梦想中的全新完美的世界。盖欧是一个奇特尤物，我曾爱他。

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一副末世既临之容，一双厄土天赐之眼；观其形貌，便知逃无生天。”——浪客

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 诡计护甲模组

flavorText.en: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “祝贺你找到为其拼搏一生的真正职业。你是一名……合格的助手。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: They will know you by the bonds you forge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们会通过你建立的纽带而知晓你。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“战争领主的废墟”地牢

flavorText.en: All it takes is a little trust.
flavorText.zh-CN: 只需要一点点信任。

description.en: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.
description.zh-CN: 持续射击会提升精度和射程。提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。

flavorText.en: "Never raise arms without reason." —Lady Efrideet
flavorText.zh-CN: “永远不要无理由地举起武器。”——艾弗里迪特夫人

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Thy duty is thy bond. Explore the boundless. Conquer the unknown." —A tenet of the Iron Will
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的职责就是你的契约。探索那无限的世界吧。去征服未知。”——钢铁意志教条

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Now it's worse and here to stay.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如今每况愈下，而且会持续下去。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

description.zh-CN: 使用此物品随机分配伤害类型：电弧、灼烧或虚空。

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: All eyes on me.
flavorText.zh-CN: 所有人都看向我。

flavorText.en: "Your most valuable organ is your brain. Keep it safe with specially carbon-molded headgear." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “你身上最宝贵的器官就是你的大脑。用这块特制的碳纤维头饰来保护它的安全吧。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

flavorText.en: "Maybe you leave your first apocalypse. But your second one never leaves you." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许你已逃脱天启初降，但你永难摆脱天启再临。”——浪客

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变温迪戈GL3的外观。解锁皮肤后，此皮肤将能供你帐户中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "Warrior-scholars. Reality breakers. Weapons of mass destruction. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “智勇双全的学者、现实破坏者还有大规模杀伤性武器。你的部族将成为出色的暗影。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: I warn of the last moment.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我警告最后一刻。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

description.zh-CN: 装备此护甲皮肤以改变力量平衡的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: I am the weaver of bitter revenge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我是痛苦复仇的编织者。

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变弑后者的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变监护的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 低射速，高伤害。保持不动、缓慢移动以及瞄准目标时，此武器精度更高。

flavorText.en: "You have not yet found your purpose. But it has found you." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “你还没有找到自己存在的目的。但目的已经找上了你。”——玖的使者

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

description.en: Complete Heroic strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It's unlocked for all Crucible armor sets.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间完成英雄打击以获得此装饰品。所有熔炉竞技场护甲套装均可解锁此皮肤。

description.en: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.
description.zh-CN: 当受到电弧伤害时，这把武器的威力会提高并能抵抗进一步的电弧伤害。完成击杀可延长这种超载充能状态的持续时间。

flavorText.en: "When I look at them, I see myself staring back." —Crow
flavorText.zh-CN: “我望向他们时，会看见我自己的影子。”——乌鸦

description.en: Earn this ornament by reaching Glory Rank "Legend." Equip it to change the appearance of Redrix's Claymore. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked on all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 可通过达到荣耀等级“传说”来获得此皮肤。装备此皮肤以改变莱德瑞克斯斩剑的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

sourceString.en: Source: Reach Glory Rank "Legend" in the Crucible.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在熔炉竞技场中达到荣耀等级“传说”。

description.en: Mistakes can burn, even in the dead of night.
description.zh-CN: 沉寂深夜，谬误尤燃。

flavorText.en: Those without purpose are already defeated.
flavorText.zh-CN: 心无目标，安能不败。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: You will not see me coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我会让你措手不及。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：闪点里程碑；传说记忆水晶。

flavorText.en: Yes, totally, absolutely, yeah!
flavorText.zh-CN: 是的，没错，就是它，这就对了！

flavorText.en: "Sometimes it's a cosmic event. Sometimes it's a beast from hell. Sometimes it's one man." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “时而是寰宇大典，时而是地狱凶兽，间或区区一人。”——浪客

description.en: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.
description.zh-CN: 高伤害，充能时间适中。进行一次水平齐射。

flavorText.en: "Lord Kandak is 'considering' our appeal for more protection. Sidenote: When the Warlord took out his Ghost, Enitan fled the assembly. Why? She still claims amnesia." —Annals of the Saharan Contested Zone
flavorText.zh-CN: “领主坎达克正在‘考虑'我们寻求更多保护的诉求。备注：当督军摧毁他的机灵之后，艾妮坦逃离了议会。为什么？她依然声称自己失忆。”——撒哈拉争议地区编年史

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from an activity.

When inserted into a Shaped weapon at the Relic, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may only store one of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从某个活动中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物在圣物处插入已塑形武器中时，会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放一件此类纪念物。

description.en: Complete the Pleasure Gardens Challenge to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 完成欢愉花园挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

flavorText.en: "Some speculate that the radiolarian fluid is the last vestige of a biological life-form that became the Vex." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “有人推测，这种放射液体是变成Vex的生物最后残余的生命形态。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果我在王座上被击败，那我便会死去。我的伟业将终结。”

description.en: Complete Heroic strikes during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Took Offense, Shelter in Place, and Xenos Vale IV head armor.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间完成英雄打击可获得此皮肤。于主动进攻、原位避难所和陌路溪谷IV头部护甲上解锁。

flavorText.zh-CN: 由绝路曙光的第一修士和第一修女穿戴；绝路曙光是一个恶名昭彰的地方武装组织，成员都是巡回游荡的猎人。

flavorText.en: Great galactic powers journey to Earth to find their destiny (which is disintegration by Nova Bomb).
flavorText.zh-CN: 强大的银河系帝国来到地球，寻觅他们的归宿（即新星炸弹引发的解体效应）。

description.en: Complete weekly strike milestones during Season 2 to earn this ornament. It's unlocked for all Crucible armor sets.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间完成周常打击里程碑以获得此皮肤。所有熔炉竞技场护甲套装均可解锁此皮肤。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: When the universe conspires, its enemies cannot hide.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当宇宙工于谋略，它的敌人将无处可藏。

flavorText.en: "He is that which is an end. And he shall rise again." —passage from Of Hated Nezarec, a pre-Golden Age text.
flavorText.zh-CN: “他就是终结的化身。他终将再次降临。”——前黄金时代文字记录《被憎者奈扎雷克》选段。

flavorText.en: Reality is the finest flesh, oh bearer mine. And are you not…hungry?
flavorText.zh-CN: 我的宿主啊，现实是最美味的血肉。你是否感到……饥饿？

flavorText.en: Mighty are they of the stormcloud thrones, and quick to anger, but bounteous to those whom they love.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们在暴风云的王座上是那么的雄伟而易怒，但对至爱之人却又慷慨大方。

flavorText.en: Defeat enemies in strike playlists using a subclass that matches the [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] Day, collect Elemental Orbs of any type in the European Aerial Zone, and defeat minibosses in the European Aerial Zone.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用匹配 /  / 日的分支职业来消灭打击列表中的敌人；在欧洲空中区收集任意类型的元素光球；在欧洲空中区消灭初级首领。

description.en: Final blows with this weapon grant improved class ability energy.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器完成最后一击可获得更多职业技能能量。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en: "Have you ever considered that the Traveler might be just as chaotic and arbitrary as everything else?" —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “你是否想过，也许旅行者同其他一切事物一样，毫无秩序，飘忽不定呢？”——阿什·米尔

description.en: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after an improved short duration or the next shot.
description.zh-CN: 使用近战技能对附近战斗人员造成伤害可大幅提高操控性和伤害。持续短暂时间后或下次射击后过期，持续时间延长。

description.en:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 缚丝超能 | 暗影技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 缚丝超能 | 暗影技能

description.en: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
description.zh-CN: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧超能 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧超能 | 光能技能

description.en:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 冰影超能 | 暗影技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 冰影超能 | 暗影技能

description.en:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空超能 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 虚空超能 | 光能技能

description.en:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
description.zh-CN:

[轻攻击]  ：向敌人投掷战锤。

击中时，战锤会碎裂成爆炸熔合碎片。

flavorText.zh-CN: 当探索新地平线的号角吹响时，请记住这里。

flavorText.en: We'll bring you home.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们会带你回家。

flavorText.en: Hawthorne forged this weapon out of scraps and salvage during her years alone in the wilds.
flavorText.zh-CN: 霍桑在孤处荒野的岁月里四处搜寻回收，用废料铸成了这把武器。

flavorText.en: A standard issue Omolon weapon. City-made.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是一把平常无奇的Omolon武器。圣城制造。

flavorText.en:
"The Hive do not see how we see. They look beyond, into the infinite. Into the dark."

—Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN:
“邪魔族力量的见地超越吾辈。它们举目眺望，目落无尽，洞入黑暗。”

——埃里斯·摩恩

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Remember, the universe is a chaotic system. This frippery won't protect you from the continuum." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住，宇宙是一个混乱不堪的系统。这件无用之物不能保你渡过四生百劫。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: There is so little left. And the cost, so high…
flavorText.zh-CN: 所剩不多。而代价却是如此高昂…

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“战争领主的废墟”地牢

flavorText.en: The Iron Banner tournament keeps alive the heroes of humanity's dark past.
flavorText.zh-CN: 铁旗锦标赛让人类黑暗岁月的英雄存活至今。

flavorText.en: Osmium's existence requires near-divine intervention—a supernova—to forge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 锇素需要近乎神性的介入——超新星——来进行锻造。

flavorText.en: "Fight forever, Guardians!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “战斗不息，守护者！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: We got this!
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们可以哒！

flavorText.en: He consumed their technology like fire, fashioning armor from their remnants.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他很快就吸取其技术，用残骸打造出了护甲。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示使用此武器时击杀敌人的数量。

flavorText.en: I tend to work better while not freezing to death.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在不会冻死的情况下，我的工作效率更高。

flavorText.en: "If you're up against someone smilin', watch out. That smile's likely hidin' something scary." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “面对微笑的人时要小心。那很有可能是笑里藏刀。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Mind over mayhem.
flavorText.zh-CN: 以智制乱。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

description.en: Increase the progress rate toward timelost weapon frames by 10% when in a fireteam with a clanmate.
description.zh-CN: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，失时武器模型进度速率+10%。

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.en: Source: Dismantle an item with this shader applied to it.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：拆解一件应用此着色器的物品。

description.en:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
description.zh-CN:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重旋转攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

flavorText.en: Nothing resonates like grief.
flavorText.zh-CN: 没什么比悲痛更能引起共鸣。

flavorText.en: "I've traveled far and weathered much. How far and how much, I don't know. All I know is I'm not done yet." —Micah-10
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经走了很远，也历练了许久。至于有多远和有多久，我不知道。我只知道一点，那就是我的人生还没结束。”——米迦-10

flavorText.en: To the Voice on the other line.
flavorText.zh-CN: 致另一端的声音。

sourceString.en: Source: Season of the Wish Activities

flavorText.en: The unit wears metal as a clam wears shell. There is a new light in the unit's eye. The light is lonely.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我身披金属，犹如蛤蜊藏身壳中。我眼中有新的光芒。孤独的光芒。

flavorText.en: The old workhorse, still with many years to give.
flavorText.zh-CN: 虽然老旧，但还能用上很长一段时间。

flavorText.en: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "It'll think for ya."
flavorText.zh-CN: 大崩溃后大气层外作战护甲原型。里面刻着：“它会帮你思考。”

flavorText.en: They look to you to save them.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们希望你来拯救。

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Banshee-44.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：班西-44处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "There is a place where we can remember who we are." —Imogen Rife
flavorText.zh-CN: “有一处可容我们铭记自己的地方。”——依莫根·莱弗

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。

flavorText.en: "Let them have the Great Machine. They deserve it." —Mithrax, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “就让他们拥有那伟大的机器吧，他们应得的。”——米瑟拉克斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en:
"Don't forget who has the best Icarus–Daedalus time."

"You did it at closest approach! Doesn't count." "Does too!"
flavorText.zh-CN:
“别忘记是谁保持了伊卡洛斯到代达罗斯的最快纪录。”

“那只是你在它们最接近的时候创下的纪录！怎么能算数。”“当然算数！”

description.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
description.zh-CN:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间进一步提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

flavorText.en: Be the bull.

Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成更多手雷能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是沐浴在同一光能下的独特气息。”——永劫教派

flavorText.zh-CN: “宇宙中有些东西是不可知的。重要的是，它们是可以被摧毁的。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "Many followed him when he left—if not with their feet, then with their hearts." —Fractal Scrolls
flavorText.zh-CN: “许多人在他离开时都跟随其后——有些人身随其行，而有的人则心随其后。”——破碎的卷轴

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "We've progressed into a liminal space. Corridors folding on each other. Psychometer is spiking here, are we sure this is safe?" —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 2nd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们进入到了一处阈限空间。廊道相互折叠。心理测试仪在这里达到了峰值；我们确定这样安全吗？”——隐秘者心像空间探险第2次通讯

flavorText.en: "We can't beat what we don't understand. Then again, we have beaten a lot of Vex." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们无法克服我们无法理解的事物。话虽如此，我们却击败了许多Vex。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: We celebrate how we have triumphed against all odds.

description.en: Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. description.en:
Deliver this reminder of home to Ana Bray in the BrayTech Futurescape on Mars.

Available only during the Dawning.

把这个能让她想起故乡的点心送去给火星布瑞科技未来景象中的阿娜·布瑞。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

flavorText.en: "The greatest compliment you can pay in the Crucible is to fight with everything you've got." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “在熔炉竞技场中，你能表现出的最高敬意便是倾尽全力战斗到底。”——领主沙克斯

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.zh-CN: 用此武器造成持续伤害会从备弹中填装略多弹药或移除更多热量，并提升伤害。

flavorText.en: "I have died for my fireteam, but I never once thought to live for them." —Reed-7, Exo Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “我曾为我的火力战队牺牲，但我从未想过要为他们而活。”——里德-7，Exo泰坦

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: Each line more potent than the last.
flavorText.zh-CN: 每句都比上一句更有料。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Don't listen.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要聆听。

flavorText.en: "It is fuel. Use it to fight harder." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是燃料，带着它更努力地战斗。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Over there...
flavorText.zh-CN: 在那里……

flavorText.en: "Gensym Armor. Let's hope it does you more good than it did me." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “圣希姆护甲。希望它穿在你身上能比穿在我身上更有用处。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: "This research has to get out. Even if I don't. People have to know what this 'anomaly' is." —Last Recording of Dr. Shanice Pell
flavorText.zh-CN: “这项研究必须公之于众。就算不是我，人们也需要知道这个‘异形'到底是什么。”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士的最后一份录音

Available only during the Dawning.

给利维坦上的卡鲁斯之容送去这丰盈的小食，并变得又强又壮。

flavorText.zh-CN: 领主萨拉丁让战死的爱国同胞的回忆留存了下来。

flavorText.en: "Let them have the Great Machine. They deserve it." —Mithrax, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “就让他们拥有那伟大的机器吧，他们应得的。”——米瑟拉克斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en: Never stop striving.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战斗不息。

Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.

消灭一个目标会向附近目标蔓延持续时间更长的灼烧效果。
更强大的战斗人员和敌方守护者会在更大的范围内造成灼烧效果。

flavorText.en: “Before my Councilors and I could finalize her containment armor, the very presence of the Fulminator assaulted the senses. She was breathtaking.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “在我和我的议员们完成她的束缚甲之前，轰鸣者的存在挑战着我们的感官。她是令人震惊的。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: There is nothing I cannot forgive.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从曙光节中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

flavorText.en: Titans once challenged themselves to patrol the frontier with armor this weak.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦曾经挑战自我，穿上如此轻薄的盔甲在前线巡逻。

flavorText.en: "The work is unending. That does not give us license to abandon it." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “工作无休止。那并不意味着我们可以弃之不顾。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.zh-CN: “我没有忘记曾经立下的誓言。那把弓我还留着。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.zh-CN: 从这么高的地方看，阳光洒在雪地上就像火烧一样。

flavorText.zh-CN: 对神秘蜻蛉是否真正存在过的问题，学者们莫衷一是。

在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

sourceString.en: Source: Earned during the seasonal Revelry event.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在狂欢季节活动中获得。

flavorText.en: "Ace pilots. Assassination squads. Swift thieves in the night. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “王牌飞行员、刺杀小组还有穿梭暗夜之中的敏捷盗贼。你的部族可以成为出色的暗影军团。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

description.en: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants for an improved duration. Gain this bonus immediately for a significantly longer duration when you are revived.
description.zh-CN: 对强力目标造成持续武器伤害或最后一击会为此武器提供额外的填装、操控性以及对战斗人员的伤害，持续时间延长。当你被复活时，立即获得此增益，且持续时间显著更长。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
description.zh-CN: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

description.en: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
description.zh-CN: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

description.en: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.
description.zh-CN: 闪身以施展一次特技之跃。着陆时，使自身和附近友军获得焕光效果。

flavorText.en: Wheeeeee!
flavorText.zh-CN: Wheeeeee！

flavorText.en: "Gone, but never forgotten." —The Drifter

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.

一种在击败一个目标后可暂时增加近战伤害的快速打击技能，效果最多可叠加三次。

使用此技能击败目标会提供职业技能能量，并恢复少量生命值。获得的能量会根据你的职业属性调整。

flavorText.en: Let them fall. You will salvage what remains.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们倒下吧，你将扫净他们的残骸。

flavorText.en: Who knew a flightless bird could dance?
flavorText.zh-CN: 谁能想到这只不会飞的鸟能跳舞？

flavorText.en: V - You are bound.
flavorText.zh-CN: V - 你被束缚了。

flavorText.en: "No light ever truly goes out." —Lady Jolder
flavorText.zh-CN: “光能并不会真正消逝。”——欧德女士

flavorText.en: "Remember why we fight." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住我们为何而战。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.zh-CN: “我遇到的每个民族都只有一个暗影。但光能如此之多，我的时间又如此之少……”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯。

description.en:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
description.zh-CN:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和盟友大幅削弱和压制他们。

发射两组三发虚空箭矢，搜寻附近目标。暗影箭矢会使敌人变得不稳定，对已被束缚的目标造成更高伤害。击败被束缚的目标会生成能量球。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

name.zh-CN: 暗影箭矢：莫比乌斯箭袋

description.en:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。

 [轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。

 [重攻击] ：进行一次可削弱目标的重攻击，并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

description.en:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
description.zh-CN:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

description.en: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
description.zh-CN: 制造一道大型屏障，利用掩体巩固作战位置，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

description.en: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
description.zh-CN: 制造一道小型屏障，瞄准时可透过屏障进行观察，你的武器的填装速度、稳定性和射程都会提高，并且当你站在其后时，可以吸引敌人火力。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

description.en: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.
description.zh-CN: 此武器可发射爆炸弹头。当使用瞄准镜瞄准时，弹头速度快，弹道笔直。当进行腰际射击时，爆炸规模更大，可对目标施加灼烧效果。

flavorText.en: You will not see me coming.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我会让你措手不及。

flavorText.en: For our salvation, the universe shall be remade.
flavorText.zh-CN: 为了我们的救赎，宇宙应该重构。

flavorText.en: "No, no, Guardians don't steal. We just… clean up after ourselves." —Kit Ali Ameir
flavorText.zh-CN: “不不不，守护者不会偷东西。我们只是在……自己打扫干净。”——基特·阿里·阿米尔

flavorText.en: "Some claim to know the future better than we do. Listen carefully. Then ask yourself: do their words ring true or false?" —Lakshmi-2
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些人认为比我们更了解未来。听仔细，问问自己：他们的话是真的，还是假的？”——拉克希米-2

flavorText.en: "If you think this world ends well, you are mistaken." —Arach Jalaal
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果你觉得这个世界死得其所，那你就错了。”——蛛族杰尔拉

description.en:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一支燃烧的大锤，用地震的力量碾碎目标。

[轻攻击]  ：在自身周围旋转大锤，对附近目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：朝地面猛击大锤并制造出一股追踪目标的火焰旋风，造成伤害并灼烧他们。

description.en:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一把燃烧的战锤对你的敌人造成毁灭打击。

[轻攻击]  ：向敌人投掷战锤。

击中时，战锤会碎裂成爆炸熔合碎片。

flavorText.en: "I love the City. But I don't want to go back. I want to bring the City to the EDZ." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “我爱圣城。但我不愿回去。我想把圣城建到欧洲无人区来。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: I sought relief. I found delight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我寻求着救济。我找到了欢欣。

flavorText.en: Hi! Hi! Hi! Hi! Hi!
flavorText.zh-CN: 嗨！嗨！嗨！嗨！嗨！

description.en: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil for a longer duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高精度和稳定性，同时改善垂直后坐力，持续时间延长。

flavorText.en: Quick to secure arisen conflicts.
flavorText.zh-CN: 迅速行动，平息浮现的冲突。

description.zh-CN: 使用其他武器达成最后一击将提高此武器的伤害和性能，持续时间延长。

flavorText.en: "We hold onto traditions like memories. They define us. They remind us of those we've lost." —Y. Satou
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们像对待记忆一样珍惜着我们的传统。传统决定了我们是怎样的人。传统让我们记住我们所失去的一切。”——Y·佐藤

description.en: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.
description.zh-CN: 造成散布发射。装备有短暂光盾。使用你的光盾阻挡伤害会逐渐为自身和附近盟友赋予虚空覆盖护盾。

flavorText.en: Getting there first is all that matters.
flavorText.zh-CN: 重要的是能第一个抵达。

flavorText.en: "If you can hear yourself think, you're not flying fast enough." —Marcus Ren
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果你还能思考，那说明你飞得还不够快。”——马库斯·伦

flavorText.en: Reinforce the bonds of legacy.
flavorText.zh-CN: 巩固传统纽带。

sourceString.en: Source: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在“往日之苦”突袭中获得。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "There's a new player over on the Shore. He calls himself 'Crow.' As if trying to rub our prince's death in our faces." —Report from Paladin Hallam Fen
flavorText.zh-CN: “海岸来了新客，他自称为‘乌鸦'。似乎想当我们的面炫耀我们王子的死。”——圣骑士霍拉姆·凡的报告

flavorText.en: "Cayde was the smooth-talker. Shiro was the behind-the-scenes. Andal was the mastermind." —Ghost of Shiro-4
flavorText.zh-CN: “凯德巧舌如簧，小白幕后推手，安达尔则是主脑。”——白-4的机灵

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of The Martlet.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变无足雨燕的外观。

flavorText.en: "I will forge you into a weapon stronger than any blade." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我会将你铸造成一件绝世兵器。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: Don't listen.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要聆听。

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021: 
- Complete Altars of Sorrow on the Moon, or Override missions from Season of the Splicer.
- Gain elemental empowerment buffs by collecting Elemental Orbs.
- Defeat combatants with Arc weapons.
flavorText.zh-CN:
至日英雄2021期间：
-在月球上完成忧愁圣坛，或完成永夜赛季的超控任务。
-通过收集元素能量球获得元素赋能增益。
-使用电弧武器消灭战斗人员。

flavorText.en: Complete any raid to enable this armor's white glow.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成任意突袭来开启此护甲的白色荧光。

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变焚天者誓约的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: You don't even have to ask. I'd follow you to the end of the galaxy. —Wei Ning
flavorText.zh-CN: 你甚至不需张口，我会随你至星系的尽头。——韦宁

flavorText.en: The wound is not deep, but you know it exists—and that is enough.
flavorText.zh-CN: 伤口并不深，但你知道它的存在——这就够了。

flavorText.en: "Lost things have a way of washing up on the Tangled Shore." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “遗失之物终会被冲上纷争海岸。”——蛛王

description.en: High damage, high recoil. Optimized for long-distance shooting.
description.zh-CN: 高伤害，高后坐力。为远程射击进行优化。

flavorText.en: "This research has to get out. Even if I don't. People have to know what this 'anomaly' is." —Last Recording of Dr. Shanice Pell
flavorText.zh-CN: “这项研究必须公之于众。就算不是我，人们也需要知道这个‘异形'到底是什么。”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士的最后一份录音

flavorText.zh-CN: 乱世驰援。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: The chorus of regret must be deafening.
flavorText.zh-CN: 悔意之歌必然震耳欲聋。

flavorText.en: “Valus Nohr marched on our capital with a few thousand. For weeks we battered them. But the Valus. She broke us.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.
flavorText.zh-CN: “军政官诺阿带着几千人杀到我们的首都。我们顽强抵抗了数周。但军政官毕竟是军政官。她击溃了我们。”——卡佳·克里普斯之枪鲁尔

flavorText.en: To help see our foes when the light has gone dim.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在灯火昏暗之处，看清我们的敌人。

flavorText.en: "There's no one else I can trust with her care." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不敢把她托付给其他人。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: You are a beacon of Light in the Darkness, a spark keeping the terrors at bay.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你是黑暗中的光明灯塔，是驱散恐惧的一缕火花。

flavorText.en: Hunger is the all of it, and it is all of hunger.
flavorText.zh-CN: 饥饿就是一切，一切都是饥饿。

flavorText.en: "Even for the faithless Arach, there is hope. While there is space on the ships, none shall be turned away." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII
flavorText.zh-CN: “即使是没有信仰的蛛族都有着希望。只要飞船上有空间，我们的人就一个都不能少。”——《启程记》，颂歌第七章

flavorText.en: You can do this dance to any music.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这种舞步能配合一切音乐。

flavorText.en: "We are the last city of Humans. We greet each new year with joy and thanksgiving." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是人类最后的城市。我们用快乐和感恩向每一个新年致意。”——泰拉·卡恩

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

description.en: Equip this Weapon Ornament to change the appearance of Vigilance Wing.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变警惕羽翼的外观。

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: "Do not be afraid."
flavorText.zh-CN: “别害怕。”

flavorText.en: It makes all the children happy.
flavorText.zh-CN: 它会让所有的孩子都很开心。

flavorText.en: And the cleanse shall beget an ocean.
flavorText.zh-CN: 净化应当产生海洋。

flavorText.en: "For starlight was my mother, and my father was the dark." —Queen Mara Sov
flavorText.zh-CN: “星光吾母，黑暗吾父。”——玛拉·索维女王

flavorText.en: Blessed with the strength of your convictions.
flavorText.zh-CN: 受你决意力量的祝福。

flavorText.en: "I can decode anything with a grenade launcher." —Saint-14
flavorText.zh-CN: “我可以用榴弹发射器解码任何东西。”——圣人14号

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：篇章怨魂赛季活动

flavorText.en: "The Reef grieves for Uldren Sov, lost in the Taken War. He will be remembered as a voice for peace." —Paladin Devi Cassl
flavorText.zh-CN: “暗礁为欧顿·索维于傀儡战争殒命而哀痛，他将作为和平使者为人铭记。”——圣骑士戴维·卡瑟尔

flavorText.en: "What we did, we did for humanity. For family." —H. Meyrin

description.zh-CN: 你的黎明射弹在命中时会点燃目标。你的灼烧造成额外伤害，并积累为更强力的点燃。用灼烧或点燃造成伤害会提供近战能量。

description.en: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 此武器会对被悬停目标造成额外伤害。当你通过任意来源悬停目标或使用此武器对被悬停的目标造成伤害时，可在短时间内获得更快的拔枪速度。

flavorText.en: A nostalgic dance to help one simply feel better.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让人感觉更加舒畅的怀旧舞蹈。

flavorText.en: When the end comes… Will you scrounge for him, Titan?
flavorText.zh-CN: 当结局将至……你会为他乞要吗，泰坦？

flavorText.en: When the end comes… Will you scrounge for him, Titan?
flavorText.zh-CN: 当结局将至……你会为他乞要吗，泰坦？

flavorText.en: When the end comes… Will you scrounge for him, Titan?
flavorText.zh-CN: 当结局将至……你会为他乞要吗，泰坦？

description.en: Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and grants Frost Armor to your allies.
description.zh-CN: 对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并为盟友提供冰霜护甲。

description.en:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range
description.zh-CN:
优化距离。
  •  增加射程

flavorText.en: The ticking of this heart can be heard across the battlefield.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这颗心脏的跳动声在战场萦绕。

flavorText.en: "It's from 'Paladin Oran.' 'Use less data, route electron notices forward over Uranus-Neptune divide." —Paladin Hallam Fen
flavorText.zh-CN: “来自‘圣骑士奥兰'，‘欧洲无人区顿时陷入一片黑暗，已派人前往，希望可以找到原因。'”——圣骑士霍拉姆·凡

flavorText.en: "Found a hallway, full of statues of Calus in various states of dissection. Sobbing noise coming from the walls."  —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 3rd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “发现一个走廊，里面摆满了处在不同解剖状态下的卡鲁斯雕像。墙上传来呜咽的声音。”——隐秘者心像空间探险第3次通讯

description.en: Destroying a Tangle spawns a Threadling. Your Threadlings unravel targets that they damage.
description.zh-CN: 摧毁缠结会生成一个线虫。你的线虫会瓦解它们所伤害到的目标。

flavorText.en: "Who will be the first to fall?" —Lakshmi-2
flavorText.zh-CN: “谁将最先陨落？”——拉克希米-2

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

  •  Decreases accuracy

  •  降低精度
 • 减少蓄力时间

description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变陨落铡刀的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

description.en: Aspects modify your subclass with new actions for your Guardian to bring to combat.
