flavorText.en: "The Traveler trusted us to carry on her task." —The Stoic
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者将她的使命托付给我们。”——斯多葛

flavorText.en: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相就像日出，孩子。它很漂亮，适合用来写诗，但到最后，它根本不在乎你会不会被灼伤。”——帕里斯·肖，隐秘者调查员

flavorText.en: Noble stand-ins for hope, when hope itself was long since gone." —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"
flavorText.zh-CN: “当希望早已消失无踪，贵族便挺身甘当希望。”——《至尊卫士历史》节选

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Synthoceps. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变合成感受器的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "Feast, my comrades. Torobatl may be lost, but its spirit lives on in our traditions." —Empress Caiatl
flavorText.zh-CN: “盛宴吧，我的战友们。图罗巴特尔也许已经离我们而去，但是它的精神永存。”——女帝查厄托

flavorText.en: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经学会不以畏惧为耻；既知身为何人，亦在意料之中。”——帕维尔·诺格

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。

flavorText.en: "Ghaul commanded you to die for his vanity. I ask only that you fight at my side for the empire. The choice is yours." —Empress Caiatl
flavorText.zh-CN: “盖欧命令你为他而死。我只要求你为帝国和我并肩作战。选择权在你。”——女帝查厄托

flavorText.en: Stand behind us.
flavorText.zh-CN: 挺身守护。

description.zh-CN: 充能近战和终结技最后一击会提供噩梦激励，提升操控性和空中效率。生效时，新拔出的武器会造成额外伤害并在造成最后一击时提供噩梦激励。获得噩梦激励会填装所有枪套中的武器。

flavorText.en: "We kill miles." —D.E.C. slogan
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们踏遍四海。”——绝路曙光口号

flavorText.en: Absolute, unflinching resolve.
flavorText.zh-CN: 坚定无畏的决心。

flavorText.en: "Many followed him when he left—if not with their feet, then with their hearts." —Fractal Scrolls
flavorText.zh-CN: “许多人在他离开时都跟随其后——有些人身随其行，而有的人则心随其后。”——破碎的卷轴

flavorText.en: Within this chest beats the heart of a phantom—an apparition, a wraith, a ghost.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这个胸膛里跳动的心脏属于一个幻影——一个幽灵、一丝幽魂、一只鬼怪。

flavorText.en: "The hurricane will overtake you. It's inevitable. Take stability where you can get it." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “飓风会追上你，其势难违；在可以稳住自己的地方不要松手。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

description.en: Fragments are used to modify your abilities. They are shared across subclasses of the same element type.
description.zh-CN: 碎片可用于改变你的技能。它们能在所有相同元素类型的分支职业之间共享。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Festival Flight. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变庆典飞行的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: We watch, and we listen. We are the first to see the danger lurking in the abyss.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们观察并聆听。我们率先看到了潜伏在深渊中的危险。

description.en: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light.
description.zh-CN: 可产生一堵燃烧着虚空之光的横向墙壁的手雷。

description.en: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
description.zh-CN: 一种投掷武器，由加重的缚丝物质组成，会在击中时爆炸，悬停目标并生成额外的悬停子射弹。

flavorText.en: "Truth is a sunrise, kid. It's pretty, and it fits great in poetry, but in the end, it don't give a damn about you getting burned." —Paris Shaw, Hidden investigator
flavorText.zh-CN: “真相就像日出，孩子。它很漂亮，适合用来写诗，但到最后，它根本不在乎你会不会被灼伤。”——帕里斯·肖，隐秘者调查员

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021:
- Defeat 5 minibosses in the European Aerial Zone before the boss is summoned.
- Collect Elemental Orbs.
- Rapidly defeat combatants.
flavorText.zh-CN:
至日英雄2021期间：
-在欧洲空中区，于首领被召唤出来之前消灭5个初级首领。
-收集元素能量球。
-快速消灭战斗人员。

flavorText.en: Complete Vanguard Ops on Master or Grandmaster difficulty to enable this armor's white glow.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成大师或宗师难度的先锋行动来启用此护甲的白色炫彩。

flavorText.en: To warm our bodies in the chill of the night.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在霜降寒夜中，使我们的身体温暖。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: It is with the greatest sorrow that I wish to pay my respects.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我以最悲伤的心情在此向你致敬。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我用自己编写的代码给这件护甲编写了程序！如果你挂了，那是你的错。与我无关。”——智能失效保险

flavorText.en: Geometry is the study of perfect beauty.
flavorText.zh-CN: 几何学是对无上完美的研究。

flavorText.en: When the Last City was just a patchwork of campfires, the Iron Lords stood guard.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当最后的城市只闪烁着点点营火时，钢铁领主便已在守卫着她了。

flavorText.en: "Think I'll pay Tex Mechanica another little visit. They need some help staying on the straight and narrow." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “我得再去拜访下特克斯机械。他们需要一点帮助才能安分守己。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：熔炉竞技场中的荣耀比赛

flavorText.en: "Constant projections. Unending destruction. The will of every efficient parasite." —Savathûn's worm
flavorText.zh-CN: “不断施展奸计，造成无尽的破坏，便是每一只尽职的寄生虫的意志所在。”——萨瓦图恩的蠕虫

flavorText.zh-CN: “最后，梦境之幕，这样你方可以己之目，洞察梦魇。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "I might not be a Guardian, but they've reminded us you don't need the Light to be a hero."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我也许不是守护者，但他们提醒我们，成为英雄不一定需要光能。”

flavorText.zh-CN: 强大的银河系帝国来到地球，寻觅他们的归宿（即新星炸弹引发的解体效应）。

flavorText.en: "Our work is to defend life—and, we cannot forget, to live it. That means stop and smell the roses, Guardian." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的职责是守护生命——也别忘了，去好好生活。这意味着停下来闻闻玫瑰的香气，守护者。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

description.en: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
description.zh-CN: 以稳健身姿进行一次策略躲避闪身。进行闪身可自动收集附近的弹药箱并填装所有武器。

description.en: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
description.zh-CN: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.zh-CN: 要是你能看到你自己就好了。但你没有眼睛。没有保留哪怕一丁点的感觉……

flavorText.zh-CN: “在这种悲惨的时代，人类唯一能依靠的只有自己。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "When did 'by any means necessary' become such a bad thing?" —The Drifter

flavorText.zh-CN: “想要在这里生存，身后都得长眼睛。”——领主邪冬

description.zh-CN: 当超能激活时，护甲可减少所受到的伤害。

flavorText.en: Flow gracefully like water from a mountain spring, and strike like the torrent of a raging flood.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如山泉涓涓流淌，如洪流奔腾冲撞。

flavorText.en:
"Parties keep you young, Titan." —Eva Levante
Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“聚会让你保持青春，泰坦。”——伊娃·莱万特
在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

flavorText.en: "It's good to see the Traveler from my balcony again. Reminds you of what we do this for, eh?" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “又能从我家阳台上看见旅行者了，感觉真好。让我们想起了拼搏的意义，对吧？”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：熔炉竞技场中的荣耀比赛

flavorText.en: "Proof of good faith is key to cooperation and, ultimately, friendship." —William Moffat, DEO Director
flavorText.zh-CN: “展现诚意是合作乃至友谊的关键。”——对外观察部主任，威廉·莫法特

flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦绞尽脑汁构思了这种高端设计用于制造作战装备。我们并非都是渴望挨揍的笨蛋。

flavorText.zh-CN: “圣希姆护甲。希望它穿在你身上能比穿在我身上更有用处。”——阿什·米尔

此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

flavorText.en: To help see our foes when the light has gone dim.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在灯火昏暗之处，看清我们的敌人。

flavorText.en: The dark decades after the Collapse were a time of confusion, desperation, and… interesting engineering choices.
flavorText.zh-CN: 大崩溃后的黑暗岁月充满了困惑、绝望，还有……相当有趣的工程学选择。

flavorText.en: "Mercy has no place in the Crucible. Going easy does no one any favors." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “熔炉竞技场中没有仁慈可言。手下留情于对任何人都毫无益处。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: What is quicker than the light, if not the dark?
flavorText.zh-CN: 能比光还快的，不就是黑暗吗？

description.en: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
description.zh-CN: 使用这款武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

flavorText.en: Your treasure hoard will one day rival Xûr's.
flavorText.zh-CN: 会有一天，你的宝藏窖藏能与仄的相媲美。

flavorText.en: Ow, my fingers!
flavorText.zh-CN: 哦，我的手指！

flavorText.en: Warm hugs in the cold of winter.
flavorText.zh-CN: 寒冬中的温暖拥抱。

flavorText.en: Stand steadfast in the face of opposition.
flavorText.zh-CN: 虽千万人吾往矣。

description.zh-CN: 使用此武器击败目标会导致目标爆炸。精准最后一击或碎裂被冻结的目标会触发点燃。

flavorText.en: Destruction from the inside out.
flavorText.zh-CN: 由内而外的毁灭。

description.zh-CN: 精准击杀可产生元素伤害爆炸。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.zh-CN: “如果我在王座上被击败，那我便会死去。我的伟业将终结。”

flavorText.en: "The greatest threat to a Guardian is another Guardian." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “对一名守护者来说，最大的威胁是其他守护者。”——玖的使者

flavorText.zh-CN: “世界都会有个终结。当你的末日来临时，身边一定要有个值得依赖的同伴。”——浪客

description.en: Deliver these explosively delicious treats to Commander Zavala in the Tower Courtyard.

description.en: This weapon marks targets with an automated targeting system. Final blows on marked targets generate a telemetry pattern. Collecting a telemetry pattern grants ammo to this weapon. Collecting 3 telemetry patterns without dying grants this weapon bonus damage for a long duration and refills the magazine.
description.zh-CN: 此武器的自动瞄准系统会自动标记目标。使用最后一击杀死的已标记目标会生成遥测规律。收集遥测规律可为此武器提供弹药。在不死亡的情况下收集3次遥测规律，会使此武器在一段较长的时间内造成额外伤害并填装弹匣。

flavorText.en: "Silimar's defense broke more assaults than not. His retribution would shake the ground." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “斯利马的防御能够打破大多数的进攻。他的反击则可撼动大地。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "My parents walked a hard road to get me to the Last City safely. They paid the price too. These Eliksni may be outsiders, but I see something familiar in 'em. Loss. Pain. Hope." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的父母历经千辛万苦才把我安全送到圣城。他们也付出了代价。这些埃里克斯尼族虽说是外来者，但我在他们身上看到了一些熟悉的东西。丧失。痛苦。希望。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

flavorText.en: "I've learned not to be ashamed of the fear. It's to be expected, given what we are." —Pavel Nolg
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已经学会不以畏惧为耻；既知身为何人，亦在意料之中。”——帕维尔·诺格

flavorText.en: The cutting edge.

flavorText.en: "There's a last, safe city out there somewhere. We have to believe."
flavorText.zh-CN: “一定还有最后的安全之城。我们必须相信。”

flavorText.en: “My planet was dead. The sky poisoned by war with an extrasolar enemy in a war that continued to rage. Then Calus came.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的星球曾经一片死寂。天空布满了星系战争的阴影，久久无法散去。直到卡鲁斯的到来。”——卡佳·克里普斯之枪，鲁尔

flavorText.zh-CN: 寻找静谧之所，凝望世界末日。

flavorText.en: A frozen scream trapped in gemstone; the recognition of a great and terrible truth. You descend upon your enemies with the enormity of the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一声冰冷的尖叫被困在原石之中；一个对伟大而可怕的真相的认知。你带着暗影的极恶降临在敌人的头顶。

flavorText.en: A desire for legacy, to be known, preserved in sterile glass. The world stops and starts at your command.
flavorText.zh-CN: 传承的渴望，被知晓的渴望，被保存在无菌玻璃中。整个世界停滞不前，只等你一声令下。

flavorText.en: – Wrapped in purpose and wreathed in meaning the old life withers away –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 被意图包裹，被意义环绕，旧日生活渐消散 –

flavorText.zh-CN: “战争与和平，恐惧与疑虑…熔炉竞技场始终屹立不倒。”——领主沙克斯

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. It will generate Orbs on multikills and gain a random bonus stat.

The weapon will also gain a tracker that displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.

将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，使用该武器多杀会生成光球，并获得一个随机奖励属性。

同时会获得一个追踪器，显示使用该武器击杀敌人的数量。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我睡不着。他的目光…在我的思维中无处不在。”——科拉西斯，奈扎雷克的仆从

flavorText.en: The first with congruity.
flavorText.zh-CN: 首次和谐。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of opponents defeated in the Crucible by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示在熔炉竞技场中使用此武器时击杀对手的数量。

flavorText.en: Trust him.
flavorText.zh-CN: 信任他。

description.en: Modifications for the transmat systems of the Starfarer 7M ship. Cannot be used on other ships.
description.zh-CN: 星旅者7M飞船的传送系统更改模组。无法在其他物品上使用。

flavorText.en: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “这个古老创伤的圣物受到邪魔族魔法的束缚，就像是旧伤疤上的新绷带。”——埃里斯·摩恩

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

description.en:
Improved handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain improved guard resistance and charge rate instead.
description.zh-CN:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

刀剑则提高防御抗性和充能速度。

flavorText.en: Tex Mechanica custom-made hood. Keep your face from sight, and your intentions a mystery.
flavorText.zh-CN: 特克斯机械定制兜帽。隐藏面孔，让人猜不透你的意图。

flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们逃走吧，你将找到他们的藏身之处。

flavorText.en: "The Loyalists won't be ready until every world in this system casts a Shadow. Calus will get us there." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
flavorText.zh-CN: “效忠者会一直等待直到银河系的所有世界充斥暗影。卡鲁斯将指引我们。”——颅骨刺穿者，法尔绰克

description.en: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles at a reduced rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage when aiming down sights.
description.zh-CN: 以较低射速发射强化射程的大口径射弹。瞄准时造成的精准伤害将提升。

flavorText.en: "You will go where none have gone before. Tread carefully." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “你将行前人未行之路，请谨小慎微。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我的伟业便是死亡，并活在那死亡之中。”

description.en: Grenades spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Defeating targets creates Arc explosions.
description.zh-CN: 手雷引爆时生成集束炸弹。击败目标时造成电弧爆炸。

flavorText.en: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 德弗里姆·卡伊让守护者护甲套装的款式更新潮。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages in the EDZ.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "CARVE UNTO ME A TRIBUTE OF WAILING PRAYERS" —Xivu Arath, Hive God of War
flavorText.zh-CN: “为我刻下一段哀嚎恸哭的祷文。”——希乌阿拉斯，邪魔族战神

description.en: An expertly tuned NLS drive, providing the best possible performance.
description.zh-CN: 经过专家级调校的NLS推进器，提供最佳的性能。

flavorText.en: Complete the 1AU Redux mission, defeat enemies with Solar Power weapons, and win non-private Crucible matches.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版1AU任务，使用烈日威能武器消灭敌人，赢得熔炉竞技场非私人比赛。

flavorText.en: "I have died many times but these deaths were only temporary."
flavorText.zh-CN: “我死过许多次，但那些死都只是暂时的。”

description.en: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
description.zh-CN: 使用前半弹匣弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

description.en:
Dive to the ground and create a burst of Solar Light that cures nearby allies.

While Heat Rises is active, you gain restoration while diving and scorch targets upon landing.
description.zh-CN:
向地面俯冲并生成一束可治愈附近友军的烈日光能。

激活炙热升腾时，你可以在俯冲时获得恢复效果并在落地时灼烧敌人。

description.en:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
description.zh-CN:
制造光能源泉，为位于其中的角色增加武器伤害和技能能量回复。

击败站在裂痕中的战斗人员可以获得额外弹药生成。

description.en: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
description.zh-CN: 制造能量源泉，为位于其中的角色提供持续治疗。

description.en: Final blows from weapons with a damage type matching your Super create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration. After reviving or being revived, you gain an aura that provides overshields to you and nearby allies.
description.zh-CN: 使用伤害类型与你的超能匹配的武器造成最后一击会在你周围产生爆发治疗，为盟友提供恢复。在复活或被复活后，你会获得一个光环，为你和附近盟友提供覆盖护盾。

flavorText.en: Lose yourself in the moment.
flavorText.zh-CN: 此刻迷失自我。

flavorText.en: Both awful and lovely.
flavorText.zh-CN: 既可怕又美好。

flavorText.en: "In the distance, a hammer clangs; my heart burns."
flavorText.zh-CN: “远处的锤子叮咣作响；我的心在燃烧。”

flavorText.en: The flightless blind, venturing out into the dark. Never to return.
flavorText.zh-CN: 折翼盲禽，涉险入夜。永不归来。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 头盔护甲模组

flavorText.en: "I was at the Final Attempt. I saw a Guardian wield a gun that left molten gold in her wake. I ran and never looked back." —Avrok, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “我曾在终结之图。我看见一个守护者拿着一把枪，在她所过之处留下熔金之色。我逃跑了，头也不回。”——埃弗罗克，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en: Few Titans master all the disciplines of their Light. Those who do can switch in an instant.
flavorText.zh-CN: 鲜有泰坦掌握光明的所有纪律。而全般掌握的泰坦能在瞬间转变。

flavorText.en: A shard of obsidian, brimming with the light of day. Eons will pass before you fade.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一片黑曜石，光照而耀之。千秋又万世，你仍不消逝。

flavorText.en: A golden medallion emblazoned with the symbol of a hammer, weighing heavy around your neck. Your inferno starts with a single flicker.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一枚饰有战锤符号的金色勋章，沉甸甸地挂在你的脖颈上。你的炼狱始于一道闪光。

flavorText.en: The pommel stone of a battle-scarred war hammer, radiant with an inner fire. You reclaim this once-hallowed ground.
flavorText.zh-CN: 战痕累累战锤的锤柄石，闪耀着内在的火光。你要夺回这片曾经神圣的土地。

flavorText.en: A worn radio detonator whose use brought victory in pitched battle. The best defense is vaporizing your foes before they ever strike.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个磨损的无线电引爆器，曾在恶战中助使用者赢得胜利。最好的防御，就是在敌人出手之前将其蒸发。

description.en: Complete challenges in Trials of the Nine during Season 2 to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在玖的试炼中完成挑战可解锁并装备此皮肤。

flavorText.en: A Mark meant to honor the stalwart defenders of the Last City.
flavorText.zh-CN: 向最后的城市中坚定防御者致敬的印记。

description.en: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.
description.zh-CN: 更多弹药储备。弹匣打空时可略微提高填装速度。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

description.en: Oversized Sidearm with extended-range, heavy-caliber rounds. Fires full auto with increased rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage to unshielded targets.
description.zh-CN: 配有远程大口径子弹的大号手枪。全自动射击，射速提高。对没有护盾的目标造成更高的精准伤害。

description.en: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
description.zh-CN: 高基础伤害，提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

flavorText.en: "We are the trusted dawn. Long forgotten, but now returned." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Herio Sect"
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们是被信仰的曙光。被遗忘已久，而今重返尘世。”——《赫罗教派纲领》节选

flavorText.en: "Inflexibility is its own virtue." —Sloane
flavorText.zh-CN: “顽强不屈本身就是种美德。”——斯隆

flavorText.en: "You're on thin ice, Guardian. Good, I can't stand to see talent playing it safe!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “守护者，你现在如履薄冰。很好，我最受不了有才干的人还那么小心翼翼！”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "This isn't happening. This isn't happening. This isn't happening."
flavorText.zh-CN: “这不可能发生。不可能。绝不可能。”

flavorText.en: I wish to be feared.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿出现令我畏惧之人。

description.en:
An Exotic catalyst can be inserted into this socket.

Check the Exotic catalysts section in Triumphs to learn where the catalyst can be obtained.
description.zh-CN:
可以将异域催化插入此插槽。

查看成就中的异域催化部分，了解在哪里可以获得催化。

description.en: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
description.zh-CN: 当一名盟友被击败时，获得填装、稳定性、瞄准辅助和射程。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

description.en: Wear the aspect of surging renewal.
description.zh-CN: 身着汹涌复兴的那一面。

flavorText.en: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir
flavorText.zh-CN: “祝贺你找到为其拼搏一生的真正职业。你是一名……合格的助手。”——阿什·米尔

flavorText.en: May the rewards of victory rain down.
flavorText.zh-CN: 愿胜利奖赏的大雨倾盆而下。

flavorText.en: A single word etched inside the barrel: "Sylvie-1."
flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“希尔薇-1”

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Skyburner's Oath. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变焚天者誓约的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: Chilling thoughts indeed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 确实令人胆寒的想法。

flavorText.en: "That's what it's all about, right? You only ever see the seeds. The plants are for the children. Metaphorically." —Myriadical, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “这才是最重要的，对吧？你只能看到种子。植物是给孩子们的。打个比方。”——云端行者，米里亚迪科

flavorText.en: Maybe it was a left turn at Arcturus?
flavorText.zh-CN: 也许应该在大角星那里左转？

flavorText.en: Defeat enemies in the European Aerial Zone, collect Solar orbs in strikes, and defeat combatants in the European Aerial Zone while equipped with a Void subclass.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在欧洲空中区消灭敌人，在打击活动中收集烈日光球，并装备虚空分支职业在欧洲空中区消灭战斗人员。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Xenophage. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变异星噬菌的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: An enneagram tips, poised to shatter.
flavorText.zh-CN: 九芒星微微倾斜，随时可能破碎。

flavorText.en: No crisis too big.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无危不克。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "Had a face like the end-times and eyes like manna in the desert. One look at him, and I knew I wasn't gonna be saved." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “一副末世既临之容，一双厄土天赐之眼；观其形貌，便知逃无生天。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

flavorText.zh-CN: “你永远无法真正确定地了解真相。你能做的就是用事实打破先入为主的观念，并祈祷最后留下的形状是个比较还原的描摹。”——达盖特-4，隐秘者分析师

flavorText.en: "They were the first line, and the last." —Excerpt, "History of the Prime Guard"

flavorText.en: Only bones for your feast. Only death for my victory.
flavorText.zh-CN: 唯有骸骨是你的盛宴。唯有死亡令我感到胜利。

flavorText.en: The unlikely champion rises from tragedy.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这个不可能的勇士从悲剧中崛起。

flavorText.en: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "Knuckle up."
flavorText.zh-CN: 大崩溃后大气层外作战护甲原型。里面刻着：“准备战斗。”

flavorText.en: "For one who seeks to reach out... and destroy." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了想要抵达……并摧毁的人。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "For the Light who exercises brute force to win an exchange." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “为了使用暴力赢得战争的光能者。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "I used some of my own code to program this armor! But if you die, it's your fault. Not mine." —Failsafe
flavorText.zh-CN: “我用自己编写的代码给这件护甲编写了程序！如果你挂了，那是你的错。与我无关。”——智能失效保险

description.en: Defeat enemies in Trials of the Nine and complete a flawless ticket during Season 2 to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 第2赛季期间在玖的试炼中消灭敌人并完成一张完美入场券可解锁并装备此皮肤。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the apex of your heuristic potential. Should you wish it, this system shall collapse from the ideas you've made into weapons. And make way for what's coming. O champion mine." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了你启发潜能的极限。只要你愿意，整个星系就会因你的想法所化身而成的武器而灭亡，并敞开道路，让我的勇士通行。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: Friends are as companions on a journey who ought to aid each other to persevere.
flavorText.zh-CN: 朋友就像旅途中的伴侣，只有相互扶持才能走到最后。

flavorText.zh-CN: “穿着这件护甲睡了一晚。醒来时，发现自己的心脏在随着一个未知的信号颤动。”

flavorText.en: A book of matches, just one left. Light 'em up.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一盒火柴，只剩一根。点燃他们。

flavorText.en: A dusty leather hat, scarred by the nicks of countless forgotten skirmishes. You walked away from those fights. Your foes didn't.
flavorText.zh-CN: 沾满灰尘的皮帽，无数已被遗忘的战斗在其上留下了痕迹。你从那些战斗中活了下来。你的敌人却没有。

flavorText.en: A scorched shell casing smelling of gunpowder, somehow still warm to the touch. You flash, brilliant, in dark times.
flavorText.zh-CN: 烧焦的弹壳，闻起来有股火药味，不知怎的触摸起来尚有余温。你在黑暗中明亮闪耀，光彩照人。

flavorText.en: A leather holster, well-worn. You were always quicker on the draw.
flavorText.zh-CN: 皮制枪套，磨损严重。你总是拔枪神速。

flavorText.en:
"I'm here to save you." —Isidel Brandor
"Imitate! Observe! Comprehend!" —Unnamed inhabitant(s), Juno Chasma
flavorText.zh-CN:
“我是来拯救你的。”——伊丝黛尔·布兰德
“效仿！观察！理解！”——无名居者，朱诺深谷

flavorText.en: "That's no ordinary dust. You're standing on the pulverized remnants of 1 Ceres." —Corsair Anzani Lyle
flavorText.zh-CN: “那不是普通的尘土，你正站在谷神星粉碎遗骸之上。”——海盗军阿扎尼·莱尔

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Touch of Malice. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变恶意触碰的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "You wouldn't believe the solar flare I caught the other day. Rode it halfway to Venus." —Blue Boaz
flavorText.zh-CN: “你一定不会相信我前几天捕捉到的太阳耀斑。高度足有金日距离的一半。”——布鲁·波资

flavorText.en: "You have truly grown fat from strength. And you are still as nimble as ever. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “你果然变得又强又壮，而依旧灵巧非凡，了不起。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.en: "Go, child! Run! Don't look back! Don't—"
flavorText.zh-CN: “快跑，孩子！跑起来！别往后看！别——”

flavorText.en: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——

flavorText.zh-CN: 朋友就像旅途中的伴侣，只有相互扶持才能走到最后。

flavorText.en: "There has only been a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.

flavorText.en:
An army meets, and stands, and falls. Three nobles wage their hopeless war.
In shifting madness, evil crawls. One stands above the battle's roar.
flavorText.zh-CN:
一支军队集结、屹立，然后倒下。三个贵族进行毫无胜算的战争。
疯狂游移间，邪恶蠕动。战斗怒吼中，一人屹立。

flavorText.en:
A spark of knowledge with each fall, the purpose of the endless youth.
No longer shunned, dark's nameless call now brings about tenebrous truth.
flavorText.zh-CN:
在死亡中萌发智慧，永恒青春的意义。
不再逃避，黑暗无名的召唤将带来阴森的真相。

description.en:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.
description.zh-CN:
装备瞬移时，可在空中使用[空中闪身]来施展暗影瞬移。

使用瞬移或暗影瞬移可获得不稳定弹药。瞬移距离更远并对你附近的目标施加不稳定，且冷却时间更短。新星折跃超能生效期间，暗影瞬移不会消耗超能能量。中幅提升所有武器的空中效率。

flavorText.zh-CN: “对蛛族来说，隔离并不是什么好事。我们的敌人总是指责我们的疯狂，而我们又给不了理由。人需要互相信任。”——《启程记》，颂歌第三章

description.en: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
description.zh-CN: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会提升伤害，持续时间延长。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

flavorText.en: "My dear, sweet Lusia. You were meant to be next to me in this life, and the next. There's time yet for me to make it so." —Clovis Bray I
flavorText.zh-CN: “我亲爱的、可爱的卢西亚。你在这一世，以及下一世，都注定要留在我的身边。我还有时间来完成这个目标。”——克洛维斯·布瑞一世

flavorText.en: I see the void, and through this gaze, I learn to covet no goal.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我看到了虚空，这凝视让我明白了：别觊觎目标。

flavorText.en: The Iron Banner tournament keeps alive the heroes of humanity's dark past.
flavorText.zh-CN: 铁旗锦标赛让人类黑暗岁月的英雄存活至今。

description.en: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.
description.zh-CN: 这个模组已经被弃用，失去了功能。你可以用另一个模组进行替换。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 弃用的护甲模组

flavorText.en: I reach for solace. It is stolen from me.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我寻求着慰藉。它已被人偷走。

description.en: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Strikes.
description.zh-CN: 在打击中微光获取量提升10%。

description.en: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.
description.zh-CN: 武器收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药。

flavorText.en: – A blade carves in wicked intent, claiming this submission is surgery  –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 邪恶意图驱使利刃雕刻，称此等屈服为手术 –

flavorText.en: As many ways to celebrate the Dawning as stars in the sky. But they all guide us in the dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 庆祝曙光节的方式有如天空中的繁星般多姿多彩，同时也如同繁星般指引着我们。

description.en:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability
description.zh-CN: 可发射在直接命中时可造成更高的伤害的榴弹。  •  提高稳定性

flavorText.en: There is no strength in letting go.
flavorText.zh-CN: 放弃没有力量可言。

flavorText.en: Calm the woes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 平静苦难。

flavorText.en: It is customary to shed a mark after victory or loss—to remind its finder of the history that came before.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在每次获胜或落败后，都习惯性地留下一枚刻印，以此提醒它现在的主人，铭记过去的历史。

flavorText.en: “Okay, then… Let's fight.” —Unknown Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “好的，那么……开打吧。”——无名泰坦

description.en: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.
description.zh-CN: 这个模组已经被弃用，失去了功能。你可以用另一个模组进行替换。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 弃用的护甲模组

flavorText.en: Draw, O Coward!
flavorText.zh-CN: 拔枪吧，胆小鬼！

flavorText.en: "Weyloran never rescinded an oath once granted." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “维洛然从不背弃誓言。”——领主萨拉丁

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: Go forth, wanderer. Enjoy the journey.
flavorText.zh-CN: 勇往直前吧，羁客。享受这段旅程。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Sunbracers. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变炎阳护腕的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "Our fundamental principle, to which all the Arachs must swear, is emigration." —The Book of Departures, Canto I
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们的基本准则，也就是蛛族必须发誓遵守的，是迁移。”——《启程记》，颂歌第一章

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从蛛族杰尔拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Hope shall follow in the wake of your greatest deeds." —The Speaker
flavorText.zh-CN: “随汝之崇高作为苏醒，希望理应纷至踏来。”——先知

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

flavorText.en: That's it. No more. Please.
flavorText.zh-CN: 真是够了。别再来了。拜托了。

flavorText.en: I wish to be strategic.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿深谋远虑。

flavorText.en: You know that you will fight forever.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你深知自己将永无止境地战斗。

flavorText.en: "The nights are long and cold. We must take care of each other." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “夜晚漫长而寒冷。我们必须照应彼此。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: "I don't know about you, but the EDZ has grown on me. Literally. The moss gets everywhere." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不知道你怎么想的，但我越来越喜欢欧洲无人区了。真的，到处都是苔藓。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: "Perhaps it was not the correct choice. But it was the right choice." —Yasmin Eld
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许那不是正确的选择，但却是合理的选择。”——亚斯明·埃尔德

flavorText.en: We celebrate the future we will build together.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂我们将会共同构建的未来。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: "I introduced Lodi to Suraya and her falcon recently. I'm not sure who was more offended at sharing a name: the man, or the bird." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人，还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: I wish to be immovable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿坚定不移。

flavorText.en: To keep our hands warm when the fires burn low.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当火苗低燃时，使我们的双手温暖。

flavorText.en: Haunt the paths yet tread, that your wake may guide those brave enough to follow.
flavorText.zh-CN: 笼罩未涉之途，汝之寒彻乃勇者之信标。

flavorText.en: "The nights are long and cold. We must take care of each other." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “夜晚漫长而寒冷。我们必须照应彼此。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.en: For ages, Guardians have visited new lands, seen the sights, and ransacked them for loot.
flavorText.zh-CN: 多年来，守护者造访了新的土地，饱览各方美景，并在这些美丽的土地上大行掠夺之事。

description.en: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Class stat.
description.zh-CN: 以牺牲少量职业属性为代价，提升此护甲的调整属性。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 一般护甲模组

flavorText.en: Tex Mechanica custom-made mark, warning vagabonds that you mean business.
flavorText.zh-CN: 特克斯机械定制印记，警告那些闲汉你说到做到。

sourceString.zh-CN: 需要已塑形或已强化武器

flavorText.en: "The past is the past; we cannot return to it. All we can do now is fight for the future our people deserve, through blade and blood." —Valus Cau'tor
flavorText.zh-CN: “过去已逝；我们无法回头。我们所能做的，只有为我们的人民所期待的未来而战，用鲜血，用刀剑。”——维鲁斯·卡托

description.en: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.
description.zh-CN: 收缩枪管。瞄准时可缩小弹头散布范围，但会降低精准伤害程度。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen the end of all things. The novenary, the Awoken Queen, the sad, strange little man on his rickety boat. They believe they've seen the same. What they don't know will destroy them." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见了一切的终末。玖，觉醒者女王，还有那个站在摇摇欲坠的飞船上悲伤而奇怪的小家伙。他们相信自己也看到了相同之事。他们的无知将引领他们走向灭亡。”——卡鲁斯大帝

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability
description.zh-CN:
符合空气动力学，重量轻。
  •  略微提高精度
  •  略微提高稳定性

flavorText.en: Hold your applause till the end.
flavorText.zh-CN: 把掌声留到最后。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Saturn's Moon, Titan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在土星卫星，土卫六上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Nobody talks about the day the Shepherd's staff became the Shepherd's rifle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从没人提起过牧羊人权杖变成牧羊人步枪的那天。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Nessus.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在涅索斯上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: How far will you go?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你能走多远？

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages in the EDZ.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在欧洲无人区中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: I will outlive you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 看谁活得久。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on Io.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在木卫一上获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Normally, I would say nothing is beyond us with Queen Mara's assistance… but things are far from normal." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “一般来说，有了玛拉女王的帮助，我们就能势如破竹…但这次的情况很不一般。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: "This relic of ancient trauma is bound by Hive magic, like a new bandage on an old scar." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “这个古老创伤的圣物受到邪魔族魔法的束缚，就像是旧伤疤上的新绷带。”——埃里斯·摩恩

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

flavorText.en: It is a Warlock's duty to carry the seeds of life where they are most needed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 术士有义务将生命之种带到需要它们的地方。

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

flavorText.en:
"I'm here to save you." —Isidel Brandor
"Imitate! Observe! Comprehend!" —Unnamed inhabitant(s), Juno Chasma
flavorText.zh-CN:
“我是来拯救你的。”——伊丝黛尔·布兰德
“效仿！观察！理解！”——无名居者，朱诺深谷

sourceString.en: Source: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：开启传说记忆水晶并获得阵营升级包。

flavorText.en: Cursed to haunt this place forever…
flavorText.zh-CN: 因为诅咒而永远被禁锢在这里……

flavorText.en: "The greatest compliment you can pay in the Crucible is to fight with everything you've got." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “在熔炉竞技场中，你能表现出的最高敬意便是倾尽全力战斗到底。”——领主沙克斯

description.en: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of a reduced amount of weapon stability.
description.zh-CN: 以牺牲较少武器稳定性为代价，大幅提升武器的射程。

flavorText.en: "Ace pilots. Assassination squads. Swift thieves in the night. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “王牌飞行员、刺杀小组还有穿梭暗夜之中的敏捷盗贼。你的部族可以成为出色的暗影军团。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：利维坦，星之塔突袭巢穴。

flavorText.en:
"I don't know what it means
That I am so sad
A legend of bygone days
That I cannot keep out of my mind." —Die Lorelei, Heinrich Heine
flavorText.zh-CN:
“我不知为了什么
我会这般悲伤
有一个旧日故事
在心中念念不忘”——《罗蕾莱》，海因里希·海涅

flavorText.en: Post-Collapse prototype extra-atmospheric combat armor. Scratched inside: "Who's up for a moonwalk?"
flavorText.zh-CN: 大崩溃后大气层外作战护甲原型。里面刻着：“谁想一起漫步月球？”

flavorText.en: "Life is lies. Comfort? Justice? Love? They're things we made up. Don't make the mistake of assuming true and false are the same as good and bad. What's important is being able to tell them apart." —Omar Saint Croix, Hidden handler
flavorText.zh-CN: “生活就是谎言。慰藉？正义？爱？都是我们编造出来的。别误以为真与假就是好与坏。重要的是要能区分它们。”——奥马尔·圣克鲁瓦，隐秘者顾问

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
description.zh-CN: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

flavorText.en: I really wish that I knew how to swim!
flavorText.zh-CN: 要是我知道怎么游泳就好了！

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: A bloody rain. A fitting end.
flavorText.zh-CN: 血雨滂沱，恰是终结。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of the Prospector. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变勘探者的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: Desiccated and nigh inoperable, this Hive artifact still manages to send shivers up your spine when fired.
flavorText.zh-CN: 虽然这件邪魔族神器已破败到几乎无法运作，但开火时依然让你毛骨悚然。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: We thought it was inanimate, but it has grown… changed. Ghost refuses to analyze it further, but I secretly believe it has become my friend.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们以为它没有生命…但它却发生了变化。机灵拒绝对它作进一步的分析，但我暗自相信，它已经成为了我的朋友。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: "A fire cannot burn forever. The embers crack and dance, then drift softly into the ether." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “火的燃烧总有尽头。余烬碎裂起舞，然后轻柔地化为虚无。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "In seeking a true leader, the Executor must test the heart of each candidate, sifting through the weak, foolish, and evil for the good." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13
flavorText.zh-CN: “为寻求一位真正的领导者，执行者必须测试每一位候选人的内心，在软弱、愚钝和邪恶中筛选出善良。”——执行者法则，卷13

flavorText.en: "We might be stopping at Nessus after all. We just lost the starboard engine." —Chief Eng. Kaoru Zuykova
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们也许最终要在涅索斯停下了。我们的右舷引擎报废了。”——薰·佐伊科娃总工程师

description.en:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
description.zh-CN:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

flavorText.en: Adapt or die. It's a core truth of the universe.
flavorText.zh-CN: 适者生存。这是宇宙的终极真理。

description.en: Apply to increase this weapon's level. This weapon level boost can only be applied when the weapon is under Level {var:2648023885}.
description.zh-CN: 应用以提升此武器的等级。该武器升级加速器仅可在武器等级低于{var:2648023885}时应用。

description.en: Defeated targets drop insectoid robots that chase and explode close to other targets.
description.zh-CN: 被击败的目标会掉落可追踪其他目标并在接近时爆炸的类虫机器人。

flavorText.en: They return from fields afar. The eye has passed, the end nears. Do not fade quietly. Let thunder reign again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们从远方归来。目光扫过，结局将至。不要安静消逝，让雷霆再次掌权。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: My first act as emperor was to send the Consul into the wasteland. The golden sun would burn away his corrupt form—a fitting symbol for the revolution that was to be my reign.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我成为帝王后的第一个决定就是把领事发配到荒原去。金黄的太阳会燃尽他的腐败外表——这是我统治变革的象征。

flavorText.en: "Thousands of Guardians fell to Crota and the Hive. Thousands." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “数以千计的守护者倒在了克洛塔和邪魔族面前。成千上万。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "It may look like fun—and trust me, it is—but don't drop that thing. You might hurt yourself." —Cayde-6
flavorText.zh-CN: “这看起来可能很滑稽——相信我，很滑稽——但别扔掉它，会伤到自己的。”——凯德6号

flavorText.en: Strike while the iron's hot.
flavorText.zh-CN: 趁热打铁。

flavorText.en: Questions remain about the "Guardian with the alligator purse."
flavorText.zh-CN: 那个“带着鳄鱼皮钱包的守护者”仍然有许多未解之谜。

flavorText.en: Complete the Homecoming Redux mission, collect Solar orbs in strikes, and complete a meditation for Ikora.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版再见圣城任务，在打击中收集烈日光球，为艾可拉完成一个冥想。

flavorText.en: To inspire our wards with a practiced flourish.
flavorText.zh-CN: 以现实之繁荣扩展吾等领地。

flavorText.en: "The greatest threat to a Guardian is another Guardian." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “对一名守护者来说，最大的威胁是其他守护者。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: We celebrate those we fight with, day after day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赞颂与我们并肩作战的伙伴，日复一日。

flavorText.en: "I have no time for nostalgia. Give me visions of braided futures, brilliantly aflame." —Lakshmi-2
flavorText.zh-CN: “我没时间怀旧。给我编制未来的景象，辉煌且炙热的景象。”——拉克希米-2

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.

flavorText.en: The quest for answers drives you onward.
flavorText.zh-CN: 寻求答案的使命驱使你前进。

description.en: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
description.zh-CN: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

flavorText.en: "The fiercest Light emerged from the tangle of the web grenade. The amethyst divider on his helmet gleamed with rage. I was gone by then. I'm no fool." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
flavorText.zh-CN: “在混乱的网格手雷中，骇人的光能者信步而出。他头盔上的紫水晶分频器发着愤怒的光芒。我那时候已经跑了。我又不傻。”——恶犬公爵，赛克里斯

flavorText.en: Reassurance. Restraint. A hand on the shoulder, offering both.
flavorText.zh-CN: 放在肩膀上的手，可以提供安慰和克制。

flavorText.en: "Future War Cult has an artifact they call 'The Device' which may be Vex in origin." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “未来战争狂热者拥有一个被他们称为‘装置'的神器，它的原始形态模型可能是Vex。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

Between the light and the dark lies deliciousness.
description.zh-CN:
使用虚空伤害击败对手后获得。

在光与暗之间蕴藏着美味。

Just the right thing at just the right time.
description.zh-CN:
通过产生能量球获得。

时机和食材都刚刚好。

description.en:

A delicious taste achieved by getting up close and personal.

使用近战技能击败对手获得。

This flavor will hit the bull's-eye every time.
description.zh-CN:
使用精准伤害击败对手获得。

这种味道每次都能正中靶心。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns, and Heavy Machine Guns.

The more, the merrier.

使用自动步枪、微型冲锋枪、和重机枪击败对手获得。

越多越好。

description.en:

description.zh-CN:
通过使用终结技击败对手获得。

一种可以给你的食谱画龙点睛的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Bows, Sniper Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Pulse Rifles.

An ingredient that brings all the flavors in your recipe together.
description.zh-CN:
通过使用弓箭、狙击步枪、斥候步枪和脉冲步枪击败对手获得。

一种可以糅合你食谱中所有风味的原料。

description.en:
Gained by gathering Orbs of Power.

An ingredient that adds a touch of the Traveler's Light to your recipe.
description.zh-CN:
通过收集能量球获得。

一种可以给你的食谱加一点旅行者之光的原料。

flavorText.en: Nothing is beyond the reach of an open mind.

"How can you protect humanity if you do not know what it is like to be human? To revel in simple pleasures?" —Eva Levante
Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“如果你不知道作为人类是什么感觉，不知道陶醉于简单快乐的感觉，你又如何能够保护人类呢？”——伊娃·莱万特
在2019年狂欢期间，每装备一件活动护甲都将提高好心情的强度。可在苍翠森林，或来自伊娃·莱万特的悬赏中找到其他护甲。

flavorText.zh-CN: “死亡永远不会停止追逐你，负光者，因为所有存在都渴求自己得不到的东西。好好珍惜这无尽的追逐吧！”——钢铁战兽拉利尔

flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿出现令我畏惧之人。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们猎杀的这东西，它很聪明。聪明得可怕。它把我们困在了旧芝加哥地下的墓穴里，然后把其他火力战队一个接一个地干掉了。”——里德-7，Exo泰坦

flavorText.zh-CN: “这不是预言。预言是术士和算命先生的把戏。而我将它称作……远眺。”——基特·阿里·阿米尔

flavorText.en: "We were hatched in the dark. Now we breathe it." —Azeryks, Herald of the Archon
flavorText.zh-CN: “自暗而生，呼吸化暗。”——阿泽瑞克斯，执政官使者

flavorText.en: "That each of us have many lives to give for the City is the Traveler's greatest gift." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者最慷慨的馈赠，就是我们能奉献给圣城的无数条生命。”——萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: "Where is your home? That is where you will fight the hardest." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的家在哪里？哪里就是拼命奋战的地方。”——萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: Where do you stand?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你站哪一边？

flavorText.zh-CN: 慢慢漂回暗礁。

description.zh-CN: 传统防御被禁用，转而偏好进攻能力。处于战斗状态时，较长时间内获得大幅增加的伤害抗性。

flavorText.en: It makes a circle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 周而复始。

sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

description.zh-CN: 宣誓效忠死亡轨道期间完成精准击杀可获得此皮肤。于抵殇胸甲、战甲和法袍上解锁。

description.en: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped.
description.zh-CN: 操控性极佳。装备时移动速度提高。

flavorText.en: "These planets we protect were beautiful. They can be again." —Cryptarch Matsuo
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们保护的这些行星昔颜瑰丽，它们可以再复秀美。”——解密大师松尾

flavorText.en: When the Last City was just a patchwork of campfires, the Iron Lords stood guard.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当最后的城市只闪烁着点点营火时，钢铁领主便已在守卫着她了。

description.en:
An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.
description.zh-CN:
一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

包含一件随机阶级武器或护甲。

flavorText.en: "You said we'd dance through time—reel through realities—together. You can't stop now." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “你说我们是在时间中起舞——在现实中起舞——共同起舞。你不能现在停下来。”——第三百夫长猎人，里斯本-13

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

flavorText.en: "You'll never know truth with real certainty. All you can do is hew away at preconception with the facts and pray that whatever shape's left at the end is a reasonable facsimile." —Dagget-4, Hidden analyst
flavorText.zh-CN: “你永远无法真正确定地了解真相。你能做的就是用事实打破先入为主的观念，并祈祷最后留下的形状是个比较还原的描摹。”——达盖特-4，隐秘者分析师

flavorText.en: I am the perfect loving god, and all will tremble to know me.
flavorText.zh-CN: 每个谈论起我的人都激动到发抖，我就是至善爱神。

flavorText.en: Mighty are they of the stormcloud thrones, and quick to anger, but bounteous to those whom they love.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们在暴风云的王座上是那么的雄伟而易怒，但对至爱之人却又慷慨大方。

flavorText.en: When the universe conspires, its enemies cannot hide.
flavorText.zh-CN: 当宇宙工于谋略，它的敌人将无处可藏。

flavorText.en: "He is that which is an end. And he shall rise again." —passage from Of Hated Nezarec, a pre-Golden Age text.
flavorText.zh-CN: “他就是终结的化身。他终将再次降临。”——前黄金时代文字记录《被憎者奈扎雷克》选段。

flavorText.en: There is so little left. And the cost, so high…
flavorText.zh-CN: 所剩不多。而代价却是如此高昂…

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Praxic Vestment. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变英勇礼服的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: "Walk in peace, and know that there can be no danger in wisdom."
flavorText.zh-CN: “以平和之心而行，明白智慧之中无险境。”

flavorText.en: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I are pillars of this existence, and shall be until all comes crashing down." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “没有。没有任何东西能阻止我们。你我就是这存在的支柱，直到一切都分崩离析。”——卡鲁斯大帝

sourceString.en: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

flavorText.en: Scratches and scars are marks of victory.
flavorText.zh-CN: 累累伤痕皆是胜利的印记。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Contraverse Hold. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变反转之握的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: A Titan without a discipline is like a computer without programs.
flavorText.zh-CN: 缺少纪律的泰坦如同缺少程序的计算机。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Khepri's Sting. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变凯布利之刺的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: SUROS reminds you that a fireteam is better than a soloist.
flavorText.zh-CN: SUROS提醒你，火力战队比独奏者要好。

flavorText.en: I am ready to defend my territory.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我已准备好捍卫领土了。

flavorText.en: You know these roads.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你认得这些道路。

flavorText.en: What came before?
flavorText.zh-CN: 曾经发生了什么？

flavorText.en: "A shield is only as good as thing it protects." —Saint-14
flavorText.zh-CN: “盾之价值，在于所护之物。”——圣人14号

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "Knowing how it ends isn't the same as wanting it to be over." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “知道结局不等于想要结束。”——第三百夫长术士，雷卡纳

flavorText.en: "Some speculate that the radiolarian fluid is the last vestige of a biological life-form that became the Vex." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “有人推测，这种放射液体是变成Vex的生物最后残余的生命形态。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: A metaphysical brace: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件玄学护腿：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示使用此武器时击杀敌人的数量。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在至日期间获得的火种和余烬来升级此物品。

flavorText.en: A real deep chortle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 真正深沉的笑声。

flavorText.en: "The Reef grieves for Uldren Sov, lost in the Taken War. He will be remembered as a voice for peace." —Paladin Devi Cassl
flavorText.zh-CN: “暗礁为欧顿·索维于傀儡战争殒命而哀痛，他将作为和平使者为人铭记。”——圣骑士戴维·卡瑟尔

description.en: Defeat combatants with Sleeper Simulant.
description.zh-CN: 用睡者之吼消灭战斗人员。

flavorText.en: "Under Calus, this system will unite. And when the end comes, we'll be ready. All of us." —Valus Nohr
flavorText.zh-CN: “在卡鲁斯的带领下，银河系必将重组。我们准备好了迎接结局的到来，所有人都是。”——军政官诺阿

flavorText.en: It was She that inspired me to imagine your destruction, o jailer mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 是她启示我想象你的毁灭，哦，我的狱卒啊。

description.en:
Gained by defeating targets with Stasis or Strand damage.

An ingredient that adds a decadently deep, rich flavor.
description.zh-CN:
通过使用冰影或缚丝伤害击败目标获得。

一种可以增添一丝深沉浓郁风味的原料。

flavorText.en: "In any future, the Lighthouse endures." —Saint-14
flavorText.zh-CN: “无论未来会如何，灯塔永存。”——圣人14号

flavorText.en: "Slept in the armor last night. Woke to feel my heart stuttering to the pattern of an unknown signal."
flavorText.zh-CN: “穿着这件护甲睡了一晚。醒来时，发现自己的心脏在随着一个未知的信号颤动。”

flavorText.en: Down the eons they come to test us: gods and cosmic intellects, vandals and mighty empires.
flavorText.zh-CN: 亿万年以来，诸神和宇宙智慧，破坏者和强大的帝国，他们都不断地前来考验我们。

flavorText.en: Devrim Kay fashioned the pattern for these Guardian armor suits.
flavorText.zh-CN: 德弗里姆·卡伊让守护者护甲套装的款式更新潮。

flavorText.zh-CN: 仔细听毒蛇的话，因为它的舌头分叉，言语也随之不同。

flavorText.en: "There has only ever been but a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.

flavorText.en: The unit wears metal as a clam wears shell. There is a new light in the unit's eye. The light is lonely.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我身披金属，犹如蛤蜊藏身壳中。我眼中有新的光芒。孤独的光芒。

flavorText.en: "Regent-Commander Petra Venj, if you take the Queenship, I will take my fleet and leave." —Paladin Kamala Rior
flavorText.zh-CN: “最高指挥官佩特拉·万吉，如果您登基为女王，我将带着我的舰队离开。”——圣骑士卡玛拉·里奥

flavorText.en: Wanna join my fireteam?
flavorText.zh-CN: 想加入我的火力战队吗？

flavorText.en: At the beginning, they stood in thrall of the Formless One, and they offered themselves to its depth.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一开始，他们臣服于无形者，将自己献给其深渊。

description.en: Claim Future War Cult reward engrams in Season 2 to earn this ornament. It is unlocked to the Entanglement Cloak, Mark, and Bond.

flavorText.en: "Enemies become allies, that's just how it goes. Hell, most of my dearest friends killed me at one point or another!" —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “敌人变成盟友，就是这么回事。见鬼，我大多数最亲密的朋友都曾经杀死过我！”——浪客

flavorText.en: Good as new. Come back anytime.
flavorText.zh-CN: 就像新的一样。欢迎随时再来。

flavorText.en: "These planets we protect were beautiful. They can be again." —Cryptarch Matsuo
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们保护的这些行星昔颜瑰丽，它们可以再复秀美。”——解密大师松尾

flavorText.en:
"Be reminded: You've sworn to the emigration. It may be needed at any time." —Jalaal, Dead Orbit Arach

Once you pledge to a faction during this Faction Rally, you can no longer use the other two factions' emotes until this Rally ends.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“提醒一下：你已宣誓移民。随时可能被召唤。”——死亡轨道蛛族，杰尔拉

在此次阵营集结中，一旦宣誓效忠某阵营，在阵营集结结束前你将无法使用其他两个阵营的动作。

flavorText.en: "I've forgotten so much of my past life, of my family. But when I hold this rifle, everything feels right. I feel like… I'm home." —Ana Bray
flavorText.zh-CN: “对于过去的人生，对于家庭，我已经忘记太多。但当拿起这把步枪时，我觉得一切都那么真切，我觉得……我回家了。”——阿娜·布瑞

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "My mother had a shotgun we called the Chaperone. Kept us alive out there before we got to the City." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “我母亲曾有一把被我们称作监护人的霰弹枪。在我们来到圣城之前，是它保护我们安然无恙。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

flavorText.zh-CN: “探测器的初始数据完全不合理。然后信号就消失了。我们能发现什么？”——沙尼斯·佩尔博士

flavorText.en: "Move quickly. The world never waits." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “动作要快。世界不等人。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是传达给所有卡巴尔不忠者的消息——你效忠于我。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

flavorText.zh-CN: 是财富找到了你还是你找到了财富？

flavorText.zh-CN: 无论你身在天涯海角，家总在比臆想更近的地方。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

flavorText.zh-CN: 英雄，你真是个解决问题的高手。继续努力吧。

flavorText.zh-CN: “也许你已逃脱天启初降，但你永难摆脱天启再临。”——浪客

- Complete Lost Sectors on any destination.
- Collect Void orbs in free roam on any destination.
- Defeat combatants with precision damage.

至日英雄2021期间：
-在任意目的地完成遗失区域。
-在任意目的地的自由漫游中收集虚空能量球。
-使用精准伤害消灭战斗人员。

flavorText.zh-CN: “怀疑的核心总会存在。问问自己，是什么原因让我来到了这里？”——领主邪冬

description.en: Your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Activating Thruster creates Stasis crystals.

description.en: Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.
description.zh-CN: 充能近战或终结技最后一击会释放一次伤害性爆炸。

description.en:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

flavorText.zh-CN: 天钿RR4在手，暗影不堪一击。

flavorText.zh-CN: SUROS邀你来到起点线。

description.en: This weapon fires singular bolts in full auto. When the magazine is emptied, ammo is pulled from across timelines to refill it based on the number of shots landed.

description.zh-CN: 这把武器射出的弹药伤害衰减程度下降，能够贯穿目标，接触坚硬的表面会反弹。反弹后弹头伤害增加。

flavorText.en: Some say the mind is the most powerful weapon. I tend to agree.
flavorText.zh-CN: 有人说思想是最强大的武器，我愿表赞同。

flavorText.en: "You can't leave me. Not like this." —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin

flavorText.en: Complete the Chosen Redux mission, defeat enemies with Void Energy weapons, and complete a Nightfall.

flavorText.en: "I consider them enemies of the Light, no matter what powers they command." —Commander Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “无论他们拥有何种力量，我都将他们视作光能的敌人。”——指挥官萨瓦拉

flavorText.en: Make sure to bury your enemies.
flavorText.zh-CN: 务必将敌人埋葬。

flavorText.zh-CN: “‘中国航天局委托制造'…要是它撑了这么长时间，应该能让你撑久一点。”——昆恩·菈咖利

description.en: Aspects modify your subclass with new actions for your Guardian to bring to combat.
description.zh-CN: 星相会为你的守护者的分支职业提供新的动作以带入战斗之中。

description.en: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.

description.zh-CN: 进行一次灵活翻滚闪身，避开战斗人员的攻击，并生成近战技能能量。获得的能量会根据你的近战属性调整。在敌人附近闪身可提升获得的能量。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete public events on any destination.
- Collect Arc or Stasis Elemental Orbs in strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.
- Defeat Guardians in Crucible or Gambit.

至日英雄2021期间：
-在任意目的地完成公共事件。
-在打击、熔炉竞技场或智谋游戏列表活动中收集电弧或冰影元素能量球。

flavorText.en: "Some know the legend. We were forged in the fires of a burning world." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些人知道这则传说：我们是在一个熊熊燃烧的世界中历练出来的。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.zh-CN: “调整航向两度。朋友们，距离开普勒-186还有很长一段路。我们没有时间游览涅索斯。”——马苏德·雅各布森船长

flavorText.en: Is it possible to measure the infinite?

description.zh-CN: 使用电弧近战造成最后一击可触发生命值回复并完全恢复一次近战充能。近战命中可提供电弧近战能量。

description.en:
Weighted Knife gains a second bounce. Rapid precision hits with your weapons grant Weighted Knife a significant damage bonus, bonus melee, and the ability to stun unshielded combatants for a short time.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
description.zh-CN:
权衡飞刀可以弹跳两次。用你的武器获得快速精准命中可为权衡飞刀提供大幅伤害加成和近战加成，并且在短时间内眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

强化权衡飞刀克制势不可挡勇士。

description.en:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.
description.zh-CN:
通过等量使用光能与暗影伤害类型造成伤害或对你的盟友施加分支职业增益来实现和谐。动能伤害会同时生成光能与暗影能量。

当超凡状态生效时，你的手雷会被替换为同时造成光能与暗影伤害的独特棱镜手雷。处于超凡状态时，造成近战伤害会大幅提升手雷能量回复速度，反之亦然。处于超凡状态时，击败目标可延长其持续时间。

An engram with untapped potential.

Contains a random tiered weapon or armor piece.

一块有着开发潜力的记忆水晶。

flavorText.zh-CN: 以大师或更高难度完成一项先锋行动活动。

flavorText.en: Nobody talks about the day the Shepherd's staff became the Shepherd's rifle.

description.en: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

flavorText.en: "Earth is our home. Not Mars, not Venus, not even the Reef. We must ensure it is a place we can continue to live for many generations to come." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “地球才是我们的家。不是火星，不是金星，更不是暗礁。我们要确保那是个我们可以几代长久生存下去的地方。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Nightfall strike "Lake of Shadows."
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成日落打击“暗影之湖”。

flavorText.en: Inhale. Exhale. Flash of light. Endless fallout.

description.en: This weapon fires blasts of high-damage Arc energy that overpenetrates enemies.
description.zh-CN: 可发射贯穿敌人的高伤害电弧冲击能量。

flavorText.en: A Black Armory experimental prototype.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件黑色军械库实验原型。

sourceString.en: Source: Crafted in a Black Armory forge.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：在黑色军械库锻炉中制造。

description.en: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用其他武器造成最后一击或持续精准命中，会在短时间内增加此武器的射速。

description.en: Gain an additional class ability charge.
description.zh-CN: 获得额外一次职业技能充能。

description.en: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapidly defeating combatants grants Burning Souls that increase the potency of healing when using Dodge and spread the healing to nearby allies.
description.zh-CN: 激活职业技能会提供治愈。快速击败战斗人员提供燃烧之魂，从而提升使用闪身时治疗的效力，并将治疗扩散至附近的盟友。

description.en: Dealing damage with a powered melee or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful Arc melee counterpunch.
description.zh-CN: 使用充能近战造成伤害或被近战攻击命中将允许你追加一次相当强大的电弧近战反击。

description.en: Your Void weapons gain volatile rounds after you emerge from being invisible.
description.zh-CN: 当你从隐身状态出现时，你的虚空武器会获得不稳定弹药。

description.en: Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
description.zh-CN: 使用手雷时会获得织造铠甲。

description.en: Allies inside the Duskfield grenade field gain Frost Armor and targets inside the field deal reduced damage.
description.zh-CN: 处于暮域手雷范围内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，处于范围内的目标造成的伤害减少。

description.en: Powered melee final blows trigger an ignition.
description.zh-CN: 充能近战最后一击会触发一次点燃。

description.en: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability grants you a temporary damage bonus for weapons matching that ability's element.
description.zh-CN: 使用技能对强力战斗人员或守护者造成伤害，会为与该技能元素匹配的武器提供临时伤害加成。

description.en: Hits and final blows with your Super will return Super energy after it ends.
description.zh-CN: 使用超能造成命中和最后一击将于超能结束后返还超能能量

description.en: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
description.zh-CN: 你的武器准备得更快且更稳定。使用你的职业技能会暂时提升此加成，并从储备弹药中填装当前装备的武器。

description.en:
Archie loves these dog-safe cookies, even though he can't really eat them! Deliver them to him in the Tower Annex.
 - Available only during the Dawning.

阿奇很喜欢这些对狗无害的饼干，尽管他其实吃不了！把它们送到高塔附属建筑，交给他。
 - 仅在曙光节期间有效。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

description.en:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
description.zh-CN:
将你的电弧法杖向前抛出，将其嵌在表面或大型目标上，震颤附近的目标。

短时间后，一道毁灭性的闪电将击中法杖，使其被电弧能量过充。在过充时，你的法杖会对附近的敌人放出闪电。

description.en:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

Heavy attack combos and airborne heavy slams blind targets.
description.zh-CN:
生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

[格挡]：按住来用你的电弧法杖抵挡来袭的射弹。

抵挡射弹会为你提供一层电光充能。

重攻击连击和空中猛击重攻击会致盲目标。

description.en:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
description.zh-CN:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

flavorText.en: Relax. We've got plenty of time.

flavorText.zh-CN: “很有意思的是，谁都不愿意听末日预言家的话。他们可是我认识的最诚实的人了。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "Vex structures on Venus and Mercury predate the Golden Age, and possibly Humanity itself." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “金星和水星上的Vex建筑是在黄金时代之前，甚至可能在人类出现之前建造的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

description.en: Hide your true face from the sun, lest you get burned.
description.zh-CN: 唯恐灼伤，将真正面容隐于烈日之下。

flavorText.en: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——

description.en: Grants a chance to receive an extra Vanguard token whenever you get one.
description.zh-CN: 任何时间得到一枚先锋代币时都有几率获得一枚额外代币。

flavorText.en: "I have heralded disaster so often that my mere presence is an omen. So be it." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我经常预示着灾难，以至于我的出现就是一种噩兆。那就这样吧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "We believe she's also responsible for the dead Guardian and Eliksni we found on Venus. We haven't identified which dead Ghost belongs to the Guardian." —Vanguard Security Report Excerpt
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们相信她也是我们在金星上发现的死去的守护者和埃里克斯尼族的元凶。我们还没确定哪个死去的机灵属于那位守护者。”——《先锋安全报告》节选

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示使用此武器时击杀敌人的数量。

description.en: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.
description.zh-CN: 完成精准击杀可以提高填装速度并使目标爆炸，对附近的敌人造成烈日伤害。

flavorText.en: "Press on! The Devils will rue the day they came to our doors!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “继续前进！魔鬼都会后悔它们来敲门的那一天！”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "I've chosen my path. Can you say the same?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “我选择了我的道路。你呢？”——第三百夫长术士，雷卡纳

description.en:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.
description.zh-CN:
使用近战对目标造成伤害会施加强效腐化，随时间造成递增伤害。击败腐化的目标会扩散此状态。

中幅提高所有忧愁武器的空中效率属性。

flavorText.en: ~directive = KILL while enemies = PRESENT: execute(directive)~
flavorText.zh-CN: ~指令=击杀 当敌人=出现：执行（指令）~

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: See strife, seek balance.
flavorText.zh-CN: 见纷争，求平衡。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "Maybe you leave your first apocalypse. But your second one never leaves you." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “也许你已逃脱天启初降，但你永难摆脱天启再临。”——浪客

flavorText.en: With victory assured, take time to rejoice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 胜利在望，花点时间来庆祝。

flavorText.zh-CN: “我梦想一个愿意为自己的存在而战的世界。”——拉克希米-2

sourceString.en: Source: Earn rank-up packages from Lakshmi-2.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：从拉克希米-2处获得升级包。

Available only during the Dawning.

给水星灯塔上的万斯修士送去这些神秘而模糊的小食。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

一件从奥斯里斯试炼中获取的罕见珍品。

flavorText.zh-CN: “卡鲁斯在黑暗边缘发现的东西……一旦它重见光明，很有可能会成为一个我们在这个星系中从未见过的存在。”——军政官诺阿

flavorText.en: They do not yet know what true cold is.

description.en: This weapon fires special shield-piercing ammunition and is strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Precision hits grant targeting data. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to the alternate scope, loading high-damage rounds based on the amount of targeting data. High damage rounds create shockwaves around impacted targets, exhausting them.

flavorText.en: Defeat combatants with Elemental damage, collect Elemental Orbs using a matching [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] subclass, and as a team, defeat opposing Guardians in the Crucible or Gambit using Solar weapons.

This item applies a blue glow to all Solstice leg armor. Once you unlock it, it's available for all three classes.

此物品会为所有至日腿部护甲提供一个蓝色炫彩效果。所有三个职业都将获得解锁的物品。

flavorText.zh-CN: “生活就是谎言。慰藉？正义？爱？都是我们编造出来的。别误以为真与假就是好与坏。重要的是要能区分它们。”——奥马尔·圣克鲁瓦，隐秘者顾问

flavorText.zh-CN: 任何生物，无论看上去是普通单调还是特别可怕，都可能对守护者构成威胁。

flavorText.en: "Petra Venj, I formally request that you take the Queenship." —Paladin Leona Bryl

flavorText.zh-CN: “夜晚漫长而寒冷。我们必须照应彼此。”——泰拉·卡恩

flavorText.zh-CN: “我们还在这真是个奇迹。继续保持下去。”——奥斯里斯

description.zh-CN: 装备此物品以改变机灵投影。

flavorText.en: "A Reefborn riotgun, rewritten with Hive voices to aid Gahlran the failed. Now yours." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “一把暗礁后裔的防暴枪，经过邪魔族声音的改造后以协助陨落的加尔兰。现在它是你的了。”——卡鲁斯大帝

sourceString.en: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

flavorText.en: "Some know the legend. We crossed a burning world with sword in hand, bringing justice and blood." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些人知道这则传说：我们手握利剑，踏遍了一个燃烧的世界，用鲜血书写正义。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: "Be careful out there. If a rescue happens, I'd rather be the rescuee than the one doing the rescuing." —Devrim Kay
flavorText.zh-CN: “在外要小心。如果一定要救援，宁愿我是被救的那一个也不愿我来救你们。”——德弗里姆·卡伊

flavorText.en: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是传达给所有卡巴尔不忠者的消息——你效忠于我。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：利维坦，星之塔突袭巢穴。

flavorText.en: To their shame, most of the wide-scattered Firebreak Order survived the City's fall.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们感到耻辱的是，分布甚广的碎焰教的大部分教众都在圣城沦陷时活了下来。

flavorText.en: "I got no qualms with them shackin' up here, but you ask me, they're wild for lookin' up to that big ball in the sky again. Didn't end well the last time around. Fool me once and all that." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们住在这里，我不在乎，但他们崇拜天上大球，那就不一样了。上次就没什么好结果。愚弄我一次，是你的耻辱；愚弄我两次，是我的耻辱。”——浪客

flavorText.en: "Sometimes the difference between survival and eradication is just pure, simple stubbornness." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “有时候，生与死之间只差一股简单纯粹的犟劲。”——浪客

description.zh-CN: 造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

description.en: Quicksilver nanites grant more health the greater your stacks of Nano-Assault are. Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active has the chance to generate nanites nearby.
description.zh-CN: 瞬变纳米蜂群会根据你的纳米突袭层数提供更多生命值。纳米突袭生效时受到伤害有几率在附近生成纳米蜂群。

description.en: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
description.zh-CN: 造成持续伤害会灼烧目标。对被灼烧的目标造成伤害会施加灼烧效果。

flavorText.en:
Subroutine IKELOS: Status=reinitiated.
APOTHEOSIS: Status=active…
flavorText.zh-CN:
子程序似像者：状态=已恢复。
神化：状态=激活……

sourceString.en: Source: World Quest "Data Recovery" on Mars.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：火星上的世界任务“恢复数据”。

description.en:
An Exotic catalyst can be inserted into this socket.

Check the Exotic catalysts section in Triumphs to learn where the catalyst can be obtained.
description.zh-CN:
可以将异域催化插入此插槽。

查看成就中的异域催化部分，了解在哪里可以获得催化。

flavorText.en: "Busy hands are warm hands! Do your part for the colony in these extra-insulated work gloves." —Excerpt from the Eventide Welcome Guide
flavorText.zh-CN: “忙碌起来，你的手就不会感觉到寒冷！戴上这双绝缘性极好的工作手套，参与到殖民地的建设中来吧。”——摘自布瑞科技薄暮殖民地欢迎指南

flavorText.en: A weapon of Vex origin frozen at the moment before it lets its ordnance fly—like an arm, spear in hand, forever paused at the apex of its throw. It is the embodiment of action forever postponed, desperate to be unleashed.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件源自于Vex的武器，停留在它甩出军械的前一刻。就像一只拿着长矛的手臂永远定格在了投掷的顶点。它是无限延期动作的化身，拼命想要释放出来。

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

flavorText.en: The Iron Lords were the first to declare themselves Guardians of the Traveler and the people.
flavorText.zh-CN: 钢铁领主第一个宣布自己是旅行者和人民的守护者。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成铁旗比赛并从领主萨拉丁处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: What's that off in the distance? Tally-ho!
flavorText.zh-CN: 远处那里的是什么？我找到了！

flavorText.en: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “这是传达给所有卡巴尔不忠者的消息——你效忠于我。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

description.en: Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.
description.zh-CN: 将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Arc damage.

It courses through everything we touch… and taste.
description.zh-CN:
使用电弧伤害击败对手获得。

它流淌在一切我们触碰……和品尝到的东西中。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Solar damage.

Hotter than a Golden Gun on the surface of the sun.
description.zh-CN:
使用烈日伤害击败对手获得。

比在太阳表面的黄金枪还要火热。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Fallen opponents.

An ingredient that adds an ethereal sweetness to anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
击败堕落者后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许以太甜味的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Vex opponents.

An ingredient that adds a bit of radiolarian liquid to anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
击败Vex后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许放射性液体的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Hive opponents.

An ingredient that adds a bit of spice to anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
击败邪魔族对手获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许辛辣味的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Cabal opponents.

An ingredient that toughens and thickens up anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
通过击败卡巴尔获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许浓稠度的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Scorn opponents.

An ingredient that adds a darkly sweet aroma to anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
击败嗤魅后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许黑暗甜味的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating Taken opponents.

An ingredient that adds an echoing deliciousness to anything it touches.
description.zh-CN:
击败傀儡军团后获得。

一种能为它接触到的一切都添加些许美味回味的原料。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Swords.

A taste that will cut right through your taste buds.
description.zh-CN:
使用刀剑击败对手获得。

能穿透你味蕾的味道。

description.en:
Gained by defeating opponents with Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Grenade abilities.

Sudden and violent. And also tasty.
description.zh-CN:
使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、和手雷技能击败对手后获得。

突兀而强烈，但也很美味。

flavorText.en: Archaeologists understand: a buried hatchet is still, after all, a hatchet.
flavorText.zh-CN: 考古学家们明白：埋在地下的斧头说到底还是斧头。

flavorText.en: Firm orders compel Legionaries to fight to the end—hoping for a lucky shot.
flavorText.zh-CN: 严苛的命令迫使军团士兵战斗到最后一刻——希望能够天降大运。

flavorText.en: I wish to be strategic.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿深谋远虑。

description.en:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability
description.zh-CN:
提升稳定性。
  •  提高稳定性

flavorText.en: Entropy's lesson: one day we'll all be still.
flavorText.zh-CN: 熵之训诫：终归寂灭。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“永恒沙漠”史诗突袭

description.en: Maximized resistance.
description.zh-CN: 最高抗性。

description.en: Base-level armor. Increase the tier to forge a Masterwork item.
description.zh-CN: 基础级护甲。提高护甲阶层，将其铸造为大师杰作物品。

flavorText.en: Tex Mechanica custom-made pants, outfitted with flared seams for smoother glides.
flavorText.zh-CN: 特克斯机械定制长裤，喇叭口设计以便更顺畅地滑行。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: "Become their nightmare." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “成为他们的梦魇吧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: The killer robot killer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 杀手级的机器人杀手。

flavorText.en: "Was Wolf once. Still Wolf after Scatter, but… different. Then Queen's. Wolf again. Bannerless. Then Spider's." —Avrok
flavorText.zh-CN: “曾为狼族，散战后依旧，但却……不同。接着属于女王，又为狼族，无名之狼。再隶蛛王。”——埃弗罗克

flavorText.en: Down in the abyss, there was no hope.
flavorText.zh-CN: 深渊之中毫无希望。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器破坏敌人的护盾，使他们在一小段时间内对动能伤害的承受力更低。

flavorText.en: "Multiple analyses confirm: the milky radiolarian fluid found in Vex chassis is organic in nature." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “多次分析确认的结果：在Vex机体中发现的乳白色放射液体实质上是有机的。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: "Pray or prey. It's all the same." —Aunor Mahal
flavorText.zh-CN: “祈祷与捕食并无不同。”——阿诺尔·玛哈

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: "Where is your home? That is where you will fight the hardest." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “你的家在哪里？哪里就是拼命奋战的地方。”——萨瓦拉

flavorText.zh-CN: 对于这种病，有良药一剂。

flavorText.zh-CN: “遗失之物终会被冲上纷争海岸。”——蛛王

flavorText.zh-CN: “狡诈随时都可能扳倒力量。磨练好你自己吧。”——佩纶夫人

description.zh-CN: 星相会为你的守护者的分支职业提供新的动作以带入战斗之中。

flavorText.en: "The Vex can't stop us now. No one can."  —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “Vex现在阻止不了我们了。谁都阻止不了我们。”  ——第三百夫长泰坦，雅尔达姆-4

flavorText.zh-CN: 搜寻自有其智慧。

description.zh-CN: 将武器重置为默认外观。

flavorText.en: Finders, keepers.
flavorText.zh-CN: 谁捡到就是谁的。

flavorText.en: "I know my duty." —Chalco Yong to Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我知道我的职责。”——卡尔科·杨对艾可拉·蕾伊说

flavorText.en: Titans are taught to repair their armor after every battle. These gauntlets are a lost cause.
flavorText.zh-CN: 泰坦聆听教诲，在每次战斗之后都会修补自己的盔甲。这幅臂铠便是注定失败之物。

description.en:
This weapon gains reload speed, range, and slightly increased damage against combatants for a short time when combat begins.

Final blows extend and enhance this bonus.
description.zh-CN:
战斗开始时，此武器在短时间内获得填装速度、射程，并略微提升对战斗人员的伤害。

最后一击会延长和强化此加成。

description.en: Modifications for your ship's transmat systems, so you'll always arrive in style.
description.zh-CN: 改造飞船的传送系统使你的登场更酷炫。

"Galanor is beyond my skill to repair."

flavorText.zh-CN:

description.zh-CN: 武器发射的激光可穿透敌人，遇到坚硬表面可产生折射。

flavorText.en: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
flavorText.zh-CN: 凤凰自我磨砺，而后从余烬中涅槃重生。那就是熔炉竞技场。

flavorText.en: “At this point, it's a given… There will be pain.” —Unknown Titan
flavorText.zh-CN: “现在，毫无疑问的是……肯定会很痛。”——无名泰坦

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from the Iron Banner.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从铁旗中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

description.zh-CN: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

flavorText.zh-CN: “当你掌握了光能，它将成为你达成目标途中的敲门砖。”——轻盈的丽莎

flavorText.en: A metaphysical guard: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件玄学护手：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。
