flavorText.en: They will know you by the bonds you forge.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们会通过你建立的纽带而知晓你。

flavorText.en: You needn't ask twice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无需多问。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "I have foreseen what must fall so the Empire may rise. Your mastery of knowledge apocryphal shall make true Cabal of us all." —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我预见到了帝国的崛起势必要伴随着某事的殒落。你对外经的渊博学问让我们见识到了卡巴尔的典范。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: The equations balance thus: you are diminished, and I am exalted. You are broken, and I am made strong.
flavorText.zh-CN: 等式是这样达到平衡的：你被踩在脚下，我被人奉为强者。你被打得趴下，而我变得强大。

flavorText.en: Why don't we go where fashion sits?
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们为什么不紧跟时尚潮流呢？

flavorText.en: We hope everyone enjoys the show!
flavorText.zh-CN: 希望大家喜欢这场演出！

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after final blows.
description.zh-CN: 强力射击，高后坐力。最后一击后射速提高。

flavorText.en: Unseen deliverance.
flavorText.zh-CN: 看不见的解脱。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：篇章怨魂赛季活动

flavorText.en: “With the death of the Ace-Defiant, the Leviathan is without a master helmsman. If I must wait another millennium for a replacement, I shall.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “随着那位王牌猎手的死去，利维坦没有了舵手。即便要一千年才能等到替代者，我也愿意等待。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: My gift to the Hunter with Ghaul's cunning.
flavorText.zh-CN: 赠予如同盖欧一般狡黠的猎人的礼物。

flavorText.en: If something heavy's coming in, send something heavy back out.
flavorText.zh-CN: 如果有沉重之物进来，就把沉重之物送出去。

flavorText.en: Function: Go all in.
flavorText.zh-CN: 功能：赌上一切。

flavorText.en: "That each of us have many lives to give for the City is the Traveler's greatest gift." —Zavala
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者最慷慨的馈赠，就是我们能奉献给圣城的无数条生命。”——萨瓦拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成打击并从指挥官萨瓦拉处获得升级包。

flavorText.en:
"Only a monarch can raise the City from these ashes." —Hideo, New Monarchy Executor

Once you pledge to a faction during this Faction Rally, you can no longer use the other two factions' emotes until this Rally ends.
flavorText.zh-CN:
“只有真正的君主才能从废墟中重振圣城。”——新王派执行者，秀夫

在此次阵营集结中，一旦宣誓效忠某阵营，在阵营集结结束前你将无法使用其他两个阵营的动作。

flavorText.en: No matter how fast I run, I never get where I'm going.
flavorText.zh-CN: 无论我跑多快都到不了目的地。

flavorText.en: Upgrade this item using Kindling and Embers obtained during Solstice.
flavorText.zh-CN: 使用在至日期间获得的火种和余烬升级此物品。

flavorText.en: Plating the Ahamkara bones in silver helps to quiet the auditory hallucinations… o bearer mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 用白银包裹阿罕卡拉遗骨有助于消除幻听……吾辈的背负者。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

description.en: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.
description.zh-CN: 在此武器准备就绪前，使用其他两件武器造成伤害可从弹药储备中填装弹药。

description.en: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器对敌人造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提高瞄准时的移速。此特性生效时弓箭可获得更快的拉弓速度，而刀剑可获得更快的充能速度。

description.en: You vanish from sight and do not appear on radar. While invisible, your radar range is reduced. Performing offensive actions will end invisibility.
description.zh-CN: 你将从视线中消失，不会出现在雷达上。隐身时，你的雷达范围会缩小。发起进攻会终止隐身。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 术士通用皮肤

flavorText.en: "Petra Venj, I formally request that you take the Queenship." —Paladin Leona Bryl
flavorText.zh-CN: “佩特拉·万吉，我郑重请求您登上女王之位。”——圣骑士蕾欧娜·布蕾尔

description.en: Gain an improved amount of health based on the number of hits before reloading.
description.zh-CN: 根据填装之前完成的命中数更多地恢复生命值。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.
description.zh-CN: 生命值低下时，使用此武器造成最后一击可提供强化雷达，将你从敌方守护者雷达上移除，并减少战斗人员对你的攻击性。

flavorText.en: "Take pride in your team, on and off the battlefield." —Saint-14
flavorText.zh-CN: “战场内外，都要为自己的队伍而自豪。”——圣人14号

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

flavorText.en: A shot straight through the heart!
flavorText.zh-CN: 直穿心脏的发射！

flavorText.en: "The Awoken have been bleeding territories for years now. Tangled Shore was just the first to slip between the cracks." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “多年以来，觉醒者的领土一直在逐渐沦陷，纷争海岸首当其冲。”——蛛王

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities and earn rank-up packages on the Tangled Shore.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成活动并在纷争海岸中获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "We've progressed into a liminal space. Corridors folding on each other. Psychometer is spiking here; are we sure this is safe?" —Hidden Mindscape Expedition 2nd Transmission
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们进入到了一处阈限空间。廊道相互折叠。心理测试仪在这里达到了峰值；我们确定这样安全吗？”——隐秘者心像空间探险第2次通讯

description.en: Complete "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" on Prestige difficulty to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 完成巅峰难度“世界吞噬者，利维坦”可解锁并装备此皮肤。

description.en: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants improved stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.
description.zh-CN: 使用此武器造成伤害或击败目标可逐渐提升稳定性、操控性、填装速度和充能速度。此效果会随时间逐渐减弱，但在靠近盟友时会更快获得。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

flavorText.en:
Amid the endless death one flew—unnatural all-consuming need—
And in the space between the two, accursed comprehension freed.
flavorText.zh-CN:
无尽的死亡之中有一人例外——违背自然吞噬一切的需要——
在生死之间，迸发了被诅咒的领悟。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。

flavorText.en:
To Tower comes a war in red; an orphan sounds the empire's call.
Mortal angels mourn the dead while lightless light wraps night in pall.
flavorText.zh-CN:
猩红色的战争降临高塔；孤儿奏响帝国之声。
凡间天使为死者哀悼，无光之光为暗夜盖上棺罩。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Osiris' Lost Prophecies for Brother Vance on Mercury.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：为水星上的万斯修士完成奥斯里斯的失落预言。

flavorText.en: "It's not enough to react! You must predict your opponent's next move if you hope to counter it." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “光是回应是不够的！如果想作出反击，你必须预测对手的下一步。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

description.en: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Eyes of Tomorrow. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变明日之眼的外观。你账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "Tradition binds us. It keeps us in line. It is the foundation of family, and the Black Armory is a family." —Y. Satou
flavorText.zh-CN: “传统将我们紧密联合。传统让我们循规蹈矩。传统是家庭的根基，而整个黑色军械库就是一家人。”——Y·佐藤

description.en:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
description.zh-CN:
造成持续伤害可提供对载具和构造体的额外伤害，并从备弹中填充弹药。主弹药伤害或对构造体的伤害可提供额外进度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

flavorText.en: "In the heat of battle, Guardian, you will know the right choice to make." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “守护者，当身处激烈的战斗中时，你便会做出正确的选择。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.zh-CN: “似乎是死了，但紧接着她坐了起来。唯一的症状是失忆。甚至不记得自己的名字。”——撒哈拉争议地区编年史

flavorText.en:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete public events on Europa or Battlegrounds from Season of the Chosen.
- Collect Solar or Stasis Elemental Orbs in strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlists.
- Defeat combatants with melee attacks while using a Solar subclass.

至日英雄2021期间：
-在木卫二完成公共事件或完成天选赛季的战场。
-在打击、熔炉竞技场或智谋游戏列表中收集烈日或冰影元素能量球。
-在装备了烈日分支职业的情况下使用近战攻击消灭战斗人员。

flavorText.zh-CN: “如果你知道该去哪里找，任何不可能的境况都会有出路。”——玛拉·索维

flavorText.zh-CN: 进入神灵的身体无疑是一种玷污。

flavorText.en: "I will not end so easily." —Harrow, Dredgen Apprentice
flavorText.zh-CN: “我不会如此轻易就消亡。”——哈罗，德瑞捷学徒

flavorText.en: It's possible for an Exo to confuse their armor as part of their body: but then, y'see, they'll feel naked.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个Exo也许会将自己的盔甲误认为身体的一部分：但你瞧，那样一来的话，他们就会觉得自己一丝不挂了啊。

description.en:
Deliver this unfortunate reminder of Asher's past to him in the Rupture on Io.

Available only during the Dawning.
description.zh-CN:
把这个让他想起自己不幸过去的点心送给木卫一裂口中的阿什。

仅在曙光节期间有效。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 稀有 已发现的食谱

description.en: Rapidly healing allies grants the intrinsic elemental benefit to you. This benefit is more potent for you and your allies.
description.zh-CN: 快速治疗盟友可为你提供固有特性元素增益。该增益对你和盟友都更为强效。

flavorText.en: "I will always protect the Black Armory, above all else." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “我会永远保护黑色军械库，这个使命高于一切。”——艾达-1

flavorText.en: "Just remember, post-crash Ghost rez in a vacuum can be, ah… complicated. So try not to die."  —Shun Endo
flavorText.zh-CN: “记住，坠机后在真空中让机灵复生会比较，呃……复杂。尽量别挂了。”——远藤骏

flavorText.en: "The instinct to migrate comes to many at once, without warning. Unlike birds, we must make preparations—we must make our own wings." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII
flavorText.zh-CN: “毫无预兆的，迁移的想法突然本能地冒了出来。我们不是鸟儿，我们需要准备——我们需要翅膀。”——《启程记》，颂歌第七章

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

flavorText.en: Ensign of untarnished principle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 谨守还未失去光华的准则。

description.en: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
description.zh-CN: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得更长时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

flavorText.en: "I introduced Lodi to Suraya and her falcon recently. I'm not sure who was more offended at sharing a name: the man or the bird." —Ikora Rey
flavorText.zh-CN: “我最近把洛迪介绍给了苏拉娅和她的鹘鹰。我不确定谁更为重名而不舒服：那个人还是那只鸟。”——艾可拉·蕾伊

flavorText.en: Not a thought was given, but a life was taken.
flavorText.zh-CN: 五蕴皆空，夺命无形。

flavorText.en: Feeling the fury in your chest.
flavorText.zh-CN: 感受胸中怒火。

flavorText.en: "When the long dark closes around us, we will be the last light." —Wei Ning
flavorText.zh-CN: “被漫长黑夜包围时，我们将是最后的光。”——韦宁

flavorText.en: There will always be paths to tread and methods to try. Roll with it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 总会有前行的道路和值得尝试的方法。学会适应。

flavorText.en: Now what did this do again?
flavorText.zh-CN: 这是做什么的来着？

flavorText.en: The Psions who spied on Crucible training at Thuria were bemused by all the complaining.
flavorText.zh-CN: 前往苏瑞亚侦察熔炉竞技场训练情况的辅助士兵被指责之声弄得困惑不堪。

flavorText.en: "Since the Scatter, nowhere in the Reef felt like home. Before I knew it, I found myself on the Shore." —Renegade Corsair Errol Mayz
flavorText.zh-CN: “自从散战以来，无处如暗礁一般有家的感觉。在我意识到这一点之前，我发现自己身在海岸之上。”——变节海盗军，埃洛尔·梅兹

description.en: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.

flavorText.en: "There is a place where we can remember who we are." —Imogen Rife
flavorText.zh-CN: “有一处可容我们铭记自己的地方。”——依莫根·莱弗

flavorText.en: The old workhorse, still with many years to give.
flavorText.zh-CN: 虽然老旧，但还能用上很长一段时间。

flavorText.en: "The Traveler called me back. Told me my work on this side isn't done yet." —Seong-Do Whiteclaw
flavorText.zh-CN: “旅行者将我召回，告知我在这边的工作尚未完成。”——圣道白爪

flavorText.en: "You wanna use your old name, that's fine by me. Just don't tell anyone." —Micah-10 to Himura Shinobu
flavorText.zh-CN: “你想用自己曾经的名字，我没意见。只是别跟别人提起。”——米迦-10致忍野绯村

flavorText.en: Time is an ocean, vast without shore.
flavorText.zh-CN: 时间就是海洋，辽阔无岸。

flavorText.zh-CN: “而机灵们呢？我觉得它们无法真正理解我们是谁。要模拟光能相当困难。超因果等等等等。”——萨吉拉

flavorText.en: The orbital city of Caer Lerion was one of Earth's crowning achievements in the Golden Age.
flavorText.zh-CN: 开尔·雷利昂的轨道城市曾是地球在黄金时代无与伦比的成就之一。

flavorText.en: "In my company, the Ether flows." —The Spider
flavorText.zh-CN: “乙太涓流，伴我同行。”——蛛王

flavorText.en: A Scout Rifle, modified by Dead Orbit's superb technicians and specialists.
flavorText.zh-CN: 经过死亡轨道的优秀技师和专家改造的一把斥候步枪。

flavorText.zh-CN: “每个人都有自己的路，做自己该做的就行了。”———凯德6号

"Like old Drifter's gonna let this collect dust on a shelf just cause of some failed safety tests… Don't they know what we're dealing with?"
—The Drifter

“想让老浪客因为这东西没通过几次安全测试就让它明珠蒙尘？做梦。他们不知道我们现在在对付什么吗？”
——浪客

A visitor ignites the sky, and in the truth of light it dreams:
Above the dead and yet-to-die, a legion's blade with fire screams.

在死者和生者之上，烈火缠绕的军团利刃呼啸而过。

flavorText.zh-CN: 高墙永不足以保护我们。我们需要先发制人。

flavorText.zh-CN: “一切都没变。光能给予我们力量，而我们必须尊重它。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.zh-CN: 汪洋大海，何能竭之？

flavorText.zh-CN: 通关欧洲空中区，造成精准最后一击，以及消灭邪魔族士兵。

flavorText.en: Entropy is inevitable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 熵增不可避免。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

description.en: Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
description.zh-CN: 使用哨兵圣盾或坚不可摧护盾防卫时移动速度更快。使用哨兵圣盾抵挡的伤害都会转化为超能能量，而使用坚不可摧抵挡的伤害都会转化为手雷能量。

description.en: Deliver these cursed yet delicious treats to Petra Venj wherever she can be found in the Reef.
description.zh-CN: 把这些虽然被诅咒但十分美味的点心送给暗礁某处的佩特拉·万吉。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 已发现的食谱

description.en: This weapon fires [Stagger] staggering projectiles. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.
description.zh-CN: 此武器发射眩晕射弹。适合对付势不可挡的勇士。

flavorText.en: Urgent|Tech|Helios|412| Someone call the boss. Call Central. We can't shelter in place here. Repeat, we can't—
flavorText.zh-CN: 紧急|技术|赫利俄斯|412| 快来个人联系老大。呼叫中枢。我们不能就地避难。重复，我们不能——

description.en: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.
description.zh-CN: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予近战属性加成。

flavorText.en: An Earth artifact, refashioned to suit the Emperor's modest tastes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件地球古物，经过翻新以迎合大帝的高雅品味。

sourceString.en: Acquired from the Menagerie aboard the Leviathan.
sourceString.zh-CN: 由利维坦上的奇珍异兽园获得。

flavorText.en: "Sylvie is a stain on this family, turning my son against me every chance she gets. His death is on her hands too." —Clovis Bray I
flavorText.zh-CN: “希尔薇是这个家族的一个污点，她一有机会就教唆我的儿子跟我作对。他的死也应该算到她的头上。”——克洛维斯·布瑞一世

flavorText.en: For the fine feathered friends.
flavorText.zh-CN: 致有精致羽毛的朋友。

description.en: Equip this ornament to change the appearance of Graviton Forfeit. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此皮肤以改变失重引力子的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: This way, they won't see the whites of your eyes.
flavorText.zh-CN: 这样他们就看不到你的眼白了。

flavorText.en: "There's not enough seats."
flavorText.zh-CN: “座位不够。”

flavorText.en: The engineers aren't ready for us.
flavorText.zh-CN: 工程师还没做好准备。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

description.en: Well-rounded, reliable, fires a 3-round burst.
description.zh-CN: 全面，可靠，可进行3发点射。

flavorText.en: Be prepared to walk through ash and flame.
flavorText.zh-CN: 准备踏过灰烬与烈焰吧。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of Aureus Neutralizer. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变金质消除者的外观。已解锁的皮肤可供你账号中的所有角色使用。

flavorText.en: A mercurial limb: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一件莫测护手：供寻觅关于暗影答案的人使用。

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成试炼入场券并从玖的使者处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: A gleaming amulet with a mantra inscribed. You control your breathing, and the world slows to a crawl.
flavorText.zh-CN: 刻着咒语的闪亮护身符。控制住呼吸，世界就会慢下来。

flavorText.en: The belt of a practiced master. Faster, faster, always faster. Unleash the tempest within.
flavorText.zh-CN: 经过历练的大师腰带。加速，加速，不断加速。释放出内心的暴风雨吧。

flavorText.en: A sliver of fulgurite carved by lightning. Strike precisely, and do not relent.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一片被闪电雕琢而成的雷击石。精准打击，不留余地。

flavorText.en: Shards of an Ahamkara bone, found in the ruins of the old Tower Courtyard. Their whispers make you feel light as a feather… but why?
flavorText.zh-CN: 在旧高塔庭院的废墟中发现的阿罕卡拉遗骨碎片。它们的低语让你觉得如鸿毛般轻盈…但为什么会这样呢？

flavorText.en: Never falter, never break.
flavorText.zh-CN: 永不动摇，永不放弃。

flavorText.en: Time to embrace humbleness.
flavorText.zh-CN: 现在要表现得谦逊一些啦。

description.en: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of precision hits dealt beforehand.
description.zh-CN: 精准最后一击会产生元素伤害爆炸，该爆炸会根据先前造成的精准命中次数造成额外伤害。

flavorText.en: "So long as the Iron Banner flies, the Iron Lords will never die." —Lord Saladin
flavorText.zh-CN: “只要铁旗仍在飘扬，钢铁领主就永远不灭。”——领主萨拉丁

flavorText.en: Tomorrow we'll hear ourselves again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 明日我们将再次听见自己的声音。

flavorText.en: In the cold of winter, we remember that the warm west wind will blow again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 尽管置身严冬，我们也记得那温暖的西风将再次吹来。

flavorText.zh-CN:
“如果你不知道作为人类是什么感觉，不知道陶醉于简单快乐的感觉，你又如何能够保护人类呢？”——伊娃·莱万特

Fragments are used to modify your abilities. They are shared across subclasses of the same element type.

碎片可用于改变你的技能。它们能在所有相同元素类型的分支职业之间共享。

你当前没有任何碎片容量。通过装备星相获取能量。

description.zh-CN: 将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

description.en: Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.
description.zh-CN: 将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

flavorText.en: "Listen closely to those deep, distant warnings you feel."
flavorText.zh-CN: “仔细聆听你感觉到的那些深邃幽远的警告。”

description.en: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.
description.zh-CN: 激活飞升或裂空打击会朝附近目标投掷出不断弹跳的爆炸物，震颤敌人并对其造成伤害。震颤附近目标可为你提供伤害抗性。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Greatly increases your Thundercrash damage and grants you damage resistance after impact. Melee final blows while amplified grant you Super energy.
description.zh-CN: 显著提升你的雷霆冲击伤害并在命中后为你提供伤害抗性。增幅时的近战最后一击会为你提供超能能量。

flavorText.en: Complete Heroic public events, collect Solar orbs in any strike, and defeat Hive combatants using a subclass that matches the [Arc] / [Solar] / [Void] Day.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成英雄公共事件；在任意打击任务中收集烈日光球；使用匹配 /  / 日的分支职业来消灭邪魔族士兵。

flavorText.en: "The mind might quail, so your heart must prevail." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “念虽有畏，心无所愧。其若冰清，天塌而不惊。”——埃里斯·摩恩

flavorText.en: "Do not face your foes head-on. Barrage them from above. Bewilder them with misdirection." —Clovis Bray
flavorText.zh-CN: “不要直接与你的敌人硬碰。从上方对他们展开轰炸。用声东击西使他们惊慌失措。”——克洛维斯·布瑞

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

description.en: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability for an extended duration.
description.zh-CN: 投身战斗一小段时间会在更长的时间内提升操控性和稳定性。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 罕见 强化原始特性

description.en:
This item applies a purple glow to all Solstice head armor. Once you unlock it, it's available for all three classes.

This elemental armor glow shines brightest when your subclass element matches.
description.zh-CN:
此物品会为所有至日头部护甲提供一个紫色炫彩效果。所有三个职业都将获得解锁的物品。

当分支职业元素与元素护甲炫彩相匹配时，效果最闪亮。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 头部护甲炫彩

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 泰坦通用皮肤

description.en: Equip this Weapon Ornament to change the appearance of Tractor Cannon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变牵引器火炮的外观。

flavorText.en: Circle 'round, great harbinger of death.
flavorText.zh-CN: 螺旋子弹，死亡的最佳预言者。

sourceString.en: Random Perks: This item cannot be reacquired from Collections.
sourceString.zh-CN: 随机特性：此物品无法从收藏品再次获取。

flavorText.en: "Black market arms aren't a particularly popular subject, for obvious reasons. Some nights I lie in bed wondering if we're doing the right thing at all." —H. Meyrin
flavorText.zh-CN: “黑市军火并非什么流行话题，原因很明显。夜晚的时候我躺在床上总会在想，我们所做的一切到底是否正确。”——H·梅兰

flavorText.en: "Just 'cause there's another player at the table don't mean our hand is weaker." —The Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “牌桌上多了一个玩家，并不意味着我们的牌就变差了。”——浪客

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Gambit matches and earn rank-up packages from the Drifter.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成智谋比赛并从浪客处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: "Osiris said that he started to pity the Red Legion, getting trapped in here for infinite eternities. I think they're getting exactly what they deserve." —Sagira
flavorText.zh-CN: “奥斯里斯说他开始为猩红军团感到抱歉了，被困在这无尽之中。而我觉得他们真的是活该。”——萨吉拉

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Nightfall strike "Tree of Probabilities."
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成日落打击“概率之树”。

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Earn Crucible Engrams during Season 3 to unlock and equip this ornament.
description.zh-CN: 第3赛季期间赢取熔炉竞技场记忆水晶可解锁并装备此皮肤。

flavorText.en: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从此处到外环，插翅难飞。

flavorText.en: "When you master the Light, it becomes an extension of your reach." —Lyssa, the Lighthearted
flavorText.zh-CN: “当你掌握了光能，它将成为你达成目标途中的敲门砖。”——轻盈的丽莎

flavorText.en: "If the Vex had achieved what we would call 'time travel,' surely none of us would now exist." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果Vex能够进行我们所谓的‘时间旅行'，我们就不可能存在。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

description.en:
A rare curio obtained from a Nightfall.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.
description.zh-CN:
一件从日落中获取的罕见珍品。

该纪念物插入已塑形或强化武器中时会为武器提供额外的装饰选项。

你一次只能存放三件此类纪念物。

description.en: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.
description.zh-CN: 这个模组已经被弃用，失去了功能。你可以用另一个模组进行替换。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 普通 弃用的护甲模组

flavorText.en: I am, therefore I think.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我在，故我思。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“永恒沙漠”史诗突袭

flavorText.en: "The Loyalists won't be ready until every world in this system casts a Shadow. Calus will get us there." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer
flavorText.zh-CN: “效忠者会一直等待直到银河系的所有世界充斥暗影。卡鲁斯将指引我们。”——颅骨刺穿者，法尔绰克

sourceString.en: Source: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：世界吞噬者，利维坦突袭巢穴。

flavorText.en: "How does Light make you tougher? Bullets strike your armor and then decide they didn't."
flavorText.zh-CN: “光明如何使得你更加坚强？子弹打上你的盔甲，你却毫发无损。”

flavorText.en: I wish to be ruthless.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我愿残酷无情。

flavorText.en: "How you get so clean, killer?" —Drifter
flavorText.zh-CN: “你身上为什么还能保持干净，杀手？”——浪客

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：奥斯里斯试炼挑战

description.en: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
description.zh-CN: 能够引起一场集中的闪电风暴的手雷。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧手雷 | 光能技能

itemTypeDisplayName.zh-CN: 电弧手雷 | 光能技能

flavorText.en: – Let your mind be split into the many facets of thought it so craves to embody –
flavorText.zh-CN: – 让你的意识按其所愿，分裂成多重思维面 –

description.en: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.
description.zh-CN: 使用此着色器更改装备配色。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：巅峰难度世界吞噬者，利维坦突袭巢穴。

flavorText.zh-CN: 在欧洲空中区洗掠宝箱，在任意活动中收集任意类型的元素光球，以及装备灼烧分支职业在欧洲空中区消灭敌人。

This mod's perks are only active in the "Root of Nightmares" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod will not improve its effects.
description.zh-CN:
此模组特性仅在“梦魇根源”突袭中生效。

多个此模组不会强化其效果。

flavorText.en: Let them rally. You will shatter their courage to fight.
flavorText.zh-CN: 让他们集结吧，你将粉碎他们战斗的勇气。

name.zh-CN: 火箭发射器弹药回收器

flavorText.en: "They gave us nothing… so we'll take everything." —Elykris, transl. from Eliksni
flavorText.zh-CN: “他们什么都没给我们……那我们就把所有东西都带走。”——埃里克瑞斯，译自埃里克斯尼语

flavorText.en: Complete the 1AU Redux mission, defeat enemies with Arc grenades, and win non-private Crucible matches.
flavorText.zh-CN: 完成终极版1AU任务，使用电弧手雷消灭敌人，赢得熔炉竞技场非私人比赛。

description.en: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.
description.zh-CN: 消灭目标会用储存弹药填装部分弹匣，弹药数量提高。

flavorText.en: I feel the void, and through this experience, I learn that want is suffering.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我感受了虚空，这经历让我明白了：渴望即折磨。

description.en: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.
description.zh-CN: 在任意合适的传奇护甲物品上装备此皮肤以改变它的外观。你账号中的所有相关角色都将解锁获得的通用皮肤。

flavorText.en: Mess with the best, die like the rest.
flavorText.zh-CN: 与我为敌，必死无疑。

description.en: This weapon generates Orbs on multikills, and displays the number of enemies defeated by using it.
description.zh-CN: 使用武器多杀时会生成光球，并显示使用此武器时击杀敌人的数量。

flavorText.en: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. They should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “此消息传达给所有你进贡于我的虚假卡巴尔。他们不会表露出来，但他们畏惧你。他们应该如此。”——卡巴尔大帝，卡鲁斯

description.en: Restores your gear to its default colors.
description.zh-CN: 将装备恢复为默认颜色。

flavorText.en: A single word etched inside the barrel: "Wilhelmina-1."
flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“威廉明娜-1”

flavorText.en: You put the "snicker" in "snicker-snack."
flavorText.zh-CN: 你用“窃笑”炒出一盘“窃笑小吃”。

flavorText.en: To warm our bodies in the chill of the night.
flavorText.zh-CN: 在霜降寒夜中，使我们的身体温暖。

flavorText.en: An infinitely sharp edge to dissect reality.
flavorText.zh-CN: 剖开现实的无限利刃。

flavorText.en: A tightly coiled whip with fraying ends, carried at your side. You twist the universe until it tears.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你把一条两端磨损、紧紧盘绕的皮鞭带在身边。你抽动宇宙，直至它撕裂开来。

flavorText.en: A cracked hand mirror, held together with dark wire. What looks back is yours, but not you.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一面裂开的手持镜子，由黑暗的丝线固定在一起。镜中对望着你的，是你的影像，而非你自己。

flavorText.en: A small shadow box with an arachnid on display showcasing the creature's deadly beauty. Give them something to really catch their eye.
flavorText.zh-CN: 装着一个蛛形纲动物的小陈列框，展示着该生物的致命之美。让人眼前一亮。

flavorText.en: The softest whisper of a glove meant to be worn under a gauntlet. Seize the threads of reality.
flavorText.zh-CN: 最柔软的手套应被穿在臂铠之下。抓住现实的丝线吧。

description.en: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.
description.zh-CN: 全面型握把，可靠耐用。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 传说 强化固有特性

flavorText.en: Inescapable, from here to the Outer Rim.
flavorText.zh-CN: 从此处到外环，插翅难飞。

flavorText.en: "Iterate and advance. That's what we do. No time to dwell on failures, only learn from them." —Kestrel, Cloud Strider
flavorText.zh-CN: “迭代和前进。这就是我们的做派。没时间沉湎于失败，只能从中吸取教训。”——云端行者，茶隼

description.en: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.
description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.en: Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning on all nearby targets, jolting them while also amplifying allies. Defeating Arc debuffed targets grants a small amount of Gathering Storm energy.
description.zh-CN: 激活风起云涌会召唤闪电攻击附近所有目标，震颤他们的同时增幅盟友。击败受到电弧减益的目标会提供少量的风起云涌能量。

flavorText.en: “We armed the Sindu with a fleet of golden ships. Their interceptors are a shield for the Leviathan, as the Shadows are my sword.” —Emperor Calus
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们给信德装备了一支黄金飞船舰队。他们的拦截者就是利维坦的护盾，就像暗影是我的利剑一样。”——卡鲁斯大帝

flavorText.en: You're a difficult one to find.
flavorText.zh-CN: 找寻你如同大海捞针。

flavorText.en: "A Devil or a King may still call herself Eliksni. In Exile, I am Fallen." –Azeryks, un-Wintered
flavorText.zh-CN: “恶魔或王族仍可自称是埃里克斯尼族。流亡之中，我自堕落。”——阿泽瑞克斯，未历严霜者

description.zh-CN: 装备此5阶武器皮肤以改变此武器的外观。

description.zh-CN: 装备此武器皮肤以改变群居者的外观。您账号中的所有角色都将解锁获得的皮肤。

flavorText.en: "Some speculate that the radiolarian fluid is the last vestige of a biological life-form that became the Vex." —Sister Faora, "Theories on the Vex"
flavorText.zh-CN: “有人推测，这种放射液体是变成Vex的生物最后残余的生命形态。”——菲奥拉修女，《Vex论》

flavorText.en: Think of it as a weaponized temper tantrum.
flavorText.zh-CN: 把它想成一把会大发脾气的武器吧。

flavorText.en: The inscription, written in a Cabal dialect, reads: "Inexorable victory."
flavorText.zh-CN: 这句卡巴尔语铭文意为：“不可阻挡的胜利”。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "It's versatile. By itself, it's nothing, just an empty tube. But that's its deceptive beauty; it's all about what you fill it with. What you make it. What you make it do." —Banshee-44
flavorText.zh-CN: “它的用途很广。就其本身而言，它只是个空空如也的管子。而这种欺骗性也正是它的美丽之处；重要的是你在里面装什么，你使它成为什么，以及你用它达成什么目的。”——班西-44

flavorText.zh-CN: “也许你已逃脱天启初降，但你永难摆脱天启再临。”——浪客

description.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat combatants while using this weapon in Arc, Solar, and Void modes to unlock this upgrade.

Defeating combatants in the Throne World or Battlegrounds will unlock these objectives faster. Defeating Champions provides bonus progress to all 3 objectives.
description.zh-CN:
将此武器升级为大师杰作。升级后，武器将获得强化能力，如提高的属性和/或额外的特性。

使用此武器在电弧、烈日以及虚空模式下消灭战斗人员以解锁这项升级。

在王座世界或战场中击败战斗人员会使解锁这些目标的速度加快。击败勇士可为所有3项目标提供额外进度。

description.en:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空光能圣盾。
哨兵圣盾生效时：
[轻攻击]  ：攻击。
[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

description.en:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.
description.zh-CN:
为你和你的盟友制造一个防护圆顶护罩。

你和你的盟友处在黎明护罩中时，会获得虚空覆盖护盾并且提升武器伤害，护罩内的目标则会被削弱。

护罩的制造者在护罩中时还会获得近战伤害提升，并且可以拾取并投掷护罩核心，以此重新放置护罩，最多两次。

description.en:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
description.zh-CN:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

flavorText.en: "That 10-year timer simplifies things, in a way. What's most important? Right here, right now? What one thing makes Neomuna better?" —Derecho, Cloud Strider
